Name: Isooctane
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a petroleum-like odor. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Vapors are heavier than air.

Name: (E,Z)-Allo-Ocimene
Description: This molecule is an ocimene.

Name: (+)-thujopsene
Description: This molecule is a thujopsene that has (R,R,R)-configuration. It is an enantiomer of a (-)-thujopsene.

Name: 2-methyl-Pentadecane
Description: This molecule is an alkane.

Name: Cuparene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Pentadecanoate
Description: This molecule is a straight-chain, saturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of pentadecanoic acid. It is the major species at pH 7.3. It has a role as an animal metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is a long-chain fatty acid anion, a straight-chain saturated fatty acid anion and a fatty acid anion 15:0. It is a conjugate base of a pentadecanoic acid.

Name: Isopimaric acid
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid, a carbotricyclic compound and a monocarboxylic acid. It is a conjugate acid of an isopimarate. It derives from a hydride of an isopimara-7,15-diene.

Name: Beta-humulene
Description: This molecule is a humulene.

Name: Alpha-curcumene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene that is 2-methyl-2-heptene in which one of the hydrogens at position 6 is substituted by a p-tolyl group.

Name: Kaempferol 7-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside
Description: This molecule is a kaempferol O-glucoside that is kaempferol attached to a beta-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a metabolite, a radical scavenger and a plant metabolite. It is a beta-D-glucoside, a kaempferol O-glucoside, a monosaccharide derivative, a trihydroxyflavone and a member of flavonols. It is functionally related to a beta-D-glucose. It is a conjugate acid of a kaempferol 7-O-beta-D-glucoside(1-).

Name: L-camphor
Description: This molecule appears as colorless or white crystals. Fragrant and penetrating odor. Slightly bitter and cooling taste. Odor index at 68 °F: 40. Flash point 149 °F. Burns with a bright, smoky flame. Sublimes appreciably at room temperature and pressure; 14% sublimes within 60 minutes at 176 °F and 12 mmHg. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Bis(2-ethylhexyl) adipate
Description: This molecule is a colorless to straw-colored liquid with a mild odor. Floats on water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: (R)-beta-himachalene
Description: This molecule is the (R)-enantiomer of beta-himachalene. It is an enantiomer of a (S)-beta-himachalene.

Name: Orsellinic acid methyl ester
Description: This molecule is a hydroxybenzoic acid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Tetrahymanol
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid having a 3beta- (21alpha-) hydroxy-substituted gammacerane structure. It derives from a hydride of a gammacerane.

Name: Onoceranoxide
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Methyl caffeate
Description: This molecule is an alkyl caffeate ester formed by the formal condensation of caffeic acid with methyl alcohol. It is an alkyl caffeate ester and a methyl ester.

Name: Ethyl trans-caffeate
Description: This molecule is an ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-caffeic acid with ethanol. It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent and an antineoplastic agent. It is an alkyl caffeate ester and an ethyl ester. It is functionally related to a trans-caffeic acid.

Name: 1-Cyano-2-hydroxymethylprop-1-ene-3-ol
Description: This molecule is a nitrile.

Name: Stigmasterol 3-O-beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin that is (3beta,22E)-stigmasta-5,22-dien-3-ol attached to a beta-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage. It is isolated from Symplocos lancifolia. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a member of phytosterols, a steroid saponin, a beta-D-glucoside and a monosaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to a stigmasterol. It derives from a hydride of a stigmastane.

Name: 3-Pentadecylphenol
Description: This molecule is a member of phenols.

Name: Tremetone
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: Tiglic acid, [corrosive solid]
Description: This molecule appears as a white lustrous flaked solid with a fruity or spicy odor. About the same density as water and slightly soluble in water. May burn if heated to high temperatures. May severely irritate skin, eyes, lungs or mucous membranes.

Name: 20-hydroxyecdysone
Description: This molecule is an ecdysteroid that is ecdysone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 20. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an animal metabolite. It is a 20-hydroxy steroid, an ecdysteroid, a 14alpha-hydroxy steroid, a 3beta-sterol, a 2beta-hydroxy steroid, a 22-hydroxy steroid, a 25-hydroxy steroid and a phytoecdysteroid. It is functionally related to an ecdysone.

Name: Caprolactam
Description: This molecule is a clear to milky white-colored solution with a mild, disagreeable odor. Contact may cause slight irritation to skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. May be mildly toxic by ingestion. The primary hazard is the threat to the environment. Immediate steps should be taken to limit its spread to the environment. As a liquid it can easily penetrate the soil and contaminate groundwater and nearby streams. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Methylnaphthalene
Description: This molecule appears as bluish-brown oil or a clear yellow liquid. Coal tar or mothball odor. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Methacrylic acid
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid (or low-melting solid) with a pungent odor. Corrosive to metals and tissue. Flash point 170 °F. Melting point 61 °F. May polymerize exothermically if heated or contaminated. If the polymerization takes place inside a container, the container may rupture violently. Less dense than water. Vapors heavier than air. Used to make plastics.

Name: 1,4-dimethylnaphthalene
Description: This molecule is a dimethylnaphthalene carrying methyl groups at positions 1 and 4.

Name: 2,7-dimethylnaphthalene
Description: This molecule is a dimethylnaphthalene.

Name: 1,7-dimethylnaphthalene
Description: This molecule is a dimethylnaphthalene carrying methyl groups at positions 1 and 7.

Name: Ethyl octadecanoate
Description: This molecule is an octadecanoate ester obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of octadecanoic (stearic) acid and the hydroxy group of ethanol. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a long-chain fatty acid ethyl ester and an octadecanoate ester.

Name: Mitraphylline
Description: This molecule is a member of indolizines.

Name: Rhynchophylline
Description: This molecule is a member of indolizines. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Amabiline
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S,3S)-2,3-dihydroxy-2-isopropylbutanoic acid with the hydroxy group of (7aS)-2,3,5,7a-tetrahydropyrrolizin-7-ylmethanol. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of pyrrolizines, a butyrate ester, a carboxylic ester, a secondary alcohol, a tertiary alcohol and a pyrrolizidine alkaloid.

Name: Echinatine
Description: This molecule is a citraconoyl group.

Name: (+)-syringaresinol beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a beta-D-glucoside. It has a role as a metabolite. It is functionally related to a (+)-syringaresinol.

Name: Solasonine
Description: This molecule is an azaspiro compound, an oxaspiro compound and a steroid.

Name: Solavetivone
Description: This molecule is a cyclic ketone derived from spiro[4.5]dec-6-en-8-one by substitution of hydrogens by methyl groups at positions 6 and 10, and by an isopropenyl group at position 2 (the (2R,5S,10R)-diastereoisomer). It has a role as a phytoalexin and a plant metabolite. It is a spiro compound, a sesquiterpenoid and a cyclic ketone.

Name: 1-[(2E,4E)-2,4-decadienoyl]pyrrolidine
Description: This molecule is a N-acylpyrrolidine. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Myristicin
Description: This molecule is an organic molecular entity. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Tuberoside E
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Pectolinarin
Description: This molecule is a disaccharide derivative that consists of pectolinarigenin substituted by a 6-O-(6-deoxy-alpha-L-mannopyranosyl)-beta-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as an apoptosis inducer, an anti-inflammatory agent, a plant metabolite, an antineoplastic agent, an EC 3.4.22.69 (SARS coronavirus main proteinase) inhibitor and an antioxidant. It is a dimethoxyflavone, a rutinoside, a glycosyloxyflavone, a disaccharide derivative and a monohydroxyflavanone. It is functionally related to a pectolinarigenin.

Name: Scutellarein
Description: This molecule is flavone substituted with hydroxy groups at C-4', -5, -6 and -7. It has a role as a metabolite. It is functionally related to an apigenin. It is a conjugate acid of a scutellarein(1-).

Name: Sorbose
Description: This molecule is a ketohexose often involved in the commercial production of vitamin C. It has been found to occur naturally in grapes. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: Dioscin
Description: This molecule is a spirostanyl glycoside that consists of the trisaccharide alpha-L-Rha-(1->4)-[alpha-L-Rha-(1->2)]-beta-D-Glc attached to position 3 of diosgenin via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a metabolite, an antifungal agent, an antiviral agent, an antineoplastic agent, an anti-inflammatory agent, a hepatoprotective agent, an apoptosis inducer and an EC 1.14.18.1 (tyrosinase) inhibitor. It is a spirostanyl glycoside, a spiroketal, a hexacyclic triterpenoid and a trisaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to a diosgenin. It derives from a hydride of a spirostan.

Name: Taxifolin
Description: This molecule is a pentahydroxyflavanone that is the 2,3-dihydro derivative of quercetin. It is a pentahydroxyflavanone, a member of dihydroflavonols, a member of 3'-hydroxyflavanones, a secondary alpha-hydroxy ketone and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones. It is functionally related to a quercetin.

Name: Ammonium oxalate
Description: This molecule is an odorless solid. Sinks and mixes slowly with water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Erythritol
Description: This molecule is the meso-diastereomer of butane-1,2,3,4-tetrol. It has a role as an antioxidant, a plant metabolite and a human metabolite.

Name: Beauvericin
Description: This molecule is a trimeric cyclodepsipeptide composed from alternating methylphenylalanyl and hydroxyvaleryl residues. It has a role as a mycotoxin, an antibiotic insecticide, an apoptosis inhibitor, a fungal metabolite, an ionophore, an antifungal agent, a P450 inhibitor and an antineoplastic agent.

Name: L-homoarginine
Description: This molecule is an L-lysine derivative that is the L-enantiomer of homoarginine. It has a role as an EC 3.1.3.1 (alkaline phosphatase) inhibitor, a human metabolite, a xenobiotic metabolite, a rat metabolite and a biomarker. It is a L-lysine derivative, a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid and a homoarginine. It is a conjugate base of a This molecule(1+).

Name: Afzelechin
Description: This molecule is a tetrahydroxyflavan that is (2S)-flavan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, 7 and 4' respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an EC 3.2.1.20 (alpha-glucosidase) inhibitor. It is a tetrahydroxyflavan and a catechin. It derives from a hydride of a (2S)-flavan.

Name: Quercetagetin
Description: This molecule is a hexahydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, 6, 7, 3' and 4' respectively. It has a role as an antioxidant, an antiviral agent and a plant metabolite. It is a member of flavonols and a hexahydroxyflavone. It is functionally related to a quercetin.

Name: Futoquinol
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Fisetinidol
Description: This molecule is a tetrahydroxyflavan that is (2S)-flavan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 7, 3' and 4'. It has a role as an EC 3.2.1.20 (alpha-glucosidase) inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a tetrahydroxyflavan and a catechin. It derives from a hydride of a (2S)-flavan.

Name: Futoenone
Description: This molecule is a neolignan with formula C20H20O5 that is isolated from Magnolia sprengeri and Piper wallichii. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a bridged compound, a member of benzodioxoles, an organic heterotricyclic compound, an enol ether, an enone, a neolignan, a cyclic ketone and a ring assembly.

Name: (+)-epicatechin
Description: This molecule is a catechin that is flavan carrying five hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 3', 4', 5 and 7 (the 2S,3S-stereoisomer). It has a role as a cyclooxygenase 1 inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a catechin and a polyphenol. It is an enantiomer of a (-)-epicatechin.

Name: Cucurbitacin E
Description: This molecule is a cucurbitacin in which a lanostane skeleton is multi-substituted with hydroxy, methyl and oxo substituents, with unsaturation at positions 1, 5 and 23. It is a cucurbitacin and a tertiary alpha-hydroxy ketone.

Name: 2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)ethanol
Description: This molecule is a phenol substituted at position 4 by a 2-hydroxyethyl group. It has a role as an anti-arrhythmia drug, an antioxidant, a cardiovascular drug, a protective agent, a fungal metabolite, a geroprotector and a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a 2-phenylethanol.

Name: Hypericin
Description: This molecule is a carbopolycyclic compound. It has a role as an antidepressant. It derives from a hydride of a bisanthene.

Name: Hyperforin
Description: This molecule is a cyclic terpene ketone that is a prenylated carbobicyclic acylphloroglucinol derivative produced by St. John's Wort, Hypericum perforatum. It has a role as a GABA reuptake inhibitor, a plant metabolite, an anti-inflammatory agent, an antidepressant, an antibacterial agent, an antineoplastic agent and an apoptosis inducer. It is a cyclic terpene ketone, a sesquarterpenoid and a carbobicyclic compound.

Name: Oxolucidine B
Description: This molecule is an organonitrogen heterocyclic compound that is lucidine B in which the hydrogen at the 4a position of the dodecahydrobenzo[5,6]cyclohepta[1,2-b]pyridinyl moiety is substituted by a hydroxy group. It is an organonitrogen heterocyclic compound, a tertiary alcohol, a tertiary amino compound and a decahydroquinoline alkaloid. It is functionally related to a lucidine B.

Name: Spirolucidine
Description: This molecule is an azaspiro compound, a decahydroquinoline alkaloid and a member of piperidines.

Name: Rescinnamine
Description: This molecule is an odorless white to cream colored crystalline powder. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Reserpiline
Description: This molecule is a yohimban alkaloid.

Name: Acanthospermolide
Description: This molecule is a germacranolide.

Name: Muramine
Description: This molecule is a dibenzazecine alkaloid that is 5,7,8,14-tetrahydrodibenzo[c,g]azecin-13(6H)-one substituted by a methyl group at position 6 and by methoxy groups at positions 3, 4, 10, and 11. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a dibenzazecine alkaloid, a tertiary amino compound and an aromatic ether.

Name: LSM-2938
Description: This molecule is a macrolide.

Name: Anacrotine
Description: This molecule is a macrolide.

Name: Integerrine
Description: This molecule is a cyclic peptide.

Name: Uscharidin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside.

Name: 13(S)-HOTrE
Description: This molecule is the (13S)-stereoisomer of HOTrE. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a This molecule(1-).

Name: Benzethonium chloride
Description: This molecule appears as odorless white crystals or powder with a very bitter taste. A 1% solution in water is slightly alkaline to litmus. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Uvarigrandin A
Description: This molecule is a polyketide. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Ampelopsin B
Description: This molecule is a heterotetracyclic stilbenoid that is a homodimer obtained by cyclodimerisation of resveratrol. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a lipoxygenase inhibitor. It is a polyphenol, a stilbenoid and an organic heterotetracyclic compound. It is functionally related to a resveratrol.

Name: Pallidol
Description: This molecule is a tetracyclic stilbenoid that is a homodimer obtained by cyclodimerisation of resveratrol. It has a role as an antioxidant, an antifungal agent and a plant metabolite. It is a polyphenol, a stilbenoid and a carbopolycyclic compound. It is functionally related to a resveratrol.

Name: Colchicoside
Description: This molecule is a carbotricyclic compound, an alkaloid and a member of acetamides.

Name: Licochalcone B
Description: This molecule is a member of chalcones.

Name: Prunetin
Description: This molecule is a hydroxyisoflavone that is genistein in which the hydroxy group at position 7 is replaced by a methoxy group. It has a role as a metabolite, an EC 1.3.1.22 [3-oxo-5alpha-steroid 4-dehydrogenase (NADP(+))] inhibitor, an anti-inflammatory agent and an EC 1.2.1.3 [aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD(+))] inhibitor. It is a hydroxyisoflavone and a member of 7-methoxyisoflavones. It is functionally related to a genistein. It is a conjugate acid of a prunetin-5-olate.

Name: Glabrene
Description: This molecule is an isoflavonoid.

Name: L-aspartic acid
Description: This molecule is the L-enantiomer of aspartic acid. It has a role as an Escherichia coli metabolite, a mouse metabolite and a neurotransmitter. It is an aspartate family amino acid, a proteinogenic amino acid, an aspartic acid and a L-alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate acid of a L-aspartate(1-). It is an enantiomer of a D-aspartic acid.

Name: Glabranin
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyflavanone that is pinocembrin substituted by a prenyl group at position 8. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a dihydroxyflavanone and a (2S)-flavan-4-one. It is functionally related to a pinocembrin.

Name: Glandulone C
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Gentiacaulein
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 8 and methoxy groups at positions 1 and 6. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of xanthones, a polyphenol and an aromatic ether.

Name: Naringenin 7-O-beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a flavanone 7-O-beta-D-glucoside that is (S)-naringenin substituted by a beta-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a metabolite, a hypoglycemic agent, an antilipemic drug and an antibacterial agent. It is a flavanone 7-O-beta-D-glucoside, a dihydroxyflavanone, a monosaccharide derivative, a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones and a (2S)-flavan-4-one. It is functionally related to a (S)-naringenin.

Name: 1,4,5-Naphthalenetriol
Description: This molecule is a member of naphthols.

Name: Schaftoside
Description: This molecule is a C-glycosyl compound that is apigenin substituted by beta-D-glucopyranosyl and an alpha-L-arabinopyranosyl moieties at positions 6 and 8 via C-glycosidic linkages. It has a role as an antinematodal drug and an antioxidant. It is a C-glycosyl compound and a trihydroxyflavone. It is functionally related to an apigenin.

Name: Glabrol
Description: This molecule is a member of flavanones.

Name: Liqcoumarin
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycoumarin.

Name: Kanzonol T
Description: This molecule is a member of isoflavanones.

Name: Kanzonol C
Description: This molecule is a member of chalcones.

Name: 13-Hydroxy-9,11-hexadecadienoic acid
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty acid.

Name: Isoschaftoside
Description: This molecule is a C-glycosyl compound that is apigenin substituted at positions 6 and 8 by alpha-L-arabinopyranosyl and beta-D-glucosyl residues respectively. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a C-glycosyl compound and a trihydroxyflavone. It is functionally related to an apigenin.

Name: Hispaglabridin A
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of hydroxyisoflavans that is (R)-isoflavan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 4' , a 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group at position 3' and a 2,2-dimethyl-2H-pyran group across positions 7 and 8 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It derives from a hydride of a (R)-isoflavan.

Name: Glycyrrhizinic acid
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin that is the glucosiduronide derivative of 3beta-hydroxy-11-oxoolean-12-en-30-oic acid. It has a role as an EC 3.4.21.5 (thrombin) inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a glucosiduronic acid, a tricarboxylic acid, a pentacyclic triterpenoid, an enone and a triterpenoid saponin. It is a conjugate acid of a glycyrrhizinate(3-).

Name: Glabridin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of hydroxyisoflavans that is (R)-isoflavan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 4' and a 2,2-dimethyl-2H-pyran group across positions 7 and 8 respectively. It has a role as an antiplasmodial drug. It derives from a hydride of a (R)-isoflavan.

Name: Licoagrodin
Description: This molecule is a member of flavanones.

Name: 2,5-bis(hydroxymethyl)-3,4-dihydroxypyrrolidine
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxypyrrolidine.

Name: Kanzonol W
Description: This molecule is an isoflavonoid.

Name: 3-Hydroxyglabrol
Description: This molecule is a member of flavanones.

Name: Licoricidin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of hydroxyisoflavans that is R-isoflavan with hydroxy groups at positions 7, 2' and 4', a methoxy group at position 5 and prenyl groups at positions 6 and 3'. Isolated from Glycyrrhiza uralensis, it exhibits antibacterial activity. It has a role as an antibacterial agent and a plant metabolite. It is a member of hydroxyisoflavans, an aromatic ether and a methoxyisoflavan.

Name: Isoglabrolide
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Glabrolide
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Glabrone
Description: This molecule is an isoflavonoid.

Name: 7-Methoxy-2-methylisoflavone
Description: This molecule is a methoxyisoflavone.

Name: Licoagrochalcone C
Description: This molecule is a member of chalcones.

Name: 8-Hydroxy-2-methoxy-6-methyl-1,4-naphthoquinone
Description: This molecule is a naphthoquinone.

Name: Wighteone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is isoflavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 4' and a prenyl group at position 6. It has been isolated from Ficus mucuso. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an antifungal agent. It is functionally related to an isoflavone.

Name: 7-Acetoxy-2-methylisoflavone
Description: This molecule is a member of isoflavones.

Name: Ternatin
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: Isomangiferin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3, 6 and 7 and a 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol moiety at position 1. It has a role as an anti-HSV-1 agent and a plant metabolite. It is a member of xanthones, a C-glycosyl compound and a polyphenol.

Name: Delcosine
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: Delcorine
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: D-ribopyranose
Description: This molecule is a D-ribose and the D-enantiomer of ribopyranose. It is a ribopyranose and a D-ribose. It is an enantiomer of a L-ribopyranose.

Name: Schottenol
Description: This molecule is a steroid. It derives from a hydride of a stigmastane.

Name: 14-methylhexadecanoic acid
Description: This molecule is a methyl-branched fatty acid that is hexadecanoic acid (palmitic acid) substituted by a methyl group at position 14. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a mammalian metabolite. It is a methyl-branched fatty acid, a branched-chain saturated fatty acid and a long-chain fatty acid. It is functionally related to a hexadecanoic acid.

Name: Tectorigenin
Description: This molecule is a methoxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 and hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 4' respectively. It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent and a plant metabolite. It is a member of 7-hydroxyisoflavones and a methoxyisoflavone. It is functionally related to an isoflavone.

Name: Glycitein
Description: This molecule is a methoxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 and hydroxy groups at positions 7 and 4'. It has been isolated from the mycelia of the fungus Cordyceps sinensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite, a phytoestrogen and a fungal metabolite. It is a methoxyisoflavone and a 7-hydroxyisoflavone. It is functionally related to an isoflavone.

Name: Atractylenolide II
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: Methyl tetradecanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of tetradecanoic acid (myristic acid) with methanol. It has a role as a plant metabolite, a flavouring agent and a fragrance. It is functionally related to a tetradecanoic acid.

Name: Capsaicin
Description: This molecule is a capsaicinoid. It has a role as a non-narcotic analgesic, a voltage-gated sodium channel blocker and a TRPV1 agonist.

Name: 2,6-Nonadien-1-ol
Description: This molecule is an aliphatic alcohol.

Name: Ricinine
Description: This molecule is a pyridine alkaloid, a pyridone and a nitrile.

Name: Cyclanoline
Description: This molecule is a charged berberine alkaloid obtained by N-methylation of (S)-scoulerine. It has a role as an EC 3.1.1.7 (acetylcholinesterase) inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a quaternary ammonium ion and a berberine alkaloid. It is functionally related to a (S)-scoulerine.

Name: L-tartaric acid
Description: This molecule is the L-enantiomer of tartaric acid. It is a conjugate acid of a L-tartrate(1-). It is an enantiomer of a D-tartaric acid.

Name: Methyl pentadecanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester obtained by condensation of the carboxy group of pentadecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of methanol. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a bacterial metabolite. It is functionally related to a pentadecanoic acid.

Name: L-methionine sulfone
Description: This molecule is an L-methionine derivative in which the sulfur has been oxidised to the corresponding sulfone. It has a role as an animal metabolite. It is a L-methionine derivative, a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid and a methionine sulfone. It is a tautomer of a methionine sulfone zwitterion.

Name: Nonanoic acid
Description: This molecule is a C9 straight-chain saturated fatty acid which occurs naturally as esters of the oil of pelargonium. Has antifungal properties, and is also used as a herbicide as well as in the preparation of plasticisers and lacquers. It has a role as an antifeedant, a plant metabolite, a Daphnia magna metabolite and an algal metabolite. It is a straight-chain saturated fatty acid and a medium-chain fatty acid. It is a conjugate acid of a nonanoate. It derives from a hydride of a nonane.

Name: Heptanoic acid
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with a pungent odor. Less dense than water and poorly soluble in water. Hence floats on water. Very corrosive. Contact may likely burn skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. May be toxic by ingestion, inhalation and skin absorption. Flash point near 200 °F.

Name: Henicosanoic acid
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty acid that is henicosane in which one of the methyl groups has been oxidised to give the corresponding carboxylic acid. It is a straight-chain saturated fatty acid and a long-chain fatty acid. It is a conjugate acid of a henicosanoate.

Name: (-)-beta-curcumene
Description: This molecule is a beta-curcumene that has R configuration at the chiral centre. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: Frutinone A
Description: This molecule is a member of coumarins.

Name: Hexyl glucoside
Description: This molecule is an O-acyl carbohydrate.

Name: N-butyl alcohol
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid. Used in organic chemical synthesis, plasticizers, detergents, etc.

Name: Atractylenolide III
Description: This molecule is a naphthofuran. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Furanodiene
Description: This molecule is a germacrane sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Heptadecan-1-ol
Description: This molecule is a long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is heptadecane in which one of the terminal methyl hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxy group. It has a role as a plant metabolite, a volatile oil component and a fungal metabolite. It is a long-chain primary fatty alcohol and a heptadecanol.

Name: Poriferasta-7,22E-dien-3beta-ol
Description: This molecule is a steroid. It derives from a hydride of a stigmastane.

Name: Coelogin
Description: This molecule is a member of phenanthrenes.

Name: Beta-D-mannose
Description: This molecule is a D-mannopyranose in which the anomeric centre has beta configuration. It has a role as an epitope. It is an enantiomer of a beta-L-mannose.

Name: Taraxerol
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid that is oleanan-3-ol lacking the methyl group at position 14, with an alpha-methyl substituent at position 13 and a double bond between positions 14 and 15. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a secondary alcohol.

Name: 3',4',5,7-tetrahydroxy-3-methoxyflavone
Description: This molecule is a tetrahydroxyflavone having the 4-hydroxy groups located at the 3'- 4'- 5- and 7-positions as well as a methoxy group at the 2-position. It has a role as a metabolite and an antimicrobial agent. It is a tetrahydroxyflavone and a monomethoxyflavone. It is functionally related to a quercetin. It is a conjugate acid of a 3',4',5-trihydroxy-3-methoxyflavon-7-olate.

Name: Stephanthrine
Description: This molecule is an organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 2-(2H-phenanthro[3,4-d][1,3]dioxole in which the hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a 2-(dimethylamino)ethyl group. It is a cyclic acetal, an organic heterotetracyclic compound and a tertiary amino compound.

Name: 5-Methoxy-3-(2-phenyl-E-E-ethenyl)-2,4-bis(4-hydroxybenzyl) phenol
Description: This molecule is a diarylheptanoid.

Name: Lobetyolin
Description: This molecule is an O-acyl carbohydrate.

Name: 13-methylpentadecanoic acid
Description: This molecule is a methyl-branched fatty acid that is pentadecanoic acid substituted by a methyl group at position 13. It has a role as a Caenorhabditis elegans metabolite and a mammalian metabolite. It is a long-chain fatty acid, a methyl-branched fatty acid and a saturated fatty acid.

Name: 1-Peroxyferolide
Description: This molecule is a gamma-lactone.

Name: (R)-sulforaphane
Description: This molecule is a sulforaphane in which the sulfinyl group has R configuration. Naturally occurring compound found in brocolli that acts as a potent inducer of phase II detoxification enzymes. It is an enantiomer of a (S)-sulforaphane.

Name: Spinoside A
Description: This molecule is a cucurbitacin and a glycoside.

Name: Pyridine
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid with an unpleasant smell. It can be made from crude coal tar or from other chemicals. This molecule is used to dissolve other substances. It is also used to make many different products such as medicines, vitamins, food flavorings, paints, dyes, rubber products, adhesives, insecticides, and herbicides. This molecule can also be formed from the breakdown of many natural materials in the environment.

Name: Phytane
Description: This molecule is a diterpene.

Name: Alpha-D-mannose
Description: This molecule is d-Mannopyranose having alpha-configuration at the anomeric centre. It has a role as an epitope. It is an enantiomer of an alpha-L-mannose.

Name: Perlolyrine
Description: This molecule is an organic molecular entity. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Beta-carboline
Description: This molecule is the parent compound of the beta-carbolines, a tricyclic structure comprising an indole ring system ortho- fused to C-3 and C-4 of a pyridine ring. It has a role as a marine metabolite and a fungal metabolite. It is a member of beta-carbolines and a mancude organic heterotricyclic parent.

Name: Butyric acid
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with a penetrating and unpleasant odor. Flash point 170 °F. Corrosive to metals and tissue. Density 8.0 lb /gal.

Name: Tectoridin
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyisoflavone that is tectorigenin substituted by a beta-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a hydroxyisoflavone, a methoxyisoflavone, a monosaccharide derivative and a 7-hydroxyisoflavones 7-O-beta-D-glucoside. It is functionally related to a tectorigenin.

Name: Codonopsine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrrolidines.

Name: Di-isooctyl phthalate
Description: This molecule is an oily colorless liquid with a slight ester odor. Denser than water. Insoluble in water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Methionine S-oxide
Description: This molecule is the S-oxide derivative of methionine. It is a biomarker of oxidative stress. It has a role as a biomarker and a human metabolite.

Name: Syringaresinol
Description: This molecule is a lignan that is 7,9':7',9-diepoxylignane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 4' and methoxy groups at positions 3, 3', 5 and 5' respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a lignan, a polyphenol, an aromatic ether, a furofuran and a polyether.

Name: Methyl stearate
Description: This molecule appears as white crystals or chunky solid. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Taraxerone
Description: This molecule is a scalarane sesterterpenoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: 1-pentadecene
Description: This molecule is an unbranched fifteen-carbon alkene with one double bond between C-1 and C-2. It has a role as a mammalian metabolite.

Name: 6-methoxyluteolin 7-alpha-L-rhamnoside
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyflavone that is luteolin substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 and an alpha-L-rhamnosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It is an alpha-L-rhamnoside, a trihydroxyflavone, a monomethoxyflavone, a monosaccharide derivative and a glycosyloxyflavone. It is functionally related to a luteolin.

Name: Caproic acid
Description: This molecule appears as a white crystalline solid or colorless to light yellow solution with an unpleasant odor. Insoluble to slightly soluble in water and less dense than water. Contact may severely irritate skin, eyes and mucous membranes. May be toxic by ingestion, inhalation and skin absorption. Used to make perfumes.

Name: Beta-D-ribose
Description: This molecule is a D-ribofuranose in which the anomeric centre has beta-configuration. It is an enantiomer of a beta-L-ribose.

Name: 2,4,4,-Trimethyl-1-pentene
Description: This molecule is a hydrocarbon and component of gasoline.

Name: 3-Methylheptane
Description: This molecule is an alkane.

Name: Encecalin
Description: This molecule is a 1-benzopyran.

Name: Ethyl hexadecanoate
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty acid ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of palmitic acid with the hydroxy group of ethanol. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a hexadecanoate ester and a long-chain fatty acid ethyl ester.

Name: Biflorin
Description: This molecule is a member of chromones.

Name: PRIM-O-GLUCOSYLCIMIFUGIN
Description: This molecule is an organic heterotricyclic compound and an oxacycle.

Name: Pretazettine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Kalopanaxsaponin A
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin that is hederagenin attached to a 2-O-(6-deoxy-alpha-L-mannopyranosyl)-alpha-L-arabinopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the stem bark of Kalopanax pictus. It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent and a plant metabolite. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid, a triterpenoid saponin, a disaccharide derivative and a hydroxy monocarboxylic acid. It is functionally related to a hederagenin.

Name: 3-[(2R)-2-piperidinyl]pyridine
Description: This molecule is an aralkylamine.

Name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate(2-)
Description: This molecule is the dianion resulting from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of pyridoxal 5'-phosphate. It has a role as a human metabolite, a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite and a cofactor. It is a conjugate base of a pyridoxal 5'-phosphate.

Name: Honokiol
Description: This molecule is a member of biphenyls.

Name: Pyridoxine
Description: This molecule is a hydroxymethylpyridine with hydroxymethyl groups at positions 4 and 5, a hydroxy group at position 3 and a methyl group at position 2. The 4-methanol form of vitamin B6, it is converted intoto pyridoxal phosphate which is a coenzyme for synthesis of amino acids, neurotransmitters, sphingolipids and aminolevulinic acid. It has a role as a cofactor, a human metabolite, a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite, an Escherichia coli metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a monohydroxypyridine, a vitamin B6, a member of methylpyridines and a hydroxymethylpyridine.

Name: 1-(4-Methoxyphenyl)-2-propanone
Description: This molecule is an alkylbenzene.

Name: 3-(4-Methoxyphenyl)-2-propenal
Description: This molecule is a member of cinnamaldehydes.

Name: Shikimic acid
Description: This molecule is a cyclohexenecarboxylic acid that is cyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxylic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 4 and 5 (the 3R,4S,5R stereoisomer). It is an intermediate metabolite in plants and microorganisms. It has a role as an Escherichia coli metabolite, a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is a cyclohexenecarboxylic acid, a hydroxy monocarboxylic acid and an alpha,beta-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a shikimate.

Name: Dipentene
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with an odor of lemon. Flash point 113 °F. Density about 7.2 lb /gal and insoluble in water. Hence floats on water. Vapors heavier than air. Used as a solvent for rosin, waxes, rubber; as a dispersing agent for oils, resins, paints, lacquers, varnishes, and in floor waxes and furniture polishes.

Name: Trans-5-O-caffeoyl-D-quinic acid
Description: This molecule is a cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-caffeic acid with the 5-hydroxy group of quinic acid. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a cyclitol carboxylic acid and a cinnamate ester. It is functionally related to a (-)-quinic acid and a trans-caffeic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a trans-5-O-caffeoyl-D-quinate.

Name: 3,3-Dimethyl allyl-p-propenyl phenyl ether
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ether.

Name: Veratramine
Description: This molecule is a piperidine alkaloid comprising the 14,15,16,17-tetradehydro derivative of veratraman having two hydroxy groups at the 3- and 23-positions. It derives from a hydride of a veratraman.

Name: (+/-)-threo-Anethole glycol
Description: This molecule is an alkylbenzene.

Name: Veranisatin A
Description: This molecule is a terpene lactone.

Name: Pyrimidin-2-ol
Description: This molecule is the hydroxypyrimidine that is pyrimidine mono-substituted at C-2 by a hydroxy group. It has a role as a Lewis base and an electron donor.

Name: Bjerkanderol A
Description: This molecule is an alkylbenzene.

Name: 3-O-feruloyl-D-quinic acid
Description: This molecule is a quinic acid that is the 3-O-feruloyl derivative of D-quinic acid. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a quinic acid and an enoate ester. It is functionally related to a (-)-quinic acid and a trans-ferulic acid.

Name: Carotol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: 4-methoxybenzoate
Description: This molecule is a methoxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of 4-methoxybenzoic acid. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a benzoate. It is a conjugate base of a 4-methoxybenzoic acid.

Name: Cis-beta-farnesene
Description: This molecule is a beta-farnesene.

Name: P-methoxybenzaldehyde
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of benzaldehydes consisting of benzaldehyde itself carrying a methoxy substituent at position 4. It has a role as an insect repellent, a human urinary metabolite, a plant metabolite and a bacterial metabolite.

Name: (3S,6Z)-nerolidol
Description: This molecule is a (6Z)-nerolidol in which the hydroxy group at positon 3 adopts an S-configuration. It is an enantiomer of a (3R,6Z)-nerolidol.

Name: Veranisatin B
Description: This molecule is a terpene lactone.

Name: Alpha-bergamotene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene consisting of a bicyclo[3.1.1]hept-2-ene skeleton substituted at positions 2 and 6 by methyl groups and at position 6 by a 4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl group. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a volatile oil component. It is a bridged compound, a sesquiterpene and a polycyclic olefin.

Name: Beta-Costic acid
Description: This molecule is a eudesmane sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Blestriarene B
Description: This molecule is a phenanthrol.

Name: 3,4',5,7-Tetrahydroxy-6-methoxyflavone
Description: This molecule is a hydroxyflavan.

Name: Gastrodin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Lanyuamide III
Description: This molecule is a carboximidic acid.

Name: Tambulin 3,5-diacetate
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: Beta-eudesmol
Description: This molecule is a carbobicyclic compound that is trans-decalin substituted at positions 2, 4a, and 8 by 2-hydroxypropan-2-yl, methyl and methylidene groups, respectively (the 2R,4aR,8aS-diastereoisomer). It has a role as a volatile oil component. It is a carbobicyclic compound, a tertiary alcohol and a eudesmane sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Atractylodin
Description: This molecule is a member of furans.

Name: Litcubine
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: N-Methylflindersine
Description: This molecule is an oxacycle, an organic heterotricyclic compound and an organonitrogen heterocyclic compound.

Name: Amurensine
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: Cneorin-NP36
Description: This molecule is a tirucallane terpenoid isolated from Dysoxylum lenticellatum. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an epoxide, a cyclic terpene ketone and a tirucallane triterpenoid.

Name: Coniferol
Description: This molecule is a phenylpropanoid that is one of the main monolignols, produced by the reduction of the carboxy functional group in cinnamic acid and the addition of a hydroxy and a methoxy substituent to the aromatic ring. It has a role as a monolignol, a mouse metabolite, a pheromone, an animal metabolite, a plant metabolite and a volatile oil component. It is a phenylpropanoid and a member of guaiacols. It is functionally related to an (E)-cinnamyl alcohol.

Name: Sophoradin
Description: This molecule is a member of chalcones.

Name: Aldehydo-D-galacturonic acid
Description: This molecule is a D-galacturonic acid. It is a conjugate acid of an aldehydo-D-galacturonate.

Name: Amurensin
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glycoside.

Name: Phellamurin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of dihydroflavonols that is (+)-dihydrokaempferol substituted by a prenyl group at position 8 and a beta-D-glucopyranosyl group at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. Isolated from Phellodendron amurense and Commiphora africana, it exhibits inhibition of intestinal P-glycoprotein. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a member of dihydroflavonols, a flavanone glycoside, a trihydroxyflavanone, a monosaccharide derivative, a beta-D-glucoside and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones. It is functionally related to a (+)-dihydrokaempferol.

Name: (S)-canadine
Description: This molecule is the (S)-enantiomer of canadine. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an an (S)-7,8,13,14-tetrahydroprotoberberine and a canadine. It is functionally related to a (S)-nandinine. It is an enantiomer of a (R)-canadine.

Name: Alpha-D-Glcp-(1->2)-D-Glcp
Description: This molecule is a glycosylglucose in which an alpha-D-glucopyranose residue is linked to a D-glucopyranose residue by a (1->2) glycosidic bond.

Name: Dihydrobaicalein
Description: This molecule is a member of flavanones.

Name: Dihydroniloticin
Description: This molecule is an epoxide, a tetracyclic triterpenoid and an organic heterohexacyclic compound.

Name: Viscidulin B
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: Cimicifugoside
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Cimigenol
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid. It derives from a hydride of a cycloartane.

Name: Visnagin
Description: This molecule is a furanochromone that is furo[3,2-g]chromen-5-one which is substituted at positions 4 and 7 by methoxy and methyl groups, respectively. Found in the toothpick-plant, Ammi visnaga. It has a role as a phytotoxin, an EC 1.1.1.37 (malate dehydrogenase) inhibitor, a vasodilator agent, an antihypertensive agent, an anti-inflammatory agent and a plant metabolite. It is a furanochromone, an aromatic ether and a polyketide. It is functionally related to a 5H-furo[3,2-g]chromen-5-one.

Name: Isocitric acid
Description: This molecule is a tricarboxylic acid that is propan-1-ol with a hydrogen at each of the 3 carbon positions replaced by a carboxy group. It has a role as a fundamental metabolite. It is a tricarboxylic acid and a secondary alcohol. It is a conjugate acid of an isocitrate(1-).

Name: Terephthalic acid
Description: This molecule is a white powder. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Saikosaponin A
Description: This molecule is a saikosaponin.

Name: Scoparone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of coumarins that is esculetin in which the two hydroxy groups at positions 6 and 7 are replaced by methoxy groups. It is a major constituent of the Chinese herbal medicine Yin Chen Hao, and exhibits a variety of pharmacological activities such as anti-inflammatory, anti-allergic, and anti-tumor activities. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an anti-inflammatory agent, an antilipemic drug, an immunosuppressive agent, an antihypertensive agent and an anti-allergic agent. It is a member of coumarins and an aromatic ether. It is functionally related to an esculetin.

Name: Soyasaponin I
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin that is composed of soyasapogenol B having an alpha-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-galactopyranosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucopyranosiduronic acid moiety attached at the 3-position via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a sialyltransferase inhibitor. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid, a triterpenoid saponin, a trisaccharide derivative and a carbohydrate acid derivative. It is functionally related to a soyasapogenol B. It is a conjugate acid of a soyasaponin I(1-).

Name: Wyerone acid
Description: This molecule is a heterocyclic fatty acid.

Name: Gamma-hydroxy-L-arginine
Description: This molecule is a gamma-hydroxyarginine, a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid and a hydroxy-L-arginine.

Name: Soyasaponin A1
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Swerchirin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of xanthones that is the 5-O-methyl derivative of bellidifolin. Isolated from Centaurium erythraea and Swertia chirayita, it exhibits hypoglycemic activity. It has a role as a hypoglycemic agent and a metabolite. It is a member of xanthones, an aromatic ether and a member of phenols. It is functionally related to a bellidifolin.

Name: Swertiamarin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Isogentisin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 3 and a methoxy group at position 7. It has a role as an EC 1.4.3.4 (monoamine oxidase) inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a member of xanthones, a polyphenol and an aromatic ether.

Name: Swertianin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 8 and a methoxy group at position 6. It has been isolated from various species of the genus Swertia and has been found to exhibit antioxidant activities. It has a role as an antioxidant and a plant metabolite. It is a member of xanthones, a polyphenol and an aromatic ether.

Name: Sideritiflavone
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: 7-hydroxy-8-methoxy-3-(4-methoxyphenyl)-1-benzopyran-4-one
Description: This molecule is a member of 4'-methoxyisoflavones.

Name: 2,6-Nonamethylene pyridine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyridines.

Name: Rubiadin
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyanthraquinone that is anthracene-9,10-dione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 3 and a methyl group at position 2. It has been isolated from Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as an antibacterial agent, an antioxidant, a hepatoprotective agent and a plant metabolite.

Name: Calaxin
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: L-tryptophan
Description: This molecule is a white powder with a flat taste. An essential amino acid; occurs in isomeric forms. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Sphingosine
Description: This molecule is a sphing-4-enine in which the double bond is trans. It has a role as a human metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a conjugate base of a sphingosine(1+). It is an enantiomer of a L-erythro-sphingosine.

Name: 3,4-diaminotoluene
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless to brownish purple crystalline solid. Toxic by ingestion and inhalation and an irritant to skin and eyes. Soluble in water, alcohol and ether. Decomposes to emit toxic oxides of nitrogen when heated to high temperature. Used in making dyes.

Name: (R)-naringenin
Description: This molecule is the (R)-enantiomer of naringenin. It is an enantiomer of a (S)-naringenin.

Name: Patchouli alcohol
Description: This molecule is a carbotricyclic compound and sesquiterpenoid tertiary alcohol that is tricyclo[5.3.1.0(3,8)]undecan-3-ol which is substituted at positions 2, 2, 6 and 8 by methyl groups (the 1R,3R,6S,7S,8S-diastereoisomer). It is a tertiary alcohol, a sesquiterpenoid and a carbotricyclic compound.

Name: (-)-Aristolene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid. It derives from a hydride of an aristolane.

Name: 9-hydroxy-8,8-dimethyl-9,10-dihydropyrano[2,3-h][1]benzopyran-2-one
Description: This molecule is a member of coumarins.

Name: Valeranone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Eudesobovatol A
Description: This molecule is a eudesmane sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Sodium orotate
Description: This molecule is an organic sodium salt comprising equal numbers of sodium and orotate ions. It has a role as a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite, a human metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It contains an orotate.

Name: controversial variable preparation containing CALCIUM GLUCONATE and either dimethylglycine or diisopropylamine so the literature
Description: This molecule is divided among these; was MH 1975-97 (see under VITAMIN B COMPLEX 1975-90); use PANGAMIC ACID (NM) to search PANGAMIC ACID 1975-97; has been called vitamin B15

Name: 7,8-Dihydro-3-methylpyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrimidin-2(6H)-one
Description: This molecule is a pyrrolopyrimidine.

Name: Hexyl formate
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester.

Name: Isomultiflorenyl acetate
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester.

Name: Corynoxeine
Description: This molecule is a member of indoles.

Name: 3-O-Methyluralenol
Description: This molecule is a member of flavones.

Name: Uralenneoside
Description: This molecule is a 4-hydroxybenzoate ester.

Name: Licoricesaponin B2
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: (E)-2,4,4'-Trihydroxychalcone
Description: This molecule is a member of chalcones.

Name: 7-Methoxy-8-(3-prop-1-en-2-yloxiran-2-yl)chromen-2-one
Description: This molecule is a member of coumarins.

Name: (-)-phaseollinisoflavan
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of hydroxyisoflavans that is (3R)-3,4-dihydro-2H,2'H-3,6'-bichromene substituted by two methyl groups at positions 2' and 2' and hydroxy groups at positions 5' and 7 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: Gancaonin X
Description: This molecule is an ether and a member of flavonoids.

Name: Trimethylpyrazine
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine in which three hydrogens at positions 2, 3 and 5 have been replaced by methyl groups. It has a role as a plant metabolite, a flavouring agent, a bacterial metabolite, an animal metabolite and a pheromone.

Name: Tetrahydroharmine
Description: This molecule is a harmala alkaloid.

Name: Trans-ferulate
Description: This molecule is a monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group of ferulic acid. It is a conjugate base of a trans-ferulic acid.

Name: LSM-6418
Description: This molecule is a yohimban alkaloid.

Name: Stigmasta-7,22E,25-trien-3beta-ol
Description: This molecule is a steroid. It derives from a hydride of a stigmastane.

Name: 2,5-Dimethylpyrazine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrazines.

Name: Formononetin 7-O-apiosyl-(1->2)-glucoside
Description: This molecule is an acrovestone and an isoflavonoid.

Name: L-pinitol
Description: This molecule is the L-enantiomer of pinitol. It is functionally related to a 1L-chiro-inositol. It is an enantiomer of a D-pinitol.

Name: 3'-O-Methylgancaonin P
Description: This molecule is a member of flavones.

Name: Licoricesaponin D3
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: (+)-Neomatatabiol
Description: This molecule is an iridoid monoterpenoid.

Name: Methylpyrazine
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a methyl group. It is a flavouring agent found in coffee, peanuts and red peppers. It has a role as a flavouring agent, a plant metabolite and a Maillard reaction product.

Name: Trans-sinapate
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of cinnamates that is the conjugate base of trans-sinapic acid. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a conjugate base of a trans-sinapic acid.

Name: Licoricesaponin E2
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: 5,6,7,8-Tetrahydro-2,4-dimethylquinoline
Description: This molecule is a member of quinolines.

Name: Akuammigine
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C21H24N2O3, isolated from Vinca sardoa and Uncaria rhynchophylla. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a monoterpenoid indole alkaloid, a methyl ester and an organic heteropentacyclic compound.

Name: Ent-Gloeosteretriol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Poriferast-7-en-3beta-ol
Description: This molecule is a steroid. It derives from a hydride of a stigmastane.

Name: 2-ethyl-5-methylpyrazine
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine with an ethyl group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 5 or vice versa. Found in tea, soybean paste, chocolate and sesame seed oil. It has a role as a flavouring agent and a Maillard reaction product. It is a member of pyrazines and a volatile organic compound.

Name: 2,6-Dimethylpyrazine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrazines.

Name: Glyurallin A
Description: This molecule is a member of pterocarpans.

Name: Kanzonol L
Description: This molecule is a member of isoflavanones.

Name: Licoricesaponin F3
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Isoorientin(1-)
Description: This molecule is a flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of isoorientin, arising from selective deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of an isoorientin.

Name: Methylglyoxal
Description: This molecule is a clear yellow slightly viscous liquid with a pungent odor. Yellowish-green vapors. Faintly acidic to litmus. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Licoisoflavone A
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone substituted by additional hydroxy groups at positions 5, 2' and 4' and a prenyl group at position 3'. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Cucurbitadienol
Description: This molecule is a tetracyclic triterpenoid that is 4,9-cyclo-9,10-secocholesta-5,24-diene substituted by methyl groups at the 9beta, 10, and 14 positions, and by a hydroxy group at position 1. It derives from a hydride of a cucurbitane.

Name: Keto-D-fructose
Description: This molecule is the open-chain form of D-fructose. It is a keto-fructose and a D-fructose. It is an enantiomer of a keto-L-fructose.

Name: Licoricesaponin g2
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Licofuranocoumarin
Description: This molecule is an organic hydroxy compound and an isoflavonoid.

Name: Liensinine
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: 1,3,6-trihydroxy-2-methyl-9,10-anthraquinone
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyanthraquinone that is 9,10-anthraquinone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 6 and a methyl group at position 2. It has been isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: Kanzonol K
Description: This molecule is a member of isoflavanones.

Name: Yunaconitine
Description: This molecule is a diterpene alkaloid with formula C35H49NO11 that is isolated from several Aconitum species. It has a role as a plant metabolite, a phytotoxin, an antifeedant, a human urinary metabolite and a xenobiotic. It is an acetate ester, an aromatic ether, a benzoate ester, a bridged compound, a diterpene alkaloid, an organic heteropolycyclic compound, a polyether, a tertiary amino compound, a secondary alcohol and a tertiary alcohol. It derives from a hydride of an aconitane.

Name: (E)-cinnamaldehyde
Description: This molecule is the E (trans) stereoisomer of cinnamaldehyde, the parent of the class of cinnamaldehydes. It has a role as a hypoglycemic agent, an EC 4.3.1.24 (phenylalanine ammonia-lyase) inhibitor, a vasodilator agent, an antifungal agent, a flavouring agent, a plant metabolite and a sensitiser. It is a 3-phenylprop-2-enal and a member of cinnamaldehydes.

Name: (+)-ar-Turmerone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Docosanoic acid
Description: This molecule is a straight-chain, C22, long-chain saturated fatty acid. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a straight-chain saturated fatty acid and a long-chain fatty acid. It is a conjugate acid of a behenate.

Name: Cholesteryl palmitate
Description: This molecule is a cholesterol ester obtained by the formal condensation of cholesterol with palmitic acid. It has a role as a human metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is functionally related to a hexadecanoic acid.

Name: Isovaleraldehyde
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid with a weak suffocating odor. Floats on water. Produces an irritating vapor. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Cordycepin
Description: This molecule is a 3'-deoxyribonucleoside and a member of adenosines. It has a role as an antimetabolite and a nucleoside antibiotic.

Name: Coryneine
Description: This molecule is a catecholamine.

Name: 3-(1H-Indol-3-yl)-2-(trimethylazaniumyl)propanoate
Description: This molecule is an alpha-amino acid.

Name: Sedoheptulose
Description: This molecule is a ketoheptose.

Name: Guanine
Description: This molecule is a 2-aminopurine carrying a 6-oxo substituent. It has a role as a human metabolite, an algal metabolite, a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite, an Escherichia coli metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a purine nucleobase, an oxopurine and a member of 2-aminopurines. It derives from a hydride of a 9H-purine.

Name: Thiamine(1+)
Description: This molecule is a primary alcohol that is 1,3-thiazol-3-ium substituted by (4-amino-2-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl, methyl and 2-hydroxyethyl groups at positions 3, 4 and 5, respectively. It has a role as a human metabolite, a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite, an Escherichia coli metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a primary alcohol and a vitamin B1. It is a conjugate base of a thiamine(2+).

Name: (11Z)-icos-11-enoic acid
Description: This molecule is an icosenoic acid having a cis- double bond at position 11. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a human metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a gondoate.

Name: M-aminophenol
Description: This molecule appears as white crystals or off-white flakes. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Beta-D-galactose
Description: This molecule is a D-galactopyranose having beta configuration at the anomeric centre. It has a role as an epitope and a mouse metabolite. It is an enantiomer of a beta-L-galactose.

Name: Guanosine
Description: This molecule is a purine nucleoside in which guanine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond. It has a role as a fundamental metabolite. It is a purines D-ribonucleoside and a member of guanosines. It is functionally related to a guanine.

Name: Galactomannan
Description: This molecule is a heteroglycan consisting of a mannan backbone with galactose side groups.

Name: Valeraldehyde
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid. Slightly soluble in water and less dense than water. Flash point 54 °F. Vapors heavier than air. Used to make artificial flavorings and rubber.

Name: Isobutyl aldehyde
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a pungent odor. Flash point of -40 °F. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Hence floats on water. Vapors are heavier than air. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Inosine
Description: This molecule is a purine nucleoside in which hypoxanthine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond. It has a role as a human metabolite, a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite, an Escherichia coli metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a purines D-ribonucleoside and a member of inosines. It is functionally related to a hypoxanthine and a ribofuranose.

Name: 2-methylbutanal
Description: This molecule is a methylbutanal in which the methyl substituent is at position 2. It has a role as a volatile oil component, a plant metabolite and a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite. It is a 2-methyl-branched fatty aldehyde and a methylbutanal.

Name: Cinnamyl alcohol
Description: This molecule is a primary alcohol comprising an allyl core with a hydroxy substituent at the 1-position and a phenyl substituent at the 3-position (geometry of the C=C bond unspecified). It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: 2-pentylfuran
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a pentyl group. It is found in many heat-processed foods and drinks. It has a role as an Aspergillus metabolite, a human urinary metabolite, a volatile oil component, an insect repellent, a flavouring agent, a plant growth stimulator and a bacterial metabolite.

Name: 2-Butanone
Description: This molecule is a manufactured chemical but it is also present in the environment from natural sources. It is a colorless liquid with a sharp, sweet odor. It is also known as methyl ethyl ketone (MEK). This molecule is produced in large quantities. Nearly half of its use is in paints and other coatings because it will quickly evaporate into the air and it dissolves many substances. It is also used in glues and as a cleaning agent. This molecule occurs as a natural product. It is made by some trees and found in some fruits and vegetables in small amounts. It is also released to the air from car and truck exhausts.

Name: (E)-hept-2-enal
Description: This molecule is a monounsaturated fatty aldehyde that is (2E)-hept-2-ene which is carrying an oxo group at position 1. Found in the peel of Malaysian pink and white pomelo peel and in the scent gland secretion of the rice stink bug Oebalus pugnax. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a uremic toxin. It is an enal, a monounsaturated fatty aldehyde and a medium-chain fatty aldehyde.

Name: (+)-isoborneol
Description: This molecule is a borneol.

Name: Borneol
Description: This molecule appears as a white colored lump-solid with a sharp camphor-like odor. Burns readily. Slightly denser than water and insoluble in water. Used to make perfumes.

Name: Dipterocarpol
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid. It contains a dammarane.

Name: Borneol
Description: This molecule appears as a white colored lump-solid with a sharp camphor-like odor. Burns readily. Slightly denser than water and insoluble in water. Used to make perfumes.

Name: (+)-bornyl acetate
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid and an acetate ester. It is functionally related to a (+)-borneol.

Name: Asiatic acid
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid that is ursane substituted by a carboxy group at position 28 and hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3 and 23 (the 2alpha,3beta stereoisomer). It is isolated from Symplocos lancifolia and Vateria indica and exhibits anti-angiogenic activity. It has a role as an angiogenesis modulating agent and a metabolite. It is a monocarboxylic acid, a triol and a pentacyclic triterpenoid. It derives from a hydride of an ursane.

Name: Isouvaretin
Description: This molecule is a diarylheptanoid.

Name: Obtusifolin 2-glucoside
Description: This molecule is an anthraquinone.

Name: Rotundifuran
Description: This molecule is a labdane diterpenoid that is isolated from the fruits of Vitex rotundifolia. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an apoptosis inducer and an antineoplastic agent. It is a labdane diterpenoid, an acetate ester, a member of furans, a tertiary alcohol and a carbobicyclic compound.

Name: Physcion 8-gentiobioside
Description: This molecule is a disaccharide derivative, a monohydroxyanthraquinone and a gentiobioside. It is functionally related to a physcion.

Name: Chrysophanol 8-O-beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a beta-D-glucoside in which the aglycone species is chrysophanol, the glycosidic linkage being to the hydroxy group at C-8. It is a beta-D-glucoside and a monohydroxyanthraquinone. It is functionally related to a chrysophanol.

Name: 8-methyl Nonanoic acid
Description: This molecule is a medium-chain fatty acid.

Name: Rotundone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Cassyfiline
Description: This molecule is an aporphine alkaloid.

Name: Emodin 8-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyanthraquinone.

Name: Toralactone
Description: This molecule is an organic heterotricyclic compound that is 9,10-dihydroxy-1H-benzo[g]isochromen-1-one substituted at positions 3 and 7 by methyl and methoxy groups respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an organic heterotricyclic compound, a lactone, a member of phenols, an aromatic ether, a polyketide and a naphtho-alpha-pyrone. It is functionally related to a nor-toralactone.

Name: Obtusin
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyanthraquinone.

Name: Vitetrifolin D
Description: This molecule is a labdane diterpenoid that is isolated from the fruits of Vitex trifolia L and Vitex negundo. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an antineoplastic agent and an apoptosis inducer. It is a labdane diterpenoid, an acetate ester, a tertiary alcohol, a carbobicyclic compound and an olefinic compound.

Name: Aspidinol
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester. It is functionally related to a phloroglucinol.

Name: Purpurin
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyanthraquinone derived from anthracene by substitution with oxo groups at C-9 and C-10 and with hydroxy groups at C-1, C-2 and C-4. It has a role as a biological pigment, a histological dye and a plant metabolite.

Name: Aurantio-obtusin
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyanthraquinone that is 1,3,7-trihydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone which is by methoxy groups at positions 2 and 8, and by a methyl group at position 6.

Name: Chryso-obtusin
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxyanthraquinone.

Name: Ochrolifuanine A
Description: This molecule is a harmala alkaloid.

Name: Cassiaside C
Description: This molecule is a benzochromenone and a glycoside.

Name: Vitexin-7-olate
Description: This molecule is conjugate base of vitexin arising from deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a vitexin.

Name: Quinizarin
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyanthraquinone having the two hydroxy substituents at the 1- and 4-positions; formally derived from anthraquinone by replacement of two hydrogen atoms by hydroxy groups It has a role as a dye.

Name: Norsanguinarine
Description: This molecule is a member of phenanthridines.

Name: Verticine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Phenylacetate
Description: This molecule is a monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of phenylacetic acid. It has a role as a human metabolite, an Escherichia coli metabolite, a plant metabolite and a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite. It is functionally related to an acetate. It is a conjugate base of a phenylacetic acid.

Name: Obtusifolin
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyanthraquinone.

Name: Torachrysone
Description: This molecule is a member of naphthols.

Name: Cassiaside
Description: This molecule is a glycoside and a benzochromenone.

Name: Torachrysone 8-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: M-cresol
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid with a sweet tarry odor. Sinks and mixes slowly with water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Nor-toralactone
Description: This molecule is a naphtho-gamma-pyrone that is 1H-benzo[g]isochromen-1-one substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and hydroxy groups at positions 7, 9 and 10. It has a role as a fungal metabolite. It is a heptaketide, a member of phenols, a lactone and a naphtho-alpha-pyrone.

Name: Emodin
Description: This molecule appears as orange needles or powder. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Gamma-tocopherol
Description: This molecule is a tocopherol in which the chroman-6-ol core is substituted by methyl groups at positions 7 and 8. It is found particularly in maize (corn) oil and soya bean (soybean) oils. It has a role as a plant metabolite, a food antioxidant and an algal metabolite. It is a vitamin E and a tocopherol.

Name: Oleic acid methyl ester
Description: This molecule is a clear to amber liquid. Insoluble in water. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Peucedanin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of furanocoumarins that is furo[3,2-g]chromen-7-one, bearing additional isopropyl and methoxy substituents at positions 2 and 3 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a furanocoumarin, an aromatic ether and a lactone.

Name: Pfaffic acid
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Maslinic acid
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 and a carboxy group at position 28 (the 2alpha,3beta stereoisomer). It is isolated from Olea europaea and Salvia canariensis and exhibits anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and antineoplastic activity. It has a role as an antioxidant, an antineoplastic agent, an anti-inflammatory agent and a plant metabolite. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid. It derives from a hydride of an oleanane.

Name: 3-amino-2-oxopropyl phosphate
Description: This molecule is a oxoalkyl phosphate having 3-amino-2-oxopropyl as the oxoalkyl group. It is a conjugate acid of a 3-ammonio-2-oxopropyl phosphate(1-).

Name: Capsanthin
Description: This molecule is a carotenone. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: Arjunolic acid
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-en-28-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3 and 23 (the 2alpha,3beta stereoisomer). Isolated from Symplocos lancifolia and Juglans sinensis, it exhibits antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. It has a role as a metabolite, an antibacterial agent, an antifungal agent and an antioxidant. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a hydroxy monocarboxylic acid. It derives from a hydride of an oleanane.

Name: 23-hydroxyursolic acid
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid that is ursolic acid substituted by an additional hydroxy group at position 23. It has been isolated from Lagerstroemia speciosa and Juglans sinensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid. It is functionally related to an ursolic acid. It derives from a hydride of an ursane.

Name: Flavylium
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of chromenyliums that is chromenylium with a phenyl substituent at position 2. It is functionally related to a chromenylium.

Name: (S)-(-)-citronellol
Description: This molecule is a citronellol that is oct-6-ene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1 and methyl groups at positions 3 and 7 (the 3S-enantiomer). It is an enantiomer of a (R)-(+)-citronellol.

Name: Beta-ionone
Description: This molecule is a colorless to light yellow liquid with an odor of cedar wood. In very dilute alcoholic solution the odor resembles odor of violets. Used in perfumery.

Name: Calceolarioside A
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Pseudopurpurin
Description: This molecule is a member of anthracenes.

Name: Alpha-methylbenzyl alcohol
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid. Insoluble in water and less dense than water. Contact may slightly irritate skin, eyes and mucous membranes. May be slightly toxic by ingestion, inhalation and skin absorption. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Alpha-cadinene
Description: This molecule is a cadinene sesquiterpene that consists of 1-(propan-2-yl)-1,2,4a,5,6,8a-hexahydronaphthalene having two methyl substituents at positions 1 and 4 (the 1S,4aS,8aS-configuration). It has a role as a volatile oil component. It is a cadinene and a member of hexahydronaphthalenes.

Name: 2-acetylfuran
Description: This molecule is a furan carrying an acetyl substituent at the 2-position. Used in the production of the antibiotic cefuroxime (CHEBI:3515). It is a member of furans, a methyl ketone and an aromatic ketone.

Name: 2-Phenyl-2-butenal
Description: This molecule is an olefinic compound.

Name: Pseudoionone
Description: This molecule is a terpene ketone derived from ring cleavage of the apo carotenoid beta-ionone. It has a role as a fragrance. It is functionally related to a beta-ionone.

Name: Safranal
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid formally derived from beta-cyclocitral by dehydrogenation. It is functionally related to a beta-cyclocitral.

Name: Hentriacontan-1-ol
Description: This molecule is a primary alcohol. It derives from a hydride of a hentriacontane.

Name: Decan-2-one
Description: This molecule is a methyl ketone that is decane in which the methylene hydrogens at position 2 are replaced by an oxo group. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It derives from a hydride of a decane.

Name: Tormentic acid
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: 2-hexen-1-ol
Description: This molecule is a primary allylic alcohol that is 2-hexene in which a hydrogen at position 1 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an alkenyl alcohol and a primary allylic alcohol.

Name: Sulcatone
Description: This molecule is a heptenone that is hept-5-en-2-one substituted by a methyl group at position 6. It is a volatile oil component of citronella oil, lemon-grass oil and palmarosa oil. It has a role as an alarm pheromone, a volatile oil component and a plant metabolite. It is a methyl ketone and a heptenone.

Name: Trans-benzylideneacetone
Description: This molecule is the trans-isomer of benzylideneacetone. It acts as an inhibitor of the enzyme phospholipase A2 (EC 3.1.1.4) of insects like diamond back moth. It has a role as a flavouring agent, a fragrance, a bacterial metabolite and an EC 3.1.1.4 (phospholipase A2) inhibitor.

Name: 2-Propylfuran
Description: This molecule is a heteroarene.

Name: 2,3-dihydrobenzofuran
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is the 2,3-dihydroderivative of benzofuran. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Isobutanol
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a sweet odor. Flash point 85 - 100 °F. Less dense than water. Vapors heavier than air.

Name: Isoamyl alcohol
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid with a mild, choking alcohol odor. Less dense than water, soluble in water. Hence floats on water. Produces an irritating vapor. (USCG, 1999)

Name: (-)-trans-carveol
Description: This molecule is a carveol. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is an enantiomer of a (+)-trans-carveol.

Name: O-cresol
Description: This molecule appears as colorless or yellow to brown-yellow or pinkish colored liquid with a phenol-like odor. Toxic by ingestion and/or skin absorption. May have a flash point between 100 and 199 °F. Causes burns to skin, eyes and mucous membranes. Insoluble in water.

Name: 2,6-nonadienal
Description: This molecule is a polyunsaturated fatty aldehyde.

Name: Hotrienol
Description: This molecule is a tertiary alcohol.

Name: Pyrrole-2-carboxaldehyde
Description: This molecule is a pyrrole carrying a formyl substituent at the 2-position. It is a member of pyrroles and a 1,3-thiazole-2-carbaldehyde.

Name: Alpha-Methyl-2-furanacrolein
Description: This molecule is a heteroarene.

Name: D,l-menthol
Description: This molecule is a white crystalline solid with a peppermint odor and taste. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Ethyl linolenate
Description: This molecule is a clear colorless liquid. (NTP, 1992)

Name: (E)-3-Octen-1-ol
Description: This molecule is an aliphatic alcohol.

Name: Pentadecanal
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty aldehyde that is pentadecane carrying an oxo substituent at position 1. It is a component of essential oils from plants like Solanum erianthum and Cassia siamea. It has a role as an antimicrobial agent, a volatile oil component and a plant metabolite. It is a long-chain fatty aldehyde and a 2,3-saturated fatty aldehyde.

Name: 2,5-Octadien-1-ol
Description: This molecule is an aliphatic alcohol.

Name: N-pentanol
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with a mild to moderately strong odor. Less dense than water. Flash point 91 °F. Boiling point 280 °F. Vapors heavier than air. Moderately toxic by ingestion. Vapors may irritate skin and eyes. Used as a solvent and to make other chemicals.

Name: (+)-cis-carveol
Description: This molecule is the (1S,5S)-stereoisomer of carveol. It is an enantiomer of a (-)-cis-carveol.

Name: (-)-cyperene
Description: This molecule is a sesuiterpene synthesized by sesquiterpene synthase from Artabotrys hexapetalus. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: Beta-damascenone
Description: This molecule is a cyclic monoterpene ketone that is 2,6,6-trimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene substituted at position 1 by a crotonoyl group.
