Name: Galangin
Description: This molecule is a 7-hydroxyflavonol with additional hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5 respectively; a growth inhibitor of breast tumor cells. It has a role as an antimicrobial agent, an EC 3.1.1.3 (triacylglycerol lipase) inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a trihydroxyflavone and a 7-hydroxyflavonol.

Name: (R)-N-methylcoclaurine
Description: This molecule is the (R)-enantiomer of N-methylcoclaurine. It is a conjugate base of a (R)-N-methylcoclaurinium. It is an enantiomer of a (S)-N-methylcoclaurine.

Name: Galanolactone
Description: This molecule is a gamma-lactone.

Name: 2-allylphenol
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of phenols that is phenol carrying an allyl group at position 2. It has a role as an antifungal agrochemical.

Name: Gamma-camphorene
Description: This molecule is a cycloalkene that is cyclohexene substituted by 2-methylpent-2-en-5-yl and 6-methylhepta-1,5-dien-2-yl groups at positions 1 and 5, respectively. It is a diterpene isolated from several plant species. It has a role as a volatile oil component. It is a diterpene and a cycloalkene.

Name: Histamine
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of imidazoles that is 1H-imidazole substituted at position C-4 by a 2-aminoethyl group. It has a role as a human metabolite, a mouse metabolite and a neurotransmitter. It is an aralkylamino compound and a member of imidazoles. It is a conjugate base of a histaminium.

Name: Portulacaxanthin I
Description: This molecule is a non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid.

Name: Indicaxanthin
Description: This molecule is a non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid.

Name: Portulal
Description: This molecule is an iridoid monoterpenoid.

Name: Isobetanin
Description: This molecule is a betalain and a glycoside. It is functionally related to a betanidin.

Name: Humilixanthin
Description: This molecule is a non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid.

Name: Poststerone
Description: This molecule is a 2beta-hydroxy steroid, a 3beta-hydroxy steroid, a 14alpha-hydroxy steroid, a 6-oxo steroid, a 20-oxo steroid and a phytoecdysteroid.

Name: Tlatlancuayin
Description: This molecule is a member of isoflavones.

Name: Macrocalin B
Description: This molecule is a member of dioxanes. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Strontium
Description: This molecule is a naturally occurring element found in rocks, soil, dust, coal, and oil. Naturally occurring strontium is not radioactive and is either referred to as stable strontium or strontium. This molecule in the environment exists in four stable isotopes,84Sr (read as strontium eighty-four),86Sr,87Sr,88Sr. This molecule compounds are used in making ceramics and glass products, pyrotechnics, paint pigments, fluorescent lights, and medicines. This molecule can also exist as several radioactive isotopes; the most common is90Sr.90Sr is formed in nuclear reactors or during the explosion of nuclear weapons. Radioactive strontium generates beta particles as it decays. One of the radioactive properties of strontium is half-life, or the time it takes for half of the isotope to give off its radiation and change into another substance. The half-life of90Sr is 29 years.

Name: Dihydrosamidin
Description: This molecule is a member of coumarins.

Name: S-Methylcysteine S-oxide
Description: This molecule is a L-alpha-amino acid.

Name: 3-(Methylthio)-1-propene
Description: This molecule is an organic sulfide.

Name: 1-Methyl-4-(prop-2-en-1-yl)tetrasulfane
Description: This molecule is an organosulfur compound.

Name: Diallyl trisulfide
Description: This molecule is an organic trisulfide that is trisulfane in which both of the hydrogens are replaced by allyl groups. A component of the essential oil of garlic and a major component of the traditional Chinese medicine allitridium, it exhibits antifungal, antitumour and antioxidant activity It has a role as an apoptosis inducer, an estrogen receptor antagonist, an antineoplastic agent, a vasodilator agent, an antioxidant, an anti-inflammatory agent, an insecticide, an antiprotozoal drug, a platelet aggregation inhibitor and an antilipemic drug.

Name: Diallyltetrasulfane
Description: This molecule is an organosulfur compound.

Name: Sulfur dioxide
Description: This molecule is a colorless gas with a pungent odor. It is a liquid when under pressure, and it dissolves in water very easily. This molecule in the air comes mainly from activities such as the burning of coal and oil at power plants or from copper smelting. In nature, sulfur dioxide can be released to the air from volcanic eruptions.

Name: Butyl propyl disulfide
Description: This molecule is an organic disulfide.

Name: Diallyl sulfide
Description: This molecule is an organic sulfide.

Name: Divostroside
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside.

Name: (20R)-protopanaxadiol
Description: This molecule is a diastereomer of protopanaxadiol in which the 20-hydroxy substituent has been introduced at the pro-R position.

Name: Diallyl disulfide
Description: This molecule is an organic disulfide where the organic group specified is allyl. It has been isolated from garlic and other species of the genus Allium. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, an antifungal agent and a plant metabolite.

Name: 2-isopropyl-1,3-dioxolane
Description: This molecule is a dioxolane that is 1,3-dioxolane substituted by an isopropyl group at position 2. It has a role as a metabolite. It derives from a hydride of a 1,3-dioxolane.

Name: Alliin
Description: This molecule is an L-alanine derivative in which one of the methyl hydrogens of L-alanine has been replaced by an (S)-allylsulfinyl group. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an antioxidant, a cardioprotective agent, a neuroprotective agent and an antimicrobial agent. It is a non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid, a L-cysteine derivative, a L-alanine derivative, a sulfoxide and an olefinic compound. It is a tautomer of an alliin zwitterion.

Name: L-2,4-diaminobutyric acid
Description: This molecule is a 2,4-diaminobutyric acid that has S-configuration. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a butyric acid. It is a conjugate base of a L-2,4-diazaniumylbutyrate. It is a conjugate acid of a L-2,4-diaminobutyrate. It is an enantiomer of a D-2,4-diaminobutyric acid.

Name: 1,2-dithiolane
Description: This molecule is a dithiolane.

Name: N-methylmescaline
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of methoxybenzenes that is benzene substituted by a 2-(methylamino)ethyl at position 1 and by methoxy groups at positions 3, 4 , and 5. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of methoxybenzenes, a secondary amino compound and a phenethylamine alkaloid. It is functionally related to a mescaline. It is a conjugate base of a N-methylmescalinium.

Name: 3,4-dimethylthiophene
Description: This molecule is a thiophene that is substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 4. It has a role as a flavouring agent, a plant metabolite and a human urinary metabolite.

Name: 1,3,5-trithiane
Description: This molecule is a trithiane.

Name: Ethylparaben
Description: This molecule is an ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid with ethanol, It has a role as an antimicrobial food preservative, an antifungal agent, a plant metabolite and a phytoestrogen. It is a paraben and an ethyl ester.

Name: Dimethyl trisulfide
Description: This molecule is an organic trisulfide.

Name: 2-Propene-1-thiol
Description: This molecule is an alkanethiol.

Name: Dimethyl disulfide
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless oily liquid with a garlic-like odor. Denser than water and slightly soluble in water. Vapors heavier than air. May irritate skin and eyes. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: 2,5-Dimethylthiophene
Description: This molecule is a member of thiophenes.

Name: Methyl 2-propenyl pentasulfide
Description: This molecule is an organosulfur compound.

Name: Cadmium
Description: This molecule is a natural element in the earth's crust. It is usually found as a mineral combined with other elements such as oxygen (cadmium oxide), chlorine (cadmium chloride), or sulfur (cadmium sulfate, cadmium sulfide). All soils and rocks, including coal and mineral fertilizers, contain some cadmium. Most cadmium used in the United States is extracted during the production of other metals like zinc, lead, and copper. This molecule does not corrode easily and has many uses, including batteries, pigments, metal coatings, and plastics.

Name: But-3-enoic acid
Description: This molecule is that isomer of butenoic acid having the double bond at position C-3. It is a conjugate acid of a but-3-enoate.

Name: Bissulfine
Description: This molecule is a sulfoxide.

Name: S-2-Propenyl methanesulfinothioate
Description: This molecule is a sulfur oxoacid derivative.

Name: Allixin
Description: This molecule is a pyranone.

Name: Pectin
Description: This molecule is any mixture of complex, colloidal, macromolecular plant galacturonans containing a large proportion of D-galactopyranosyluronic acid residues in alpha-(1->4) linkage, the carboxy groups of which may be esterified to varying degrees by methyl groups or be partially or completely converted into salts. The structure shown is that of the parent polygalacturonan. It has a role as an antidiarrhoeal drug, a food stabiliser, a food emulsifier, a food thickening agent, a food gelling agent, a plant metabolite and a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite. It is a mixture and a galacturonan. It is a conjugate acid of a pectate.

Name: S-Methyl mercapto-L-cysteine
Description: This molecule is a cysteine derivative.

Name: Allithiamine
Description: This molecule is an aminopyrimidine.

Name: (E)-Ajoene
Description: This molecule is a sulfoxide.

Name: Allicin
Description: This molecule is a sulfoxide and a botanical anti-fungal agent. It has a role as an antibacterial agent.

Name: Allyl methyl disulfide
Description: This molecule is an organic disulfide having allyl and methyl as the two organic groups. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a volatile oil component.

Name: 7-(Methylthio)heptanenitrile
Description: This molecule is a nitrile.

Name: 3-(Allylsulphinyl)-L-alanine
Description: This molecule is a L-alpha-amino acid.

Name: 1-heptadecene
Description: This molecule is an unbranched seventeen-carbon alkene with one double bond between C-1 and C-2. It is produced by the Carrion beetles. It has a role as an animal metabolite and a pheromone.

Name: Ingol
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: Alpha-himachalene
Description: This molecule is a himachalene.

Name: Taraxasterol acetate
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Aplotaxene
Description: This molecule is an alkatetraene.

Name: Zinc
Description: This molecule is one of the most common elements in the earth's crust. It is found in air, soil, and water, and is present in all foods. Pure zinc is a bluish-white shiny metal. This molecule has many commercial uses as coatings to prevent rust, in dry cell batteries, and mixed with other metals to make alloys like brass, and bronze. A zinc and copper alloy is used to make pennies in the United States. This molecule combines with other elements to form zinc compounds. Common zinc compounds found at hazardous waste sites include zinc chloride, zinc oxide, zinc sulfate, and zinc sulfide. This molecule compounds are widely used in industry to make paint, rubber, dyes, wood preservatives, and ointments.

Name: Rhamnetin-3-olate
Description: This molecule is major species at pH 7.3 It is a conjugate base of a rhamnetin.

Name: Methyl arachidate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester.

Name: Pilosin
Description: This molecule is a dimethoxyflavone that is flavone carrying hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, and 8, and methoxy groups at positions 4' and 6. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a trihydroxyflavone and a dimethoxyflavone. It is functionally related to a 2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydroxy-4H-1-benzopyran-4-one.

Name: (Z,Z)-1,8,11-Heptadecatriene
Description: This molecule is an alkatriene.

Name: Phthalate(2-)
Description: This molecule is a phthalate that is the dianion obtained by the deprotonation of both the carboxy groups of phthalic acid. It has a role as a human xenobiotic metabolite. It is a dicarboxylic acid dianion and a phthalate. It is a conjugate base of a phthalate(1-).

Name: N-phenyl-1-naphthylamine
Description: This molecule appears as white to slightly yellowish prisms or reddish brown crystalline powder. (NTP, 1992)

Name: 2-phenylpropan-2-ol
Description: This molecule is a tertiary alcohol that is isopropanol in which the hydrogen attached to the carbon bearing the hydroxy group has been replaced by a phenyl group. It has a role as a Mycoplasma genitalium metabolite and a human xenobiotic metabolite. It is a tertiary alcohol and a member of benzyl alcohols. It derives from a hydride of a cumene.

Name: Atractyligenin
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid isolated from coffee silverskin. It inhibits cutaneous photoaging. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a carbotetracyclic compound, a dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid, an ent-kaurane diterpenoid and a tetracyclic diterpenoid.

Name: Aldehydo-L-lyxose
Description: This molecule is an L-lyxose in open-chain aldehyde form. It is an enantiomer of an aldehydo-D-lyxose.

Name: Dicliripariside C
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glycoside.

Name: Spruceanol
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: Tributyl phosphate
Description: This molecule is an odorless colorless to yellow liquid. Toxic by ingestion and inhalation.

Name: Delphinidin-3-glucoside
Description: This molecule is an anthocyanidin glycoside.

Name: Soyasaponin A2
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Soyasapogenol B 3-O-beta-glucuronide
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin that is the 3-O-beta-glucuronide of soyasapogenol B. It is a beta-D-glucosiduronic acid and a triterpenoid saponin. It is functionally related to a soyasapogenol B. It is a conjugate acid of a soyasapogenol B 3-O-beta-glucuronate.

Name: Soyasaponin V
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Trans-aconitic acid
Description: This molecule is the trans-isomer of aconitic acid. It has a role as a fundamental metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a trans-aconitate(3-).

Name: Dihydrodaidzin
Description: This molecule is an acrovestone and an isoflavonoid.

Name: Aconitic acid
Description: This molecule is a tricarboxylic acid that is prop-1-ene substituted by carboxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 3. It is a conjugate acid of an aconitate(3-).

Name: Dihydrogenistin
Description: This molecule is a hydroxyisoflavanone that is dihydrogenistein in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 7 has been replaced by a beta-D-glucosyl residue. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a beta-D-glucoside, a hydroxyisoflavanone and a monosaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to a dihydrogenistein.

Name: Glycitin
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by a methoxy group at position 6, a hydroxy group at position 4' and a beta-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 7. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a methoxyisoflavone, a hydroxyisoflavone, a monosaccharide derivative and a 7-hydroxyisoflavones 7-O-beta-D-glucoside.

Name: Gentisin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 7 and a methoxy group at position 3. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of xanthones, a polyphenol and an aromatic ether.

Name: Arctiin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside and a lignan.

Name: Glomeratose A
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Hellebrigenin 3-acetate
Description: This molecule is a steroid lactone. It is functionally related to a bufanolide.

Name: Lancerin
Description: This molecule is a C-glycosyl compound that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3, and 7 and a 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol moiety at position 1. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of xanthones, a C-glycosyl compound and a polyphenol.

Name: Leptosin
Description: This molecule is a member of aurones and a glycoside.

Name: Lanceolin
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glycoside.

Name: 4-Ethyl-2-methylphenol
Description: This molecule is a hydroxytoluene.

Name: 1,2,3-trimethoxybenzene
Description: This molecule is a methoxybenzene that is benzene substituted by methoxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 3 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: 2-Methoxynaphthalene
Description: This molecule is a member of naphthalenes.

Name: Hexadecanoate
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of hexadecanoic acid (palmitic acid); major species at pH 7.3. It has a role as a human metabolite and a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite. It is a long-chain fatty acid anion, a fatty acid anion 16:0, a 2-saturated fatty acid anion and an omega-methyl fatty acid anion. It is a conjugate base of a hexadecanoic acid.

Name: Guvacoline
Description: This molecule is the methyl ester of guvacine. It has a role as a muscarinic agonist and a plant metabolite. It is a beta-amino acid ester, a methyl ester, an enoate ester, a tetrahydropyridine, a secondary amino compound, an alpha,beta-unsaturated carboxylic ester and a pyridine alkaloid. It is functionally related to a guvacine.

Name: 2,5-dimethylphenol
Description: This molecule is a colorless to off-white crystalline solid. Odor threshold concentration 0.4 mg/L. Taste threshold concentration 0.5 mg/L. (NTP, 1992)

Name: 5-Hydroxyoxindole
Description: This molecule is a member of indoles.

Name: Norbornene
Description: This molecule is a bridged compound that is cyclohexane with a methylene bridge between carbons 1 and 4 and a double bond at position 2. It is a bridged compound, a carbobicyclic compound and a cyclic olefin.

Name: Indigo dye
Description: This molecule is a member of hydroxyindoles.

Name: Neoglucobrassicin
Description: This molecule is an indolyl carbohydrate that is glucobrassicin methoxy substituted at position 1 of the indole moiety. It is an indolyl carbohydrate and an indolylmethylglucosinolic acid. It is functionally related to a glucobrassicin. It is a conjugate acid of a neoglucobrassicin(1-).

Name: TR-Saponin A
Description: This molecule is an organic molecular entity.

Name: Sulfoglucobrassicin
Description: This molecule is an indolylmethylglucosinolic acid that is glucobrassicin bearing an additional sulfo group on the indole nitrogen. It is an indolyl carbohydrate and an indolylmethylglucosinolic acid. It is functionally related to a glucobrassicin. It is a conjugate acid of a sulfoglucobrassicin(1-).

Name: Glycyrol
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of coumestans that is coumestan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 9, a methoxy group at position 3 and a prenyl group at position 2 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a member of coumestans, a polyphenol, a delta-lactone and an aromatic ether. It is functionally related to a coumestan.

Name: Tryptanthrine
Description: This molecule is an organonitrogen heterocyclic compound, an organic heterotetracyclic compound and an alkaloid antibiotic.

Name: Anthranilic acid
Description: This molecule appears as odorless white to pale-yellow or tan crystalline powder with a sweetish taste. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Isatidine
Description: This molecule is a citraconoyl group.

Name: 5-oxoproline
Description: This molecule is an oxoproline having the oxo group placed at the 5-position. It is an intermediate metabolite in the glutathione cycle. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is a pyrrolidinemonocarboxylic acid, a member of pyrrolidin-2-ones and an oxoproline. It is a conjugate acid of a 5-oxoprolinate.

Name: Trp-Val
Description: This molecule is a dipeptide formed from L-tryptophan and L-valine residues. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Indoxyl
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3. It is a member of hydroxyindoles and a heteroaryl hydroxy compound.

Name: Uncinatone
Description: This molecule is a member of phenanthrenes.

Name: Glucobrassicin
Description: This molecule is an indolylmethylglucosinolic acid that is 1-thio-beta-D-glucopyranose having a 2-(1H-indol-3-yl)-N-(sulfooxy)ethanimidoyl group attached to the anomeric sulfur. It is an indolylmethylglucosinolic acid and an indolyl carbohydrate. It is a conjugate acid of a glucobrassicin(1-).

Name: 1H-Quinazoline-2,4-dione
Description: This molecule is a member of quinazolines.

Name: Potassium chloride
Description: This molecule appears as white colorless cubic crystals. Strong saline taste. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Sodium chloride
Description: This molecule is an inorganic chloride salt having sodium(1+) as the counterion. It has a role as an emetic, a flame retardant and a NMR chemical shift reference compound. It is an inorganic chloride and an inorganic sodium salt.

Name: Magnesium sulfate
Description: This molecule is a magnesium salt having sulfate as the counterion. It has a role as an anticonvulsant, a cardiovascular drug, a calcium channel blocker, an anaesthetic, a tocolytic agent, an anti-arrhythmia drug, an analgesic and a fertilizer. It is a magnesium salt, a metal sulfate and an organic magnesium salt.

Name: Calcium sulfate
Description: This molecule appears as odorless, white powder or colorless, crystalline solid. Crystals sometimes have a blue, gray or reddish tinge or can be brick red. Density: 2.96 g cm-3.

Name: (S)-chaulmoogric acid
Description: This molecule is the (S)-enantiomer of chaulmoogric acid.

Name: Licarin A
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: Vasicinol
Description: This molecule is a member of quinazolines.

Name: Vasicinone
Description: This molecule is a member of quinazolines.

Name: Anisotine
Description: This molecule is a member of quinazolines.

Name: Rindoside
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Rinderine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrrolizines.

Name: Hiyodorilactone A
Description: This molecule is a germacranolide.

Name: Neryl propionate
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester.

Name: Eupatoriopicrin
Description: This molecule is a germacranolide.

Name: Grossamide
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: 10beta-hydroxy-6beta-isobutyrylfuranoeremophilane
Description: This molecule is an eremophilane sesquiterpenoid and a naphthofuran.

Name: Tannic acid
Description: This molecule is a light yellow to tan solid with a faint odor. Sinks and mixes with water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Procyanidin B2
Description: This molecule is a proanthocyanidin consisting of two molecules of (-)-epicatechin joined by a bond between positions 4 and 8' in a beta-configuration. This molecule can be found in Cinchona pubescens (Chinchona, in the rind, bark and cortex), in Cinnamomum verum (Ceylon cinnamon, in the rind, bark and cortex), in Crataegus monogyna (Common hawthorn, in the flower and blossom), in Uncaria guianensis (Cat's claw, in the root), in Vitis vinifera (Common grape vine, in the leaf), in Litchi chinensis (litchi, in the pericarp), in the apple, in Ecdysanthera utilis and in red wine. It has a role as a metabolite and an antioxidant. It is a hydroxyflavan, a proanthocyanidin, a biflavonoid and a polyphenol. It is functionally related to a (-)-epicatechin.

Name: Rhapontigenin
Description: This molecule is a stilbenol that is trans-stilbene in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5, while the other phenyl group is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 4. It has a role as a P450 inhibitor, an antineoplastic agent, an antiviral agent, a quorum sensing inhibitor, a cardioprotective agent, an antilipemic drug, an antifungal agent, a melanin synthesis inhibitor, an antibacterial agent, an angiogenesis inhibitor, a radical scavenger and a plant metabolite. It is a stilbenol, a polyphenol, a member of resorcinols and a member of guaiacols. It is functionally related to a piceatannol.

Name: Palmidin B
Description: This molecule is a member of anthracenes.

Name: 6-Glucopyranosylprocyanidin B1
Description: This molecule is a flavonoid oligomer.

Name: Secologanate
Description: This molecule is a terpene glycoside.

Name: [3,4,5-trihydroxy-6-(hydroxymethyl)oxan-2-yl] 3,4,5-trihydroxybenzoate
Description: This molecule is a tannin.

Name: Laccaic acid D
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 3,6,8-trihydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by methyl and carboxy groups at positions 1 and 2 respectively. A minor component of LAC dye together with laccaic acids A, B and C. It has a role as a dye and an animal metabolite. It is a monocarboxylic acid, a polyphenol and a trihydroxyanthraquinone. It is a conjugate acid of a laccaic acid D(1-).

Name: Trans-rhaponticin
Description: This molecule is a rhaponticin in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration. It possesses a range of pharmacological activities including antitumour, antiinflammatory, antilipemic and neuroprotective activities. It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent, a plant metabolite, a neuroprotective agent, an EC 2.3.1.85 (fatty acid synthase) inhibitor, an antineoplastic agent, an apoptosis inducer, an angiogenesis inhibitor, a hypoglycemic agent, an anti-allergic agent and an antilipemic drug. It is functionally related to a rhapontigenin.

Name: 6-O-galloyl-beta-D-glucose
Description: This molecule is a a galloyl beta-D-glucose compound having a galloyl group at the 6-position. Isolated from the leaves of Sapium sebiferum, it exhibits antihypertensive activity. It has a role as a metabolite and an antihypertensive agent. It is a gallate ester and a galloyl beta-D-glucose.

Name: Cassiachromone
Description: This molecule is a member of chromones.

Name: Isolindleyin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Rheidin B
Description: This molecule is a member of anthracenes.

Name: Mutatochrome
Description: This molecule is a xanthophyll.

Name: 1,2,6-tris-O-galloyl-beta-D-glucose
Description: This molecule is a galloyl-beta-D-glucose compound having the galloyl groups in the 1-, 2- and 6-positions. It is a gallate ester and a galloyl beta-D-glucose. It is functionally related to a gallic acid and a beta-D-glucose.

Name: Glucoemodin
Description: This molecule is an anthraquinone.

Name: Hamamelitannin
Description: This molecule is a gallate ester.

Name: Rheinoside C
Description: This molecule is a member of anthracenes.

Name: 2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid 5-O-beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a beta-D-glucosyl residue. It has a role as a Brassica napus metabolite. It is a beta-D-glucoside and a monohydroxybenzoic acid. It is functionally related to a 2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid.

Name: (-)-catechin-3-O-gallate
Description: This molecule is a gallate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the (3R)-hydroxy group of (-)-catechin. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a gallate ester, a polyphenol and a member of flavans. It is functionally related to a (-)-catechin and a gallic acid. It is an enantiomer of a (+)-catechin-3-O-gallate.

Name: Rheidin C
Description: This molecule is a member of anthracenes.

Name: Sennoside D
Description: This molecule is a member of sennosides.

Name: (R)-lactic acid
Description: This molecule is an optically active form of lactic acid having (R)-configuration. It has a role as an Escherichia coli metabolite and a human metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a (R)-lactate. It is an enantiomer of a (S)-lactic acid.

Name: Palmidin C
Description: This molecule is a member of anthracenes.

Name: Emodin anthrone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of anthracenones that is anthracen-9(10H)-one which carries a methyl group at position 6 and hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 8, respectively. It is an intermediate precursor in the synthesis of hypericin. It has a role as a fungal metabolite. It is an anthracenone and a member of phenols.

Name: Sennoside C
Description: This molecule is a member of sennosides.

Name: 2-phenyl-4-quinolinecarboxylic acid
Description: This molecule is a member of quinolines.

Name: Raspberry ketone
Description: This molecule is a ketone that is 4-phenylbutan-2-one in which the phenyl ring is substituted at position 4 by a hydroxy group. It is found in a variety of fruits including raspberries, blackberries and cranberries, and is used in perfumery and cosmetics. It has a role as a flavouring agent, a fragrance, a metabolite, a hepatoprotective agent, a cosmetic and an androgen antagonist. It is a member of phenols and a methyl ketone.

Name: 1-O-trans-cinnamoyl-beta-D-glucopyranose
Description: This molecule is an O-acyl carbohydrate consisting of beta-D-glucose carrying a O-trans-cinnamoyl group at the anomeric position. It is functionally related to a beta-D-glucose and a trans-cinnamic acid.

Name: Procyanidin B8
Description: This molecule is a proanthocyanidin that is (+)-catechin and (-)-epicatechin units joined by a bond between positions 4 and 6' respectively in an alpha-configuration. This molecule is found in acorn and is present in fruit and leaves of blackberry (Rubus fruticosus), raspberry (Rubus idaeus) and cowberry (Vaccinium vitis idaea). It can be also found in grape seeds and in beer. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a hydroxyflavan, a proanthocyanidin, a biflavonoid and a polyphenol. It is functionally related to a (-)-epicatechin and a (+)-catechin.

Name: Sennoside B
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of sennosides that is (9R,9'S)-9,9',10,10'-tetrahydro-9,9'-bianthracene-2,2'-dicarboxylic acid which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 4', by beta-D-glucopyranosyloxy groups at positions 5 and 5', and by oxo groups at positions 10 and 10'. It is a member of sennosides and an oxo dicarboxylic acid.

Name: Chrysophanein
Description: This molecule is an anthraquinone.

Name: 2',4,4',5,5'-Pentahydroxy-7'-methyl-10,10'-dioxo-9H,9'H,10H,10'H-[9,9'-bianthracene]-2-carboxylic acid
Description: This molecule is a member of anthracenes.

Name: Rheochrysin
Description: This molecule is an anthraquinone.

Name: Apoatropine
Description: This molecule is a monocarboxylic acid.

Name: 1-alpha-linolenoylglycerol
Description: This molecule is a 1-monoglyceride that has alpha-linolenoyl as the acyl group. It is functionally related to an alpha-linolenic acid.

Name: Scopolamine
Description: This molecule is a tropane alkaloid isolated from members of the Solanaceae family of plants, similar to [atropine] and [hyoscyamine], all of which structurally mimic the natural neurotransmitter [acetylcholine]. This molecule was first synthesized in 1959, but to date, synthesis remains less efficient than extracting scopolamine from plants. As an acetylcholine analogue, scopolamine can antagonize muscarinic acetylcholine receptors (mAChRs) in the central nervous system and throughout the body, inducing several therapeutic and adverse effects related to alteration of parasympathetic nervous system and cholinergic signalling. Due to its dose-dependent adverse effects, scopolamine was the first drug to be offered commercially as a transdermal delivery system, Scopoderm TTS®, in 1981. As a result of its anticholinergic effects, scopolamine is being investigated for diverse therapeutic applications; currently, it is approved for the prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with motion sickness and surgical procedures.  This molecule was first approved by the FDA on December 31, 1979, and is currently available as both oral tablets and a transdermal delivery system.

Name: 3-stearoyl-sn-glycerol
Description: This molecule is a 3-acyl-sn-glycerol that has octadecanoyl (stearoyl) as the 3-acyl group. It is a 1-monostearoylglycerol and a 3-acyl-sn-glycerol. It is an enantiomer of a 1-stearoyl-sn-glycerol.

Name: 3-linoleoyl-sn-glycerol
Description: This molecule is a 3-acyl-sn-glycerol that is the R-enantiomer of 1-monolinolein. It is a 1-monolinolein and a 3-acyl-sn-glycerol. It is an enantiomer of a 1-linoleoyl-sn-glycerol.

Name: Neoglucobrassicin(1-)
Description: This molecule is an indolylmethylglucosinolate that is the conjugate base of neoglucobrassicin, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group. It is a conjugate base of a neoglucobrassicin.

Name: Neogitogenin
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Cuscohygrine
Description: This molecule is a N-alkylpyrrolidine and a pyrrolidine alkaloid.

Name: Smilagenone
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: 2,3-dilinoleoyl-sn-glycerol
Description: This molecule is a 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both acyl groups are specified as linoleoyl. It is a 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol and a dilinoleoylglycerol. It is functionally related to a linoleic acid. It is an enantiomer of a 1,2-dilinoleoyl-sn-glycerol.

Name: Belladonnine
Description: This molecule is a carbonyl compound and a member of naphthalenes.

Name: Cusparine
Description: This molecule is a member of quinolines.

Name: Zhebeinine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Aristolochic acid D
Description: This molecule is an aristolochic acid that is phenanthrene-1-carboxylic acid substituted by a methylenedioxy group at the 3,4 positions, by an hydroxy group at position 6, by a methoxy group at position 8, and by a nitro group at position 10. It has a role as a carcinogenic agent, a metabolite, a nephrotoxin and a toxin. It is a C-nitro compound, a member of aristolochic acids, an aromatic ether, a cyclic acetal, a monocarboxylic acid and an organic heterotetracyclic compound.

Name: A class of dibenzylbutane derivatives which
Description: This molecule occurs in higher plants and in fluids (bile, serum, urine, etc.) in man and other animals. These compounds, which have a potential anti-cancer role, can be synthesized in vitro by human fecal flora. (From Singleton & Sainsbury, Dictionary of Microbiology and Molecular Biology, 2d ed)

Name: Solanidine(1+)
Description: This molecule is a tertiary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of solanidine. Major microspecies at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate acid of a solanidine.

Name: Xylopinine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Pseudoprotodioscin
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Nevadensin
Description: This molecule is a trimethoxyflavone that is flavone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 6, 8 and 4' and hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a trimethoxyflavone and a dihydroxyflavone. It is functionally related to a flavone. It is a conjugate acid of a nevadensin-7-olate.

Name: Gracillin
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Diosgenin
Description: This molecule is a sapogenin that is spirostan which is substituted by a hydroxy group at the 3beta position, contains a double bond at the 5-6 position, and has R- configuration at position 25. A natural product found in Dioscorea (wild yam) species, it is used as the starting point for the commercial synthesis of a number of steroids, including cortisone, pregnenolone and progesterone. It has a role as an apoptosis inducer, an antiviral agent, an antineoplastic agent and a metabolite. It is a 3beta-sterol, a spiroketal, a hexacyclic triterpenoid and a sapogenin. It derives from a hydride of a spirostan.

Name: (25S)-5beta-spirostan-3beta-ol
Description: This molecule is a sapogenin.

Name: Yamogenin
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Methylprotodioscin
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Pentylbenzene
Description: This molecule is a member of benzenes.

Name: (10E)-octadecenoic acid
Description: This molecule is an octadecenoic acid with a trans-double bond at position C-10. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a (10E)-octadecenoate.

Name: Allitol
Description: This molecule is a hexitol.

Name: 3-hydroxyl-2-methylpyridine
Description: This molecule is a member of methylpyridines.

Name: Trioxsalen
Description: This molecule is 7H-Furo[3,2-g]chromen-7-one in which positions 2, 5, and 9 are substituted by methyl groups. Like other psoralens, trioxsalen causes photosensitization of the skin. It is administered orally in conjunction with UV-A for phototherapy treatment of vitiligo. After photoactivation it creates interstrand cross-links in DNA, inhibiting DNA synthesis and cell division, and can lead to cell injury; recovery from the cell injury may be followed by increased melanisation of the epidermis. It has a role as a photosensitizing agent and a dermatologic drug.

Name: Methyl 11-eicosenoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester.

Name: P-xylene
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless watery liquid with a sweet odor. Less dense than water. Insoluble in water. Irritating vapor. Freezing point is 56 °F. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Indene
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid derived from coal tar. Fp: -2 °C; bp:182 °C. Density 0.997 g cm-3. Insoluble in water but soluble in organic solvents.

Name: (S)-3-hydroxypalmitic acid
Description: This molecule is a 3-hydroxypalmitic acid. It is an enantiomer of a (R)-3-hydroxypalmitic acid.

Name: Ethylbenzene
Description: This molecule is a colorless, flammable liquid that smells like gasoline. It is found in natural products such as coal tar and petroleum and is also found in manufactured products such as inks, insecticides, and paints. This molecule is used primarily to make another chemical, styrene. Other uses include as a solvent, in fuels, and to make other chemicals.

Name: Furfuryl acetate
Description: This molecule appears as colorless to clear yellow or orange liquid with a pungent odor. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Poliumoside
Description: This molecule is an oligosaccharide.

Name: Methyl tricosanoate

Name: 1-Acetyl-beta-carboline
Description: This molecule is a harmala alkaloid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Di-2-furanylmethane
Description: This molecule is a heteroarene.

Name: Methyl Hexacosanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester.

Name: Dimethyl azelate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester that is nonanedioic acid in which both carboxy groups are replaced by methoxycarbonyl groups. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a fatty acid methyl ester and a diester. It is functionally related to a nonanedioic acid.

Name: Trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline betaine
Description: This molecule is an amino-acid betaine that is trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline zwitterion in which both of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen have been replaced by methyl groups. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an amino-acid betaine, a secondary alcohol and a pyrrolidine alkaloid. It is functionally related to a trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline zwitterion.

Name: Methyl pentacosanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester.

Name: 2-dodecene
Description: This molecule is a dodecene that is dodecane with a double bond at position 2. It has a role as a fungal metabolite. It is a dodecene and a volatile organic compound.

Name: 24-epicampesterol
Description: This molecule is a 3beta-sterol, a member of phytosterols, an ergostanoid, a 3beta-hydroxy-Delta(5)-steroid and a C28-steroid.

Name: Caracurine V
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Telekin
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: 9-[(3,7-Dimethyl-2,6-octadienyl)oxy]-7H-furo[3,2-g][1]benzopyran-7-one
Description: This molecule is a terpene lactone.

Name: 3-Methoxy-4,5-methylenedioxybenzoic acid
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxybenzoic acid.

Name: Gentioflavine
Description: This molecule is a delta-lactone.

Name: Gentiopicrin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Gentianine
Description: This molecule is a pyranopyridine, a lactone and a pyridine alkaloid.

Name: Paravallarine
Description: This molecule is a steroid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Canin
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: Epimedin C
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glycoside.

Name: Tremuloidin
Description: This molecule is an aryl beta-D-glucoside that is salicin in which the hydrogen of the 2-hydroxy group is replaced by a benzoyl group. It is found in the leaves and bark of willows and poplars. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of benzyl alcohols, a benzoate ester, a monosaccharide derivative, an aryl beta-D-glucoside and an aromatic primary alcohol. It is functionally related to a salicin.

Name: Hypocrellin B
Description: This molecule is a naphthalenone.

Name: 1,4-Di-O-caffeoylquinic acid
Description: This molecule is a quinic acid.

Name: D-glutamic acid
Description: This molecule is an optically active form of glutamic acid having D-configuration. It has a role as an Escherichia coli metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a D-alpha-amino acid and a glutamic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a D-glutamate(1-). It is an enantiomer of a L-glutamic acid.

Name: D-cystine
Description: This molecule is the D-enantiomer of cystine. It has a role as an EC 1.2.1.11 (aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase) inhibitor. It is an enantiomer of a L-cystine. It is a tautomer of a This molecule zwitterion.

Name: D-mannopyranose
Description: This molecule is d-Mannose in its six-membered ring form. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a D-aldohexose, a D-mannose and a mannopyranose.

Name: L-cysteine
Description: This molecule is an optically active form of cysteine having L-configuration. It has a role as a flour treatment agent, a human metabolite and an EC 4.3.1.3 (histidine ammonia-lyase) inhibitor. It is a serine family amino acid, a proteinogenic amino acid, a cysteine and a L-alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate base of a L-cysteinium. It is a conjugate acid of a L-cysteinate(1-). It is an enantiomer of a D-cysteine. It is a tautomer of a This molecule zwitterion.

Name: Gardendiol
Description: This molecule is a terpene lactone.

Name: Gardnerilin A
Description: This molecule is a polyketide.

Name: Crocetin(2-)
Description: This molecule is a dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the carboxy groups of crocetin. The major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a crocetin.

Name: Gardoside
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: N-benzyloxycarbonyl-L-leucine
Description: This molecule is a L-leucine derivative obtained by the substitution of a benzyloxycarbonyl group on the nitrogen atom. It is a carbamate ester and a L-leucine derivative. It is a conjugate acid of a N-benzyloxycarbonyl-L-leucinate.

Name: Gamma-Crocetin
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: D-aspartic acid
Description: This molecule is the D-enantiomer of aspartic acid. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It is an aspartic acid and a D-alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate acid of a D-aspartate(1-). It is an enantiomer of a L-aspartic acid.

Name: Gardenoside
Description: This molecule is a cyclopentapyran that is 7-deoxyloganin with a methyl and hydrogen replaced by hydroxy and hydroxymethyl groups at position 7. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a beta-D-glucoside, a cyclopentapyran, an enoate ester, a monosaccharide derivative, a methyl ester and a tertiary alcohol. It is functionally related to a 7-deoxyloganin.

Name: Genipin 1-beta-gentiobioside
Description: This molecule is a terpene glycoside.

Name: Gamma-linolenic acid
Description: This molecule is a C18, omega-6 acid fatty acid comprising a linolenic acid having cis- double bonds at positions 6, 9 and 12. It has a role as a human metabolite, a plant metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is an omega-6 fatty acid and a linolenic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a gamma-linolenate.

Name: Beta-L-arabinopyranose
Description: This molecule is a L-arabinopyranose with a beta-configuration at the anomeric position. It is an enantiomer of a beta-D-arabinopyranose.

Name: (12S,13R)-12-acetyl-9,13,17-trihydroxy-5,10,16,21-tetramethoxy-13-methylhexacyclo[13.8.0.02,11.03,8.04,22.018,23]tricosa-1(15),2(11),3(8),4(22),5,9,16,18(23),20-nonaene-7,19-dione
Description: This molecule is a naphthalenone.

Name: Plaunotol
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid that is geranylgeraniol carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 18. It has a role as an antibacterial agent, an antineoplastic agent, an apoptosis inducer, an anti-ulcer drug, a plant metabolite, a nephroprotective agent and a vulnerary. It is a primary alcohol and a diterpenoid.

Name: Ethyl pentadecanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: Acenaphthylene
Description: This molecule is a colorless crystalline solid. Insoluble in water. Used in dye synthesis, insecticides, fungicides, and in the manufacture of plastics.

Name: D-ornithine
Description: This molecule is the D-enantiomer of ornithine. It is an intermediate metabolite produced in the urea cycle. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It is an ornithine and a D-alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate base of a D-ornithinium(1+). It is an enantiomer of a L-ornithine.

Name: 20-epi-bryonolic acid
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid of D:C-friedooleanane-type triterpenoids isolated from the stems of Lagenaria siceraria and roots of Coriaria intermedia and has been found to exhibit antineoplastic activity. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a hydroxy monocarboxylic acid.

Name: Cucurbitacin D
Description: This molecule is a cucurbitacin in which a lanostane skeleton is multi-substituted with hydroxy, methyl and oxo substituents, with unsaturation at positions 5 and 23. It is a cucurbitacin, a secondary alpha-hydroxy ketone and a tertiary alpha-hydroxy ketone. It derives from a hydride of a lanostane.

Name: L-citrulline
Description: This molecule is the L-enantiomer of citrulline. It has a role as an EC 1.14.13.39 (nitric oxide synthase) inhibitor, a protective agent, a nutraceutical, a micronutrient, a human metabolite, an Escherichia coli metabolite, a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is an enantiomer of a D-citrulline. It is a tautomer of a This molecule zwitterion.

Name: Pyrene
Description: This molecule is a colorless solid, solid and solutions have a slight blue fluorescence. Used in biochemical research. (EPA, 1998)

Name: 2,4-dimethylphenol
Description: This molecule appears as colorless crystals or clear, dark amber liquid.

Name: 2-methylnaphthalene
Description: This molecule is a white crystalline solid. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Alpha-(hydroxymethyl)serine
Description: This molecule is a serine derivative in which the alpha-hydrogen of serine is replaced by a hydroxymethyl group. It is an aminodiol, a dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid and a serine derivative. It is a tautomer of an alpha-(hydroxymethyl)serine zwitterion.

Name: Lithospermoside
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Menisdaurilide
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: Chromone
Description: This molecule is the simplest member of the class of chromones that is 4H-chromene with an oxo group at position 4. It is a member of chromones and an enone.

Name: Dibutyl terephthalate
Description: This molecule is a phthalate ester.

Name: Epipinoresinol
Description: This molecule is an enantiomer of pinoresinol having (+)-(1R,3aR,4S,6aR)-configuration. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a marine metabolite.

Name: HBA
Description: This molecule is a fatty amide.

Name: 4-(beta-D-glucosyloxy)benzoic acid
Description: This molecule is a beta-D-glucoside of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid. It is a member of benzoic acids and a beta-D-glucoside. It is functionally related to a benzoic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 4-(beta-D-glucosyloxy)benzoate.

Name: Ethyl vanillate
Description: This molecule is a methoxybenzoic acid.

Name: 5-O-Methylvisamminol
Description: This molecule is an oxacycle and an organic heterotricyclic compound.

Name: (4-hydroxyphenyl)acetonitrile
Description: This molecule is a hydroxynitrile that is phenylacetonitrile substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: L-glutamic acid 5-methyl ester
Description: This molecule is a glutamic acid 5-methyl ester having L-configuration. It is a L-glutamic acid derivative, a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid and a glutamic acid 5-methyl ester.

Name: (+)-nyasol
Description: This molecule is a 1,3-bis(p-hydroxyphenyl)pentane-1,4-diene that has 1Z,3S configuration. A natural product found in Asparagus africanus and Asparagus cochinchinensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an enantiomer of a (-)-nyasol.

Name: 4-(methoxymethyl)phenol
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of phenols that is p-cresol in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a methoxy group. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: 4-(Ethoxymethyl)phenol
Description: This molecule is a benzyl ether.

Name: 3-Methoxybenzyl alcohol
Description: This molecule is a member of methoxybenzenes.

Name: 4-Hydroxybenzylamine
Description: This molecule is an aromatic amine.

Name: Dihydroferulic acid
Description: This molecule is a monocarboxylic acid that is propanoic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 has been replaced by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group. It has a role as a human xenobiotic metabolite, a plant metabolite, a mouse metabolite and an antioxidant. It is a monocarboxylic acid, a phenylpropanoid and a member of guaiacols. It is functionally related to a propionic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a dihydroferulate.

Name: 1-monolinolein
Description: This molecule is a 1-monoglyceride that has octadecadienoyl (linoleoyl) as the acyl group. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an antiviral agent. It is functionally related to a linoleic acid.

Name: Alpha-D-Glcp-(1->2)-alpha-D-Glcp
Description: This molecule is a alpha-D-Glcp-(1->2)-D-Glcpglycosylglucose in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has alpha configuration.

Name: 4-nitro-L-phenylalanine
Description: This molecule is an L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a nitro group at position 4 of the phenyl ring. It is a L-phenylalanine derivative and a C-nitro compound.

Name: 2-methylpyrrolidine
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of pyrrolidines that is pyrrolidine which is substituted by a methyl group at position 2. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: 3-Furfuryl 2-pyrrolecarboxylate
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrroles.

Name: Multiradiatin
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: 2-Keto-L-gluconate
Description: This molecule is a hexose.

Name: Pyrrole-2-carboxylic acid
Description: This molecule is a pyrrolecarboxylic acid that is 1H-pyrrole carrying a carboxy substituent at position 2. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a pyrrole-2-carboxylate.

Name: 1H-pyrrole
Description: This molecule is a tautomer of pyrrole that has the double bonds at positions 2 and 4. It is a pyrrole and a secondary amine. It is a tautomer of a 2H-pyrrole and a 3H-pyrrole.

Name: 1,2-dihexadecanoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate
Description: This molecule is a 1-acyl-2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate in which the 1-acyl group is also hexadecanoyl. It is a conjugate acid of a This molecule(2-).

Name: Beta-maltose
Description: This molecule is a maltose that has beta-configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre. It has a role as a geroprotector.

Name: 2,4,5-trichlorocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ol
Description: This molecule is an organochlorine compound and a cyclohexadienol.

Name: (+)-8-hydroxycalamenene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid consisting of 5,6,7,8-tetrahydronaphthalen-1-ol having two methyl substituents at the 3- and 8-positions, an isopropyl substituent at the 5-position and (+)-(5R,8S)-configuration. It is a sesquiterpenoid and a carbobicyclic compound. It derives from a hydride of a cadinane.

Name: 7-Hydroxycadalene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Oleandrin
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin that consists of oleandrigenin having a 2,6-dideoxy-3-O-methyl-alpha-L-arabino-hexopyranosyl residue attached to the oxygen function at position 3. It is a cardenolide glycoside, a 14beta-hydroxy steroid, a steroid ester and a steroid saponin. It is functionally related to an oleandrigenin.

Name: Adynerin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside.

Name: 2-Undecen-1-ol
Description: This molecule is an aliphatic alcohol.

Name: Bicyclogermacrene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene derived from germacrane by dehydrogenation across the C(1)-C(10) and C(4)-C(5) bonds and cyclisation across the C(8)-C(9) bond. It has a role as a metabolite. It derives from a hydride of a germacrane.

Name: Gitoxin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside that is gitoxigenin in which the 3beta-hydroxy group has been glycosylated with tridigitoxose. It is functionally related to a gitoxigenin.

Name: All-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoic acid
Description: This molecule is an icosatrienoic acid having three cis double bonds at positions 8, 11 and 14. It has a role as a nutraceutical, a human metabolite and a fungal metabolite. It is a fatty acid 20:3 and a long-chain fatty acid. It is a conjugate acid of an all-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoate.

Name: Neriifolin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside that is digitoxigenin in which the hydroxy goup at position 3 has been converted to its (6-deoxy-3-O-methyl-alpha-L-glucopyranoside derivative. Found in the seeds of Cerbera odollamand in Thevetia ahouia and Thevitia neriifolia. It has a role as a cardiotonic drug, a toxin and a neuroprotective agent. It is functionally related to a digitoxigenin.

Name: DB-2073
Description: This molecule is an alkylbenzene.

Name: Penta-2,4-dienoic acid
Description: This molecule is a pentadienoic acid with the double bonds at positions 2 and 4. It is a pentadienoic acid and an alpha,beta-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a penta-2,4-dienoate.

Name: Cis-hydrindane
Description: This molecule is a hydrindane.

Name: Heptan-3-ol
Description: This molecule is a secondary alcohol that is heptane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a secondary alcohol and a heptanol.

Name: Xi-5-Dodecanolide
Description: This molecule is a delta-lactone.

Name: Dambonitol
Description: This molecule is a member of cyclohexanols.

Name: Gitoxigenin
Description: This molecule is a 3beta-hydroxy steroid, a 14beta-hydroxy steroid and a 16beta-hydroxy steroid. It derives from a hydride of a 5beta-cardanolide.

Name: Strospeside
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside in which the parent structure gitoxigenin is glycosylated at the 3beta-hydroxy group by beta-D-digitalose. It is functionally related to a gitoxigenin.

Name: 2-butyl-1-octanol
Description: This molecule is a primary alcohol that is 1-octanol substituted by a butyl group at position 2. Metabolite observed in cancer metabolism. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is a primary alcohol, an alkyl alcohol and a medium-chain fatty alcohol. It derives from a hydride of an octane.

Name: Apocynin
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ketone that is 1-phenylethanone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4 and a methoxy group at position 3. It has a role as a non-narcotic analgesic, a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, an antirheumatic drug, a peripheral nervous system drug, an EC 1.6.3.1. [NAD(P)H oxidase (H2O2-forming)] inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a member of acetophenones, a methyl ketone and an aromatic ketone.

Name: Citroside B
Description: This molecule is a terpene glycoside and a member of allenes. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Jaceosidin
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyflavone that is flavone with hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 4' and methoxy groups at positions 3' and 6. Isolated from Salvia tomentosa and Artemisia asiatica, it exhibits anti-allergic, anti-inflammatory and apoptosis inducing activties. It has a role as a metabolite, an anti-inflammatory agent, an apoptosis inducer, an anti-allergic agent and an antineoplastic agent. It is a trihydroxyflavone and a dimethoxyflavone.

Name: Pseudoneolinderane
Description: This molecule is a butenolide. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Ovatifolin
Description: This molecule is a germacranolide.

Name: Otobain
Description: This molecule is a lignan.

Name: Ligstroside
Description: This molecule is a secoiridoid glycoside that is the methyl ester of 3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran-5-carboxylic acid which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 4 by hydroxy, ethylidene, and carboxymethyl groups, respectively and in which the anomeric hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into its beta-D-glucoside and the carboxylic acid moiety of the carboxymethyl substituent has been converted to the corresponding 4-hydroxyphenethyl ester (the 2S,3E,4S stereoisomer). An important phenolic compound present in olive cultivars. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a secoiridoid glycoside, a methyl ester, a diester, a member of pyrans, a member of phenols and a beta-D-glucoside.

Name: Lucidumoside C
Description: This molecule is a secoiridoid glycoside isolated from Ligustrum lucidum which has been shown to exhibit antioxidant activity against hemolysis of red blood cells induced by free radicals. It has a role as an antioxidant, an antiviral agent and a plant metabolite. It is a monosaccharide derivative, a member of catechols, a beta-D-glucoside, a member of pyrans, a monoterpene glycoside, a methyl ester and a secoiridoid glycoside.

Name: Oleuropein
Description: This molecule is a secoiridoid glycoside that is the methyl ester of 3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran-5-carboxylic acid which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 4 by hydroxy, ethylidene, and carboxymethyl groups, respectively and in which the anomeric hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into its beta-D-glucoside and the carboxylic acid moiety of the carboxymethyl substituent has been converted to the corresponding 3,4-dihydroxyphenethyl ester (the 2S,3E,4S stereoisomer). The most important phenolic compound present in olive cultivars. It has a role as a plant metabolite, a radical scavenger, an anti-inflammatory agent, an antineoplastic agent, an antihypertensive agent, a NF-kappaB inhibitor, an apoptosis inducer, an antioxidant and a nutraceutical. It is a secoiridoid glycoside, a beta-D-glucoside, a methyl ester, a member of catechols, a diester and a member of pyrans.

Name: Acetylursolic acid
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Propionaldehyde

Name: (S)-[10]-Gingerol
Description: This molecule is a monomethoxybenzene, a beta-hydroxy ketone and a member of phenols.

Name: 4-isopropyl-1-methylenecyclohexane
Description: This molecule is a monoterpene consisting of methylenecyclohexane having an isopropyl substituent at the 4-position. It derives from a hydride of a p-menthane.

Name: Glyoxal
Description: This molecule appears as yellow crystals melting at15 °C. Hence often encountered as a light yellow liquid with a weak sour odor. Vapor has a green color and burns with a violet flame.

Name: 1,7-dimethyl-7-(4-methylpent-3-enyl)bicyclo[2.2.1]heptan-2-ol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: (+)-alpha-santalene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene consisting of a tricyclo[2.2.1.0(2,6)]heptane skeleton substituted by methyl groups at positions 1 and 7 and by a 4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl group at position 7 (the 1S,2R,4S,6R,7R diastereoisomer). It is a sesquiterpene and a bridged compound.

Name: Fenchlorazole-ethyl
Description: This molecule is a dichlorobenzene.

Name: 1-(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)-7-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-(4E)-4-hepten-3-one
Description: This molecule is a diarylheptanoid that is (4E)-4-hepten-3-one substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 1 and a 4-hydroxyphenyl group at position 7 respectively. It has been isolated from the rhizomes of Curcuma kwangsiensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a diarylheptanoid, an enone and a member of guaiacols.

Name: 4-Gingerol
Description: This molecule is a monomethoxybenzene, a member of phenols and a beta-hydroxy ketone.

Name: 9-Ethoxy-aristololactam
Description: This molecule is a phenanthrol.

Name: Phellatin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside and a member of flavonoids.

Name: 3,7,11-Trimethyl-2,6,10-dodecatrienyl acetate
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: 3'-Methoxy-[6]-Gingerdiol 3,5-diacetate
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester.

Name: 6-Methylgingediol
Description: This molecule is a dimethoxybenzene.

Name: Malvidin 3-rutinoside-5-glucoside
Description: This molecule is an anthocyanidin glycoside.

Name: Valerate
Description: This molecule is a short-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of valeric acid; present in ester form as component of many steroid-based pharmaceuticals. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a short-chain fatty acid anion and a straight-chain saturated fatty acid anion. It is a conjugate base of a valeric acid.

Name: Pipecolic acid
Description: This molecule is a piperidinemonocarboxylic acid in which the carboxy group is located at position C-2. It is a conjugate acid of a pipecolate.

Name: Propionate
Description: This molecule is the conjugate base of propionic acid; a key precursor in lipid biosynthesis. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is a conjugate base of a propionic acid.

Name: 6-Gingesulfonic acid
Description: This molecule is a member of phenols and a member of methoxybenzenes.

Name: Chikusetsusaponin-IV
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: 4-{[(3s,4r,5s)-3-hydroxy-5-(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)-4-(hydroxymethyl)tetrahydro-3-furanyl]methyl}-2-methoxyphenyl beta-d-glucopyranoside
Description: This molecule is a lignan and a glycoside.

Name: Alpha-L-rhamnopyranose
Description: This molecule is an L-rhamnopyranose having alpha-configuration at the anomeric centre. It has a role as an epitope.

Name: Methyl alpha-D-galactoside
Description: This molecule is an alpha-D-galactoside having a methyl substituent at the anomeric position. It is an alpha-D-galactoside, a methyl D-galactoside and a monosaccharide derivative.

Name: Manghaslin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside and a member of flavonoids.

Name: Kaempferol 3-neohesperidoside
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glycoside.

Name: Zingerone
Description: This molecule is a methyl ketone that is 4-phenylbutan-2-one in which the phenyl ring is substituted at positions 3 and 4 by methoxy and hydroxy groups respectively. The major pungent component in ginger. It has a role as an antioxidant, an anti-inflammatory agent, a radiation protective agent, an antiemetic, a flavouring agent, a fragrance and a plant metabolite. It is a member of phenols, a monomethoxybenzene and a methyl ketone.

Name: Specnuezhenide
Description: This molecule is a lipopolysaccharide.

Name: Cyanidin 3-O-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a metabolite found in or produced by Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

Name: Cyanidin 3-O-rutinoside chloride
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of anthocyanin chlorides that has cyanidin 3-O-rutinoside as the cationic counterpart. It contains a cyanidin 3-O-rutinoside.

Name: Ethyl laurate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ethyl ester of lauric acid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Hexane-1,2,3,4,5,6-hexol
Description: This molecule is a hexitol.

Name: (Z,Z)-alpha-farnesene
Description: This molecule is the (Z,Z)-stereoisomer of alpha-farnesene

Name: 2-Methylpiperidine
Description: This molecule is a member of piperidines.

Name: Butyl butyryllactate
Description: This molecule is a diester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-(butanoyloxy)propanoic acid with butan-1-ol. It has a role as a flavouring agent and a plant metabolite. It is a diester and a butyrate ester. It is functionally related to a 2-hydroxypropanoic acid and a butan-1-ol.

Name: Nereistoxin
Description: This molecule is toxin isolated from marine segmented worm, Lumbriconereis heterodopa. It is also the active insecticide of the proinsecticide thiocyclam. It has a role as a toxin and an insecticide.

Name: 8-Gingediol
Description: This molecule is a glycol, a monomethoxybenzene and a member of phenols.

Name: (-)-syringaresinol O,O'-bis(beta-D-glucoside)
Description: This molecule is a beta-D-glucoside that is the 4,4'-bis(beta-D-glucosyl) derivative of (-)-syringaresinol. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an antioxidant and an anti-inflammatory agent. It is functionally related to a (-)-syringaresinol.

Name: Quercetin 3-O-beta-D-glucosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin attached to a beta-D-sophorosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as an antioxidant and a plant metabolite. It is a tetrahydroxyflavone and a sophoroside. It is a conjugate acid of a quercetin 3-O-beta-D-glucosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucoside(1-).

Name: Ethylisopropyl sulfide
Description: This molecule is an aliphatic sulfide.

Name: Alpha-Santalal
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Albafuran C
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: Guangsangon M
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of polyphenols consisting of a methylcyclohexene ring attached to a 2,4-dihydroxyphenyl, 2,4-dihydroxybenzoyl and trihydroxyflavanone moieties at positions 5'', 4'' and 3'' respectively (the 2R,3''R,4''R,5''S stereoisomer). Regarded biogenetically as a Diels-Alder adduct, it is isolated from the stem barks of Morus macroura and exhibits antioxidant activity. It has a role as an antioxidant and a plant metabolite. It is a trihydroxyflavanone, a polyphenol, an aromatic ketone and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones.

Name: Guangsangon N
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of polyphenols consisting of a methylcyclohexene ring attached to a 2,4-dihydroxyphenyl, 2,4-dihydroxybenzoyl and trihydroxyflavanone moieties at positions 5'', 4'' and 3'' respectively (the 2S,3''R,4''R,5''S stereoisomer). Regarded biogenetically as a Diels-Alder adduct, it is isolated from the stem barks of Morus macroura and exhibits antioxidant activity. It has a role as an antioxidant and a plant metabolite. It is a polyphenol, a trihydroxyflavanone, an aromatic ketone and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones.

Name: Guangsangon L
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of polyphenols consisting of a methylcyclohexene ring attached to a 2,4-dihydroxyphenyl, 2,4-dihydroxybenzoyl and 2,4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde moieties at positions 5'', 4'' and 3'' respectively. Regarded biogenetically as a Diels-Alder adduct, it is isolated from the stem barks of Morus macroura and exhibits antioxidant activity. It has a role as an antioxidant and a plant metabolite. It is a polyphenol, an aromatic ketone and a dihydroxybenzaldehyde.

Name: Guangsangon K
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of polyphenols consisting of a methylcyclohexene ring attached to a 2,4-dihydroxyphenyl, 2,4-dihydroxybenzoyl and dihydroflavonol moieties at positions 5'', 4'' and 3'' respectively. Regarded biogenetically as a Diels-Alder adduct, it is isolated from the stem barks of Morus macroura and exhibits antioxidant activity. It has a role as an antioxidant and a plant metabolite. It is a member of dihydroflavonols, a polyphenol, an aromatic ketone and a secondary alpha-hydroxy ketone.

Name: Kuwanon Y
Description: This molecule is a diarylheptanoid.

Name: (5S)-5-methylimidazolidine-2,4-dione
Description: This molecule is an imidazolidine-2,4-dione.

Name: 4-coumaric acid methyl ester
Description: This molecule is a cinnamate ester that is the methyl ester of 4-coumaric acid. It has a role as a melanin synthesis inhibitor, a fungal metabolite, an anti-inflammatory agent, an antifungal agent and a plant metabolite. It is a cinnamate ester, a member of phenols and a methyl ester. It is functionally related to a 4-coumaric acid.

Name: 5-hydroxy-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-7-[[3,4,5-trihydroxy-6-(hydroxymethyl)-2-oxanyl]oxy]-1-benzopyran-4-one
Description: This molecule is an acrovestone and an isoflavonoid.

Name: Icosanoate
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of icosanoic acid (arachidic acid). It has a role as a human metabolite. It is a long-chain fatty acid anion, a fatty acid anion 20:0 and a 2-saturated fatty acid anion. It is a conjugate base of an icosanoic acid.

Name: 1-Formyl-beta-carboline
Description: This molecule is a member of beta-carbolines.

Name: Coronopilin
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: Germacrone-13-al
Description: This molecule is a germacrane sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Turricolol E
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Nomilin
Description: This molecule is a limonoid with formula C28H34O9. It is commonly found in edible citrus fruits including lemons, limes, oranges, and grapefruits. The compound exhibits a variety of biological and pharmacological activities including anticancer, antiinflammatory, antiobesity, and antiviral. It has a role as a pregnane X receptor agonist, a geroprotector, an anti-inflammatory agent, an antioxidant, a skin lightening agent, an anti-obesity agent, a hypoglycemic agent, an angiogenesis inhibitor, an apoptosis inducer, an anti-HIV-1 agent, a plant metabolite, an antineoplastic agent and an immunomodulator. It is a limonoid, an organic heteropentacyclic compound, a lactone, a member of furans, an epoxide, an acetate ester and a pentacyclic triterpenoid.

Name: Dehydrodeguelin,7a,13a-Didehydrodeguelin
Description: This molecule is a member of rotenones.

Name: Demethoxycurcumin
Description: This molecule is a beta-diketone that is curcumin in which one of the methoxy groups is replaced by hydrogen. It is found in Curcuma zedoaria and Etlingera elatior. It has a role as a metabolite, an antineoplastic agent and an anti-inflammatory agent. It is a polyphenol, a beta-diketone, an enone and a diarylheptanoid.

Name: Bisdemethoxycurcumin
Description: This molecule is a beta-diketone that is methane in which two of the hydrogens are substituted by 4-hydroxycinnamoyl groups. It has a role as a metabolite and an EC 3.2.1.1 (alpha-amylase) inhibitor. It is a beta-diketone, a polyphenol, an enone and a diarylheptanoid. It is functionally related to a 4-coumaric acid.

Name: (1E,4E,6E)-1,7-bis(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)hepta-1,4,6-trien-3-one
Description: This molecule is a diarylheptanoid.

Name: Curcumol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: 1,7-bis (4-hydroxyphenyl)-1,4,6-heptatrien-3-one
Description: This molecule is a diarylheptanoid that is 1,4,6-heptatrien-3-one substituted by 4-hydroxypheny group at positions 1 and 7 respectively. It has been isolated from the rhizomes of Curcuma domestica and Etlingera elatior. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a diarylheptanoid, a member of phenols and an enone.

Name: 3,4,5-trimethyl-2-Cyclopenten-1-one
Description: This molecule is a cyclic ketone.

Name: 1,7-Bis(4-hydroxyphenyl)-1-heptene-3,5-dione
Description: This molecule is a diarylheptanoid.

Name: Curdione
Description: This molecule is a germacrane sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Calebin A
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Zingiberenol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Guaiane
Description: This molecule is a terpenoid fundamental parent and a sesquiterpene.

Description: This molecule is a germacrane sesquiterpenoid.

Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.
