Description: This molecule is a member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone substituted by a methoxy group at position 4'. It has a role as a phytoestrogen and a plant metabolite. It is a member of 7-hydroxyisoflavones and a member of 4'-methoxyisoflavones. It is functionally related to a daidzein. It is a conjugate acid of a formononetin(1-).

Name: D-glucopyranuronic acid
Description: This molecule is a D-glucuronic acid in cyclic pyranose form. It has a role as an algal metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a D-glucopyranuronate. It is an enantiomer of a L-glucopyranuronic acid.

Name: Isoastragaloside II
Description: This molecule is a glycoside and a cucurbitacin.

Name: Parinaric acid
Description: This molecule is an octadecatetraenoic acid containing a conjugated system of double bonds at positions 9, 11, 13 and 15.

Name: 3',5'-cyclic AMP
Description: This molecule is a 3',5'-cyclic purine nucleotide having having adenine as the nucleobase. It has a role as a human metabolite, an Escherichia coli metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is an adenyl ribonucleotide and a 3',5'-cyclic purine nucleotide. It is a conjugate acid of a This molecule(1-).

Name: Nonyl acetate
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid with a pungent odor of mushrooms. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Hence floats on water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: (1R,6S)-gamma-himachalene
Description: This molecule is a cis-gamma-himachalene. It is an enantiomer of a (1S,6R)-gamma-himachalene.

Name: Ombuin
Description: This molecule is a dimethoxyflavone that is quercetin in which the hydroxy groups at positions 7 and 4' are replaced by methoxy groups. Isolated from Cyperus teneriffae, it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity. It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent and a plant metabolite. It is a trihydroxyflavone, a member of flavonols and a dimethoxyflavone. It is functionally related to a quercetin. It is a conjugate acid of a 7,4'-O-dimethylquercetin 3-olate.

Name: 5-hydroxy-3,3',4',7-tetramethoxyflavone
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxyflavone that is 5-hydroxyflavone which is substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3,3',4' and 7. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a tetramethoxyflavone, a member of 3'-methoxyflavones and a monohydroxyflavone. It is a conjugate acid of a This molecule(1-).

Name: Dhelwangin
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ketone.

Name: Flopropione
Description: This molecule is an organic molecular entity.

Name: (2E)-hexenal
Description: This molecule is a 2-hexenal in which the olefinic double bond has E configuration. It occurs naturally in a wide range of fruits, vegetables, and spices. It has a role as a flavouring agent, an antibacterial agent and a plant metabolite.

Name: 7,4'-dimethylkaempferol
Description: This molecule is a dimethoxyflavone that is kaempferol in which the hydroxy groups at position 4' and 7 have been replaced by methoxy groups. It is a component of bee glue and has been isolated from several plant species including Betula exilis, Zingiber mekongense and Alpinia flabellata. It has a role as an antioxidant and a plant metabolite. It is a dimethoxyflavone, a dihydroxyflavone and a member of flavonols. It is functionally related to a kaempferol. It is a conjugate acid of a 7,4'-O-dimethylkaempferol 3-olate.

Name: 5-methylhexan-2-one
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with a pleasant fruity odor. Less dense than water. Vapors heavier than air. Used as a solvent and for making other chemicals.

Name: 3-methylbutan-2-one
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with a pleasant odor. Flash point below 70 °F. Less dense than water. May be toxic by inhalation and skin absorption. Used as a solvent.

Name: Epi-Friedelanol
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Irisolidone
Description: This molecule is a member of 4'-methoxyisoflavones.

Name: Diphenyl sulfide
Description: This molecule is an aryl sulfide that consists of two phenyl groups connected by a sulphur atom.

Name: (Z)-3-phenyl-2-propenal
Description: This molecule is a 3-phenylprop-2-enal that has Z configuration. It has a role as a volatile oil component.

Name: Koenine
Description: This molecule is a member of carbazoles.

Name: Kynurenine
Description: This molecule is a ketone that is alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2-aminobenzoyl group. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is a substituted aniline, an aromatic ketone and a non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate acid of a kynureninate.

Name: 4'-demethyldeoxypodophyllotoxin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of furonaphthodioxoles that is (5R,5aR,8aR)-5,8,8a,9-tetrahydro-2H-furo[3',4':6,7]naphtho[2,3-d][1,3]dioxol-6(5aH)-one substituted at position 5 by a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an immunosuppressive agent, an antioxidant and an antineoplastic agent. It is a lignan, a gamma-lactone, a furonaphthodioxole, a member of methoxybenzenes and a member of phenols.

Name: Narwedine
Description: This molecule is a benzazepine.

Name: Norgalanthamine
Description: This molecule is a benzazepine.

Name: Desmodilactone
Description: This molecule is a N-acyl-amino acid.

Name: Isovitexin 8-C-beta-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a C-glycosyl compound that is isovitexin in which the hydrogen at position 8 is replaced by a beta-D-glucosyl residue. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a trihydroxyflavone and a C-glycosyl compound. It is functionally related to an isovitexin.

Name: Perilla ketone
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ketone.

Name: Pogostole
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Onjisaponin F
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: (2R)-eriodictoyl-7-O-beta-D-glucopyranosiduronic acid
Description: This molecule is a beta-D-glucosiduronic acid that is the 7-O-glucuronide of (2R)-eriodictyol. Isolated from the flowers of Chrysanthemum indicum, it exhibits inhibitory activity for rat lens aldose reductase. It has a role as a metabolite and an EC 1.1.1.21 (aldehyde reductase) inhibitor. It is a beta-D-glucosiduronic acid and a 3'-hydroxyflavonoid.

Name: Jesaconitine
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: 2-Methyl-3-[(2S,3R,4S,5S,6R)-3,4,5-trihydroxy-6-(hydroxymethyl)oxan-2-yl]oxypyran-4-one
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Dianthramine
Description: This molecule is a hydroxybenzoic acid.

Name: Cymarol
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside.

Name: Acetylcorynoline
Description: This molecule is a benzophenanthridine alkaloid.

Name: Glaudine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Corynoline
Description: This molecule is a benzophenanthridine alkaloid that is chelidonine substituted by a methyl group at position 13. Isolated from the aerial parts of Corydalis incisa, it acts as an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor and also exhibits antineoplastic and hepatoprotective activity. It has a role as a metabolite, an EC 3.1.1.7 (acetylcholinesterase) inhibitor, an antineoplastic agent and a hepatoprotective agent. It is a member of isoquinolines, an organic heterohexacyclic compound, a secondary alcohol, a cyclic acetal and a benzophenanthridine alkaloid. It is functionally related to a chelidonine.

Name: 5'-hydroxystreptomycin
Description: This molecule is a streptomycin bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at the 5'-position (on the furanose ring) It is functionally related to a streptomycin.

Name: (R)-canadine
Description: This molecule is a canadine which has R configuration. It is an enantiomer of a (S)-canadine.

Name: Dehydrocorydalmine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Corylidin
Description: This molecule is a member of coumestans.

Name: Reticuline
Description: This molecule is an isoquinolinol, a benzyltetrahydroisoquinoline and a benzylisoquinoline alkaloid. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a conjugate base of a reticuline(1+).

Name: Stypandrol
Description: This molecule is a member of biphenyls.

Name: Norglaucin
Description: This molecule is an isoquinoline alkaloid.

Name: (S)-corytuberine
Description: This molecule is an aporphine alkaloid that is aporphine which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 11, and by methoxy groups at positions 2 and 10 (the S enantiomer). It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an aporphine alkaloid, an organic heterotetracyclic compound, a tertiary amino compound, a polyphenol and an aromatic ether.

Name: (S)-glaucine
Description: This molecule is an aporphine alkaloid that is (S)-1,2,9,10-tetrahydroxy-6-methyl-5,6,6a,7-tetrahydro-4H-dibenzo[de,g]quinoline in which the four phenolic hydrogens have been replaced by methyl groups. It has a role as a platelet aggregation inhibitor, a NF-kappaB inhibitor, an antitussive, an antibacterial agent, a muscle relaxant, an antineoplastic agent, a plant metabolite and a rat metabolite. It is an aporphine alkaloid, a polyether, an organic heterotetracyclic compound and a tertiary amino compound. It is a conjugate base of a This molecule(1+).

Name: Capaurine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Isoboldine
Description: This molecule is an aporphine alkaloid.

Name: Noroxyhydrastinine
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: Norisocorydine
Description: This molecule is an isoquinoline alkaloid.

Name: Elaidic acid
Description: This molecule is a 9-octadecenoic acid and the trans-isomer of oleic acid. It has a role as a food component. It is a conjugate acid of an elaidate and an Octadec-9-enoic acid anion. It derives from a hydride of a trans-octadec-9-ene.

Name: Deltoside
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Convallagenin A
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: 7-O-[alpha-L-rhamnosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucosyl]chrysoeriol
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyflavone that is chrysoeriol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 7 is replaced by an alpha-L-rhamnosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucosyl moiety. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a dihydroxyflavone, a glycosyloxyflavone, a monomethoxyflavone and a disaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to a 4',5,7-trihydroxy-3'-methoxyflavone.

Name: Tupichinol A
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: Epiruscogenin
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Norwogonin
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyflavone with the hydroxy groups at positions C-5, -7 and -8. It has a role as an antioxidant and a metabolite.

Name: 6,7-Dihydroxy-1-methyl-N-(6'-fructopyranosyl)-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: 6,7-Dihydroxy-1,1-dimethyl-N-ethyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: Provincialin
Description: This molecule is a germacranolide.

Name: Asparanin B6
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Valerosidatum
Description: This molecule is a terpene glycoside.

Name: Cephalin
Description: This molecule is a phospholipid with the polar ethanolamine found in phosphoester linkage to diacylglycerol.

Name: Alpha-acoradiene
Description: This molecule is a spiro compound that is 1,8-dimethyl-4-(prop-1-en-2-yl)spiro[4.5]decane that has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond at position 8-9 (the 1R,4S,5S isomer). It has a role as a volatile oil component. It is a sesquiterpene and a spiro compound.

Name: 2,5-Dimethylbenzaldehyde
Description: This molecule is a carbonyl compound.

Name: 4-Ethylresorcinol
Description: This molecule is a member of resorcinols.

Name: 2,4-Dimethylbenzaldehyde
Description: This molecule is a carbonyl compound.

Name: Bicycloelemene
Description: This molecule is a carbobicyclic compound that is 7,7-dimethylbicyclo[4.1.0]heptane substituted by prop-1-en-2-yl, ethenyl and methyl groups at positions 2, 3 and 3, respectively (the 1R,2R,3S,6R-stereoisomer). It is a sesquiterpene isolated from the leaves of several plant species. It has a role as a volatile oil component. It is a sesquiterpene, a carbobicyclic compound and an a bicycloelemene.

Name: Brefeldin A
Description: This molecule is a metabolite from Penicillium brefeldianum that exhibits a wide range of antibiotic activity. It has a role as a Penicillium metabolite.

Name: Acetophenone
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with a sweet pungent taste and odor resembling the odor of oranges. Freezes under cool conditions. Slightly soluble in water and denser than water. Hence sinks in water. Vapor heavier than air. A mild irritant to skin and eyes. Vapors can be narcotic in high concentrations. Used as a flavoring, solvent, and polymerization catalyst.

Name: Phthalic anhydride
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless to white lustrous solid in the form of needles with a mild distinctive odor. Moderately toxic by inhalation or ingestion and a skin irritant. Melting point 64 °F Flash point 305 °F. Forms a corrosive solution when mixed with water. Used in the manufacture of materials such as artificial resins.

Name: Cis-isoeugenol
Description: This molecule is an isoeugenol.

Name: Butyraldehyde
Description: This molecule appears as a clear liquid with a pungent odor. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Vapors heavier than air.

Name: Eucalyptin
Description: This molecule is an organic molecular entity.

Name: 5-hydroxyindole
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is 1H-indole in which the hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It has a role as a human metabolite.

Name: 4-ethylphenol
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of phenols carrying an ethyl substituent at position 4. It has a role as a fungal xenobiotic metabolite.

Name: 4-Methyl-6-hepten-3-one
Description: This molecule is a ketone.

Name: Isococculidine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Sedanolide
Description: This molecule is a member of 2-benzofurans.

Name: Undecan-6-ol
Description: This molecule is a secondary alcohol that is undecane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6. It is a secondary alcohol and an undecanol.

Name: 2,4,6-trimethyl-Octane
Description: This molecule is an alkane.

Name: (?)-Camphoric acid
Description: This molecule is a dicarboxylic acid.

Name: Dimethyl camphorate
Description: This molecule is a dicarboxylic acid.

Name: 2,3-dimethylphenol
Description: This molecule appears as colorless crystalline solid or brown chunky solid. Taste threshold concentration 0.03 mg/L. Odor threshold concentration 0.5 mg/L. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Sebiferic acid
Description: This molecule is a steroid acid.

Name: 6-Undecanone
Description: This molecule is a ketone.

Name: 2,4,6-Trimethylbenzaldehyde
Description: This molecule is a carbonyl compound.

Name: 2,3,5-trimethylhydroquinone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of hydroquinones that is hydroquinone substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 3 and 5. It is a member of hydroquinones and a methylbenzene.

Name: 2-methylhexadecanoic acid
Description: This molecule is a methyl-branched fatty acid that is hexadecanoic (palmitic) acid bearing a methyl substituent at position 2. It is a branched-chain saturated fatty acid, a long-chain fatty acid and a methyl-branched fatty acid. It is functionally related to a hexadecanoic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 2-methylhexadecanoate.

Name: 2-Butenoic acid, 2-methyl-, 2-carboxy-2-butenyl ester, (Z,Z)-
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: 3-Ethylphenol
Description: This molecule is a member of phenols.

Name: Phthalic acid
Description: This molecule appears as white crystals or fine white powder. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Chimaphylin
Description: This molecule is a member of 1,4-naphthoquinones.

Name: (-)-antofine
Description: This molecule is an organic heteropentacyclic compound that is (13aR)-9,11,12,13,13a,14-hexahydrodibenzo[f,h]pyrrolo[1,2-b]isoquinoline substituted at positions 2, 3 and 6 by methoxy groups. It is an alkaloid produced by relatives of the milkweed family and exhibits antiviral, anti-inflammatory, antiadipogenic and antitumorigenic activities. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, a plant metabolite, a phytotoxin, an antimicrobial agent, an anti-inflammatory agent, an antiviral agent and an angiogenesis inhibitor. It is an organic heteropentacyclic compound, an aromatic ether, an alkaloid and an alkaloid antibiotic.

Name: 2-acetylphenol
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxyacetophenone that is acetophenone in which one of the hydrogens ortho to the acetyl group has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It has a role as a flavouring agent. It is a monohydroxyacetophenone and a member of phenols.

Name: 2-Methoxy-4-methylphenol
Description: This molecule is a member of phenols and a member of methoxybenzenes.

Name: Sarcostin
Description: This molecule is a corticosteroid hormone.

Name: Tomentolide A
Description: This molecule is a neoflavonoid.

Name: 3-methoxyphenol
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of phenols that is phenol having a methoxy-substituent at the 3-position. It is a member of phenols and a monomethoxybenzene. It is functionally related to a resorcinol.

Name: Oroxylin A 7-O-beta-D-glucuronide
Description: This molecule is the glycosyloxyflavone which is the 7-O-glucuronide of oroxylin A. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a glycosyloxyflavone, a monomethoxyflavone, a monohydroxyflavone, a monosaccharide derivative and a beta-D-glucosiduronic acid. It is functionally related to an oroxylin A. It is a conjugate acid of an oroxylin A 7-O-beta-D-glucuronate.

Name: Alpha-irone
Description: This molecule is a methyl ketone that is alpha-ionone in which a hydrogen at position 5 of the cyclohex-2-en-1-yl ring is substituted by a methyl group. It is a methyl ketone and an enone. It is functionally related to an alpha-ionone.

Name: Calcium acetate
Description: This molecule is the calcium salt of acetic acid. It is used, commonly as a hydrate, to treat hyperphosphataemia (excess phosphate in the blood) in patients with kidney disease: the calcium ion combines with dietary phosphate to form (insoluble) calcium phosphate, which is excreted in the faeces. It has a role as a chelator. It contains an acetate.

Name: (-)-secologanin
Description: This molecule is an iridoid monoterpenoid that is acetaldehyde in which on of the hydrogens of the methyl group has been replaced by a 2-(beta-D-glucopyranosyloxy)-3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran-4-yl group which is substituted at positions 3 and 5 by a vinyl and a methoxycarbonyl group, respectively (the 2S,3R,4S stereoisomer). It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a beta-D-glucoside, a methyl ester, an aldehyde, an enoate ester, a secoiridoid glycoside and a member of pyrans.

Name: Akeboside Std
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Secoxyloganin
Description: This molecule is a secoiridoid glycoside that is [(2R,3R,4S)-2-hydroxy-5-(methoxycarbonyl)-3-vinyl-3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran-4-yl]acetic acid in which the anometric hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding beta-D-glucoside. It has been isolated from several plant species and exhibits antioxidant and anti-allergic properties. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an antioxidant and an anti-allergic agent. It is a methyl ester, a member of pyrans, an enoate ester, a beta-D-glucoside, a monosaccharide derivative, a dicarboxylic acid monoester and a secoiridoid glycoside. It is a conjugate acid of a secoxyloganin(1-).

Name: Akebia saponin D
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin that is hederagenin attached to a alpha-L-arabinopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage and a 6-O-beta-D-glucopyranosyl-beta-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 28 via an ester linkage. It is the active ingredient found in the traditional Chinese herb Radix Dipsaci. It has a role as an apoptosis inducer, an antineoplastic agent, a plant metabolite, an anti-inflammatory agent, a bone density conservation agent, a neuroprotective agent and an antilipemic drug. It is a triterpenoid saponin, a trisaccharide derivative, a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a carboxylic ester. It is functionally related to a hederagenin.

Name: Pseudolycorine
Description: This molecule is a member of phenanthridines.

Name: Lycoramine
Description: This molecule is a benzazepine.

Name: (9Z,11E,13E,15Z)-octadecatetraenoic acid
Description: This molecule is the (9Z,11E,13E,15Z)-isomer of parinaric acid. It is a conjugate acid of a cis-parinarate.

Name: 2-methoxy-1,4-naphthoquinone
Description: This molecule is a naphthoquinone that is naphthalene-1,4-dione substituted by a methoxy group at position 2. It has been isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as a metabolite, an antimicrobial agent and a plant metabolite. It is an enol ether and a member of 1,4-naphthoquinones.

Name: Methyl octanoate
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid. Insoluble in water and about the same density as water. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: 14-Deoxy-11,12-didehydroandrographolide
Description: This molecule is a diterpene lactone. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Cis-5,8,11,14,17-eicosapentaenoic acid methyl ester
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester.

Name: Methyl 9-oxononanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty aldehyde.

Name: Methyl henicosanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of henicosanoic acid with methanol. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a henicosanoic acid.

Name: Cis-11-eicosenoic acid methyl ester
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester.

Name: Methyl palmitoleate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester obtained from the formal condensation of methanol and palmitoleic acid. It is functionally related to a palmitoleic acid.

Name: Cimiracemoside F
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: 25-O-methoxycimigenol 3-O-alpha-L-arabinopyranoside
Description: This molecule is a triterpene glycoside that consists of 25-O-methoxycimigenol attached to a alpha-L-arabinopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage. Isolated from the rhizomes of Cimicifuga racemosa, it exhibits cytotoxic activities. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent and a plant metabolite. It is a triterpenoid saponin, a bridged compound, a cyclic ether, an alpha-L-arabinopyranoside, a monosaccharide derivative and a secondary alcohol. It is functionally related to a cimigenol. It derives from a hydride of a cycloartane.

Name: 5-{6-hydroxy-4-[6-hydroxy-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-4-[2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)ethenyl]-2,3-dihydro-1-benzofuran-3-yl]-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-2,3-dihydro-1-benzofuran-3-yl}benzene-1,3-diol
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: Sequirin C
Description: This molecule is a norlignan that is a derivative of agatharesinol in which the aromatic ring B has an additional hydroxy substituent ortho to the one present in the parent compound. It has a role as a metabolite. It is functionally related to an agatharesinol.

Name: Stizolamine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrazines.

Name: Pinnatin
Description: This molecule is an extended flavonoid.

Name: Chlorphenamine
Description: This molecule is a tertiary amino compound that is propylamine which is substituted at position 3 by a pyridin-2-yl group and a p-chlorophenyl group and in which the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen are replaced by methyl groups. A histamine H1 antagonist, it is used to relieve the symptoms of hay fever, rhinitis, urticaria, and asthma. It has a role as a H1-receptor antagonist, an antipruritic drug, a histamine antagonist, a serotonin uptake inhibitor, an antidepressant and an anti-allergic agent. It is a tertiary amino compound, a member of monochlorobenzenes and a member of pyridines.

Name: Auriculatin
Description: This molecule is a member of isoflavanones.

Name: 2-Acetoxy-5methoxy-6-methyl-3-tridecyl-1,4-benzoquinone
Description: This molecule is a member of p-quinones and a member of benzoquinones.

Name: 2,5-Dimethoxy-6-methyl-3-tridecyl-1,4-benzoquinone
Description: This molecule is a member of p-quinones and a member of benzoquinones.

Name: Glucoraphanin
Description: This molecule is under investigation in clinical trial NCT01879878 (Pilot Study Evaluating Broccoli Sprouts in Advanced Pancreatic Cancer [POUDER Trial]).

Name: 2,6-dihydroxybenzoic acid
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxybenzoic acid having the two hydroxy groups at the C-2 and C-6 positions. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a dihydroxybenzoic acid and a monocarboxylic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 2,6-dihydroxybenzoate.

Name: 24-methylidenelophenol
Description: This molecule is a 3beta-hydroxy steroid. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It derives from a hydride of a stigmastane.

Name: Physalin L
Description: This molecule is a physalin.

Name: Guanidine
Description: This molecule is an aminocarboxamidine, the parent compound of the guanidines. It is a one-carbon compound, a member of guanidines and a carboxamidine. It is a conjugate base of a guanidinium.

Name: Euglobal III
Description: This molecule is a 1-benzopyran.

Name: 5-O-methyl embelin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of monohydroxy-1,4-benzoquinones that is embelin in which the hydroxy group at position 5 is replaced by a methoxy group. Isolated from Lysimachia punctata and Embelia ribes, it exhibits antileishmanial activity as well as inhibitory activity towards hepatitis C protease. It has a role as a metabolite, a hepatitis C protease inhibitor, an antileishmanial agent and an antineoplastic agent. It is an enol ether and a member of monohydroxy-1,4-benzoquinones. It is functionally related to an embelin.

Name: Euglobal Ib
Description: This molecule is a 1-benzopyran.

Name: P-cumic acid
Description: This molecule is a cumic acid that consists of benzoic acid substituted by an isopropyl group at position 4. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a p-cumate.

Name: 2-Methyl-3-(2',3',4'-trihydroxybutyl)pyrazine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrazines.

Name: Alizarin
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyanthraquinone that is anthracene-9,10-dione in which the two hydroxy groups are located at positions 1 and 2. It has a role as a chromophore, a dye and a plant metabolite.

Name: Physovenine
Description: This molecule is a member of indoles.

Name: Sennidin B
Description: This molecule is a member of anthracenes.

Name: Stevenin
Description: This molecule is a neoflavonoid.

Name: 4',5,6,7-tetramethoxyflavone
Description: This molecule is a tetramethoxyflavone that is the tetra-O-methyl derivative of scutellarein. It has a role as an antimutagen and a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a scutellarein.

Name: Isorhamnetin 3-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyflavone that is isorhamnetin substituted at position 3 by a beta-D-glucosyl residue. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a monosaccharide derivative, a glycosyloxyflavone, a monomethoxyflavone, a trihydroxyflavone and a beta-D-glucoside. It is functionally related to an isorhamnetin and a beta-D-glucose.

Description: This molecule is a member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3, 6 and 7. Isolated from Garcinia mangostana and Maclura pomifera, it exhibits inhibitory activity against protein kinase C. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, an EC 2.7.11.13 (protein kinase C) inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a member of xanthones and a polyphenol.

Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyflavone that is apigenin substituted by a methoxy group at position 3. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a trihydroxyflavone and a monomethoxyflavone. It is functionally related to an apigenin.

Name: Phenylacetic acid
Description: This molecule is a monocarboxylic acid that is toluene in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group has been replaced by a carboxy group. It has a role as a toxin, a human metabolite, an Escherichia coli metabolite, a plant metabolite, a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite, an EC 6.4.1.1 (pyruvate carboxylase) inhibitor, an Aspergillus metabolite, a plant growth retardant, an allergen and an auxin. It is a monocarboxylic acid, a member of benzenes and a member of phenylacetic acids. It is functionally related to an acetic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a phenylacetate.

Name: Saponoside D
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Cinchonine
Description: This molecule is cinchonan in which a hydrogen at position 9 is substituted by hydroxy (S configuration). It occurs in the bark of most varieties of Cinchona shrubs, and is frequently used for directing chirality in asymmetric synthesis. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a cinchona alkaloid and an (8xi)-cinchonan-9-ol. It derives from a hydride of a cinchonan.

Description: This molecule is an organosulfur heterocyclic compound.

Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(methylthio)propionic acid with ethanol. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a carboxylic ester and a methyl sulfide. It is functionally related to a 3-(methylthio)propionic acid.

Name: Acetin
Description: This molecule is a clear colorless to pale yellow viscous liquid with a characteristic odor. (NTP, 1992)

Name: 4-Methoxybenzyl alcohol
Description: This molecule is a member of benzyl alcohols.

Name: CE(10:0)
Description: This molecule is a cholesteryl ester.

Name: Butyl hexanoate
Description: This molecule is a hexanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexanoic acid (caproic acid) with butan-1-ol. It is a volatile compound found in apples and peaches. It has a role as a flavouring agent, a human metabolite, a plant metabolite and an insect attractant. It is a hexanoate ester and a volatile organic compound. It is functionally related to a butan-1-ol.

Name: 8-methyl-1-undecene
Description: This molecule is an alkene that is undec-1-ene carrying a methyl substituent at position 8.

Name: Hexanoate
Description: This molecule is a short-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of hexanoic acid (also known as caproic acid). It has a role as a human metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is a short-chain fatty acid anion, a straight-chain saturated fatty acid anion and a fatty acid anion 6:0. It is a conjugate base of a hexanoic acid.

Name: Isovalerate
Description: This molecule is a branched-chain saturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of isovaleric acid; reported to improve ruminal fermentation and feed digestion in cattle. It has a role as a mammalian metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is a short-chain fatty acid anion, a branched-chain saturated fatty acid anion and a 3-methyl fatty acid anion. It is a conjugate base of an isovaleric acid.

Name: 3Z,13Z-octadecadien-1-ol
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty alcohol.

Name: N-propyl benzene
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid. Insoluble in water and less dense than water. Flash point 86 °F. Mildly toxic by ingestion and inhalation. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Isosorbide

Name: Hexyl butyrate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of hexanol with butyric acid. It has a role as an animal metabolite. It is functionally related to a butyric acid and a hexan-1-ol.

Name: Tetraethylene glycol
Description: This molecule is a colorless to straw-colored liquid with a mild odor. Sinks and mixes with water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Tiron
Description: This molecule is an organic molecular entity.

Name: 7,8-dihydroxycoumarin
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycoumarin.

Name: Alpha-methylvaleraldehyde
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid. Less dense than water. Used to make rubber and artificial flavorings.

Name: Paraldehyde
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a pleasant odor. Flash point 96 °F. Melting point 54 °F. Less dense than water. Vapors are heavier than air.

Name: 3-furaldehyde
Description: This molecule is an aldehyde that is furan substituted by a formyl group at position 3. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a member of furans and an aldehyde. It derives from a hydride of a furan.

Name: Octyl butanoate
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester.

Name: 4-(2,6,6-Trimethyl-1-cyclohexenyl)-2-butanol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Chlorhexidine
Description: This molecule is a bisbiguanide compound with a structure consisting of two (p-chlorophenyl)guanide units linked by a hexamethylene bridge. It has a role as an antiinfective agent and an antibacterial agent. It is a member of biguanides and a member of monochlorobenzenes. It is functionally related to a biguanide.

Name: Dodecanoic anhydride
Description: This molecule is an acyclic carboxylic anhydride resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy groups of two molecules of dodecanoic acid. It is functionally related to a dodecanoic acid.

Name: Hexyl octanoate
Description: This molecule is an octanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of octanoic acid with hexan-1-ol. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a hexan-1-ol.

Name: Hexyl hexanoate
Description: This molecule is a hexanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexanoic acid (caproic acid) with hexan-1-ol. It is a constituent found in passion fruit, apples, strawberries and wine. It has a role as a plant metabolite, a volatile oil component, a flavouring agent and a fragrance. It is functionally related to a hexan-1-ol.

Name: (S)-propane-1,2-diol
Description: This molecule is a propane-1,2-diol. It has a role as a human metabolite and an Escherichia coli metabolite. It is an enantiomer of a (R)-propane-1,2-diol.

Name: Ethyl 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate
Description: This molecule is an ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid with ethanol. It is the anti-oxidative component of peanut seed testa. It has a role as an EC 1.14.11.2 (procollagen-proline dioxygenase) inhibitor, an antibacterial agent, an antioxidant, an apoptosis inducer and a plant metabolite. It is an ethyl ester and a member of catechols. It is functionally related to a 3,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid.

Name: 1,3,5-trimethylbenzene
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with a peculiar odor. Insoluble in water and less dense than water. Flash point near 123 °F. May be toxic by ingestion and inhalation. Used to make plastics and dyes.

Name: Diacetone alcohol
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a pleasant odor. Flash point below 141 °F. Less dense than water. Vapors heavier than air.

Name: 1,1,6-trimethyltetralin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of tetralins that is tetralin substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 1 and 6 respectively. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a member of tetralins and an ortho-fused bicyclic hydrocarbon. It derives from a hydride of a tetralin.

Name: Vomicine
Description: This molecule is a member of carbazoles.

Name: (2R,3R,4S)-2-({[(1S)-2-hydroxy-1-phenylethyl]amino}methyl)pyrrolidine-3,4-diol
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxypyrrolidine.

Name: 1,6-Dihydroxy-3,5,7-trimethoxyxanthone
Description: This molecule is a member of xanthones.

Name: Capillin
Description: This molecule is a ynone and an aromatic ketone.

Name: Deguelin
Description: This molecule is a rotenone that is 13,13a-dihydro-3H-chromeno[3,4-b]pyrano[2,3-h]chromen-7(7aH)-one substituted by methoxy groups at positions 9 and 10, and by two methyl groups at position 3 (the 7aS,13aS-stereoisomer). It exists in abundant quantities in the bark, roots, and leaves of the Leguminosae family of plants and reported to exert anti-tumour effects in various cancers. It has a role as an apoptosis inducer, an antineoplastic agent, a plant metabolite, an angiogenesis inhibitor, an antiviral agent, a mitochondrial NADH:ubiquinone reductase inhibitor, an anti-inflammatory agent and an EC 2.7.11.1 (non-specific serine/threonine protein kinase) inhibitor. It is a member of rotenones, an aromatic ether, an organic heteropentacyclic compound and a diether.

Name: Grayanotoxin I
Description: This molecule is a tetracyclic diterpenoid that is grayanotoxane in which the pro-R hydrogen at position 14 is substituted by an acetoxy group and in which the 3beta-, 5-, 6beta-, 10-, and 16- positions are substituted by hydroxy groups. It has a role as a phytotoxin, an antihypertensive agent, a metabolite and a neuromuscular agent. It is a tetracyclic diterpenoid, a pentol, a tertiary alcohol, a secondary alcohol and an acetate ester. It derives from a hydride of a grayanotoxane.

Name: (+)-trans-fustin
Description: This molecule is the (2R,3R)-stereoisomer of fustin.

Name: Rhombifoline
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Wogonin 7-O-beta-D-glucuronide
Description: This molecule is the glycosyloxyflavone which is the 7-O-glucuronide of wogonin. It is a glycosyloxyflavone, a monomethoxyflavone, a monohydroxyflavone, a monosaccharide derivative and a beta-D-glucosiduronic acid. It is functionally related to a wogonin. It is a conjugate acid of a wogonin 7-O-beta-D-glucuronate.

Name: Butylated hydroxyanisole
Description: This molecule appears as white, beige or slightly yellow waxy solid with an aromatic odor and a slightly bitter burning taste. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Collidine
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Hence floats on water. Vapors heavier than air. Produces toxic oxides of nitrogen during combustion. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Baicalein
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyflavone with the hydroxy groups at positions C-5, -6 and -7. It has a role as an antioxidant, a hormone antagonist, a prostaglandin antagonist, an EC 1.13.11.31 (arachidonate 12-lipoxygenase) inhibitor, an EC 1.13.11.33 (arachidonate 15-lipoxygenase) inhibitor, a radical scavenger, an EC 3.4.21.26 (prolyl oligopeptidase) inhibitor, an anti-inflammatory agent, a plant metabolite, a ferroptosis inhibitor, an anticoronaviral agent, an EC 3.4.22.69 (SARS coronavirus main proteinase) inhibitor, an angiogenesis inhibitor, an antineoplastic agent, an EC 4.1.1.17 (ornithine decarboxylase) inhibitor, an antibacterial agent, an antifungal agent, an apoptosis inducer and a geroprotector. It is a conjugate acid of a baicalein(1-).

Name: Negletein
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: Acetone
Description: This molecule is a manufactured chemical that is also found naturally in the environment. It is a colorless liquid with a distinct smell and taste. It evaporates easily, is flammable, and dissolves in water. It is also called dimethyl ketone, 2-propanone, and beta-ketopropane. This molecule is used to make plastic, fibers, drugs, and other chemicals. It is also used to dissolve other substances. It occurs naturally in plants, trees, volcanic gases, forest fires, and as a product of the breakdown of body fat. It is present in vehicle exhaust, tobacco smoke, and landfill sites. Industrial processes contribute more acetone to the environment than natural processes.

Name: 10-undecenal
Description: This molecule is an undecenal.

Name: n-Hexane
Description: This molecule is a chemical made from crude oil. Pure This molecule is a colorless liquid with a slightly disagreeable odor. It is highly flammable, and its vapors can be explosive. PureThis molecule is used in laboratories. Most of theThis molecule used in industry is mixed with similar chemicals called solvents. The major use for solvents containing This molecule is to extract vegetable oils from crops such as soybeans. These solvents are also used as cleaning agents in the printing, textile, furniture, and shoemaking industries. Certain kinds of special glues used in the roofing and shoe and leather industries also contain This molecule. Several consumer products containThis molecule, such as gasoline, quick-drying glues used in various hobbies, and rubber cement. .

Name: Lapachol
Description: This molecule is a hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone that is 1,4-naphthoquinone substituted by hydroxy and 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl groups at positions 2 and 3, respectively. It is a natural compound that exhibits antibacterial and anticancer properties, first isolated in 1882 from the bark of Tabebuia avellanedae. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an antineoplastic agent, an antibacterial agent and an anti-inflammatory agent. It is a hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone and an olefinic compound.

Name: Chrysin
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyflavone in which the two hydroxy groups are located at positions 5 and 7. It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent, an antineoplastic agent, an antioxidant, a hepatoprotective agent, an EC 2.7.11.18 (myosin-light-chain kinase) inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a dihydroxyflavone and a 7-hydroxyflavonol.

Name: Chrysin 7-glucuronide
Description: This molecule is a glucosiduronic acid and a member of flavonoids.

Name: Trans-Brassidic acid
Description: This molecule is a very long-chain fatty acid.

Name: Beta-lapachone
Description: This molecule is a benzochromenone that is 3,4-dihydro-2H-benzo[h]chromene-5,6-dione substituted by geminal methyl groups at position 2. Isolated from Tabebuia avellanedae, it exhibits antineoplastic and anti-inflammatory activities. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, an anti-inflammatory agent and a plant metabolite. It is a benzochromenone and a member of orthoquinones.

Name: Mosloflavone
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: Chrysin-7-O-glucuronide
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glucosiduronic acid.

Name: 6-hydroxyluteolin
Description: This molecule is a pentahydroxyflavone that is luteolin with an additional hydroxy group at position 6. It is functionally related to a luteolin.

Name: 5-methyl-2,3-dihydrofuran
Description: This molecule is a dihydrofuran.

Name: 2-methyltridecane
Description: This molecule is a long-chain alkane that is tridecane substituted by a methyl group at position 2. Metabolite observed in cancer metabolism. It has a role as a human metabolite. It derives from a hydride of a tridecane.

Name: Ethyl undecanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: But-3-yn-1-ol
Description: This molecule is a terminal acetylenic compound that is but-1-yne with one of the methyl hydrogens substituted by a hydroxy group. It is a terminal acetylenic compound and a member of butyn-1-ols.

Name: Sulfonyldimethane
Description: This molecule is a sulfone.

Name: Herbacetin
Description: This molecule is a pentahydroxyflavone that is kaempferol substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8. It is a natural flavonoid from flaxseed which exerts antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and anticancer activities. It has a role as an EC 4.1.1.17 (ornithine decarboxylase) inhibitor, an antineoplastic agent, an apoptosis inducer, an angiogenesis inhibitor, a plant metabolite, an antilipemic drug, an anti-inflammatory agent and an EC 3.4.22.69 (SARS coronavirus main proteinase) inhibitor. It is a pentahydroxyflavone and a 7-hydroxyflavonol. It is functionally related to a kaempferol.

Name: Undecane, 2-methyl-
Description: This molecule is an alkane.

Name: Dimethyl glutarate
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid. (USCG, 1999)

Name: 3-hydroxybenzoic acid
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3. It has been isolated from Taxus baccata. It is used as an intermediate in the synthesis of plasticisers, resins, pharmaceuticals, etc. It has a role as a bacterial metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a benzoic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 3-hydroxybenzoate.

Name: 4-methoxycinnamic acid
Description: This molecule is a methoxycinnamic acid having a single methoxy substituent at the 4-position on the phenyl ring. It is functionally related to a cinnamic acid.

Name: 3,3-dimethylhexane
Description: This molecule is an alkane that is hexane in which the two methylene hydrogens at position 3 have been replaced by methyl groups.

Name: Butyl acetate
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a fruity odor. Flash point 72 - 88 °F. Density 7.4 lb / gal (less than water). Hence floats on water. Vapors heavier than air.

Name: Fluorene
Description: This molecule is a white leaflets. Sublimes easily under a vacuum. Fluorescent when impure. (NTP, 1992)

Name: 1,2,4-trimethylbenzene
Description: This molecule appears as a liquid. Flash point near 130 °F. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Vapors irritate eyes, throat, and nose. Used in dyes and pharmaceuticals.

Name: Palustrine
Description: This molecule is a lactam and an azamacrocycle.

Name: Benethamine
Description: This molecule is an aromatic amine that is 2-phenylethanamine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the amino group is substituted by a benzyl group.

Name: Syringate
Description: This molecule is a methoxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of syringic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. It is a methoxybenzoate and a hydroxybenzoate. It is a conjugate base of a syringic acid.

Name: Monomethyl glutaric acid
Description: This molecule is a dicarboxylic acid monoester that the monomethyl ester of glutaric acid. It has a role as a human urinary metabolite. It is functionally related to a glutaric acid.

Name: Kaempferol 3,7-di-O-beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol having two beta-D-glucosyl residues attached at positions O-3 and O-7. Isolated from the aerial parts of Delphinium staphisagria, it exhibits trypanocidal activity. It has a role as a trypanocidal drug and a plant metabolite. It is a beta-D-glucoside, a kaempferol O-glucoside and a dihydroxyflavone.

Name: 2,4-dimethylheptane
Description: This molecule is an alkane that is heptane in which a hydrogen has been replaced by a methyl group at positions 2 and 4. It has a role as a fungal metabolite. It is an alkane and a volatile organic compound.

Name: 1,4-Dideoxy-1,4-imino-arabinitol
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrrolidines.

Name: Scullcapflavone II
Description: This molecule is a tetramethoxyflavone that is flavone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 6, 7, 8 and 6' and hydroxy groups at positons 5 and 2' respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an anti-asthmatic drug and an EC 1.6.5.2 [NAD(P)H dehydrogenase (quinone)] inhibitor. It is a tetramethoxyflavone and a dihydroxyflavone. It is functionally related to a flavone.

Name: 4'-Prenyloxyresveratrol
Description: This molecule is a stilbenoid.

Name: Calceolarioside B
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Dihydronepetalactone
Description: This molecule is a terpene lactone.

Name: Cycloolivil
Description: This molecule is a lignan.

Name: Akebonic acid
Description: This molecule is an organic hydroxy compound. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Daphnoline
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines and a bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloid.

Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone isolated from Saussureae Radix and has been shown to exhibit inhibitory activity against melanogenesis. It has a role as a melanin synthesis inhibitor and a metabolite. It is an organic heterotricyclic compound, a sesquiterpene lactone and a tertiary alcohol.

Name: Celabenzine
Description: This molecule is a cyclic spermidine alkaloid that is 2-phenyl-1,5,9-triazacyclotridecan-4-one in which the amino hydrogen at position 9 has been replaced by a benzoyl group. It is a member of benzamides, a spermidine alkaloid, a lactam and an azamacrocycle.

Name: Germacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-al
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid resulting formally from germacrane by oxidation at C(12) together with dehydrogenation across the C(1)-C(10), C(4)-C(5) and C(11)-C(13) bonds. It derives from a hydride of a germacrene A.

Name: Germacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-ol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid resulting formally from germacrane by hydroxylation at C(12) together with dehydrogenation across the C(1)-C(10), C(4)-C(5) and C(11)-C(13) bonds. It derives from a hydride of a germacrene A.

Name: 3,6,9-Trimethylidene-3a,4,5,6a,7,8,9a,9b-octahydroazuleno[4,5-b]furan-2-one
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: Santamarin
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone of the eudesmanolide group.

Name: Cyclooctadienes
Description: This molecule appears as a liquid. May irritate skin and eyes. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Used to make rubber.

Name: Cyclododecanone
Description: This molecule is a cyclic ketone.

Name: Tridecanal
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty aldehyde that is tridecane in which two hydrogens attached to a terminal carbon are replaced by an oxo group. It has a role as a human metabolite and a volatile oil component. It is a saturated fatty aldehyde, a n-alkanal and a long-chain fatty aldehyde. It derives from a hydride of a tridecane.

Name: Beta-Costol
Description: This molecule is a eudesmane sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Cotarnine
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: Zaluzanin C
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone that is decahydroazuleno[4,5-b]furan-2(3H)-one substituted by methylidene groups at positions 3, 6 and 9 and a hydroxy group at position 8. It has a role as an EC 1.14.13.39 (nitric oxide synthase) inhibitor and a metabolite. It is a gamma-lactone, a guaiane sesquiterpenoid, an organic heterotricyclic compound, a sesquiterpene lactone and a secondary alcohol.

Name: Savinin
Description: This molecule is a lignan that is dihydrofuran-2(3H)-one (gamma-butyrolactone) substituted by a 1,3-benzodioxol-5-ylmethylidene group at position 3 and a 1,3-benzodioxol-5-ylmethyl group at position 4 (the 3E,4R-isomer). It exhibits antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2. It has a role as a T-cell proliferation inhibitor, an anti-inflammatory agent, a plant metabolite, an EC 3.4.22.69 (SARS coronavirus main proteinase) inhibitor and an anticoronaviral agent. It is a member of benzodioxoles, a lignan and a gamma-lactone.

Name: Isozaluzanin C
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Description: This molecule is a mineral with formula of HgS. The IMA symbol is Cin.

Description: This molecule is a xanthophyll.

Name: 2,6-Decamethylene pyridine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyridines.

Name: Pinoresinol diglucoside
Description: This molecule is a lignan and a glycoside.

Name: Helenalin
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone that is 3,3a,4,4a,7a,8,9,9a-octahydroazuleno[6,5-b]furan-2,5-dione substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4, methyl groups at positions 4a and 8 and a methylidene group at position 3 (the 3aS,4S,4aR,7aR,8R,9aR stereoisomer). It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent, an antineoplastic agent, a plant metabolite and a metabolite. It is a gamma-lactone, a cyclic ketone, an organic heterotricyclic compound, a sesquiterpene lactone and a secondary alcohol.

Name: Dehydrodieugenol
Description: This molecule is a member of biphenyls.

Name: 8-Hydroxypinoresinol
Description: This molecule is a lignan.

Name: Cyrtopterin
