Name: Myricetin 3-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside
Description: This molecule is a myricetin O-glucoside that is myricetin with a beta-D-glucosyl residue attached at position 3. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a myricetin O-glucoside, a beta-D-glucoside, a monosaccharide derivative and a pentahydroxyflavone. It is functionally related to a beta-D-glucose. It is a conjugate acid of a myricetin 3-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside(1-).

Name: Gossypin
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyflavone that is gossypetin attached to a beta-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 8 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a neuroprotective agent and a plant metabolite. It is a 7-hydroxyflavonol, a pentahydroxyflavone, a glycosyloxyflavone and a monosaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to a gossypetin.

Name: Iberin
Description: This molecule is an isothiocyanate that is 1-isothiocyanatopropane in which a hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a methylsulfinyl group. A glucosinolate hydrolysis product found in many members of the Brassicaceae family, it is a quorum-sensing inhibitor (QSI) of the bacterial pathogen Pseudomonas aeruginosa. It has a role as a quorum sensing inhibitor, a plant metabolite and an apoptosis inducer. It is a sulfoxide and an isothiocyanate.

Name: Methylmethionine sulfonium salt
Description: This molecule is an organic molecular entity.

Name: Homomethionine
Description: This molecule is a sulfur-containing amino acid and a non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate acid of a homomethioninate.

Name: Progoitrin
Description: This molecule is the stereoisomer of xi-progoitrin that has R at the carbon bearing the allylic hydroxy group. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a progoitrin(1-).

Name: O-heptadecanoylcarnitine
Description: This molecule is an O-acylcarnitine in which the acyl group is specified as heptadecanoyl. It has a role as a rat metabolite, a human metabolite and a biomarker. It is functionally related to a heptadecanoic acid.

Name: Dodecanoate
Description: This molecule is a medium-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of dodecanoic acid (lauric acid); major species at pH 7.3. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite. It is a straight-chain saturated fatty acid anion, a medium-chain fatty acid anion, a fatty acid anion 12:0, an omega-methyl fatty acid anion and an omega-methyl-medium-chain fatty acid anion. It is a conjugate base of a dodecanoic acid.

Name: 3'-Hydroxy-4',5,6,7,8-pentamethoxyflavone
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: Citromitin
Description: This molecule is an ether and a member of flavonoids.

Name: 1-methyl-3-(1-methylethyl)-Cyclohexane
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: (+)-cis-sabinol
Description: This molecule is a sabinol. It is an enantiomer of a (-)-cis-sabinol.

Name: Isopropenyl toluene b
Description: This molecule is an olefinic compound.

Name: Sudachitin
Description: This molecule is an ether and a member of flavonoids.

Name: Beta-colubrine
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid indole alkaloid that is strychnine in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a methoxy group. It is a minor alkaloid from Strychnos nux-vomica. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a monoterpenoid indole alkaloid, an organic heteroheptacyclic compound and an aromatic ether. It is functionally related to a strychnine. It is a conjugate base of a beta-colubrine(1+).

Name: Tropinium
Description: This molecule is conjugate acid of tropine arising from protonation of the tertiary amino group. It is a conjugate acid of a tropine.

Name: 2-(hydroxymethyl)anthraquinone
Description: This molecule is an anthraquinone. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Strychnine
Description: This molecule appears as colorless, transparent crystals or white crystalline powder. Has no odor. Used for destroying rodents and predatory animals and for trapping fur-bearing animals. (EPA, 1998)

Name: Aurantiacone
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: L-Quebrachitol
Description: This molecule is a member of cyclohexanols.

Name: Cis-4-hydroxy-L-proline
Description: This molecule is l-Proline in which a hydrogen at the 4-position of the pyrrolidine ring is substituted by a hydroxy group (S-configuration). It has a role as a metabolite. It is a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid and a 4-hydroxyproline. It is a tautomer of a cis-4-hydroxy-L-proline zwitterion.

Name: Pyridine, 4-amino-
Description: This molecule is a white crystalline material with no odor. Used as an avicide, an intermediate and as a fixer for some textile dyes. (EPA, 1998)  It has been approved by the FDA for use as a treatment for multiple sclerosis.

Name: 2,4-Dimethylpentane
Description: This molecule is a hydrocarbon and one of the isomers of heptane. Heptanes may be found in gasoline and are widely used as solvents. They are also sold as fuel for outdoor stoves. (L1289)

Name: Terminaline
Description: This molecule is a corticosteroid hormone.

Name: Beta-santalol
Description: This molecule is a norbornane monoterpenoid and a member of penten-1-ols.

Name: 1-Methylpyrrole
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrroles.

Name: Alpha-Bergamotenol
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Beta-picoline
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid with a sweetish odor. (NTP, 1992)

Name: 1,2,3-trilinoleoylglycerol
Description: This molecule is a triglyceride formed by acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol with linoleic acid. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It is a triglyceride, a TG(18:2/18:2/18:2), a linoleoyl containing 1,2,3-triacyl-sn-glycerol, a 1,2-diacyl-3-linoleoylglycerol and a 1,3-diacyl-2-linoleoylglycerol. It is functionally related to a linoleic acid.

Name: Teresantalol
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Ketosantalic acid
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Ethyl isopropyl ketone
Description: This molecule is a ketone.

Name: Dendrolasin
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Orobol
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones which consists of isoflavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 3' and 4'. It has been isolated from the mycelia of Cordyceps sinensis. It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent, a radical scavenger, a plant metabolite and a fungal metabolite. It is functionally related to an isoflavone.

Name: 3,4-methylenedioxymethamphetamine
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of benzodioxoles that is 1,3-benzodioxole substituted by a 2-(methylamino)propyl group at position 5. It has a role as a neurotoxin. It is a member of amphetamines and a member of benzodioxoles.

Name: Hop-17(21)-ene
Description: This molecule is a triterpene consisting of hopane having a C=C double bond at the 17(21)-position. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a bacterial metabolite. It derives from a hydride of a hopane.

Name: Daphnetoxin
Description: This molecule is a daphnane-type orthoester diterpene with potential cholesterol-lowering activity, found exclusively in plants of the family Thymelaeaceae. It is a diterpene alkaloid, an ortho ester, an epoxide and a tertiary alpha-hydroxy ketone. It is functionally related to a daphnane.

Name: Daphnin
Description: This molecule is a beta-D-glucoside. It is functionally related to a 7,8-dihydroxycoumarin.

Name: Caffeoylmalic acid
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Marrubiin
Description: This molecule is a gamma-lactone.

Name: Prenyl caffeate
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Premarrubiin
Description: This molecule is a gamma-lactone.

Name: Glucobarbarin
Description: This molecule is a glucosinolic acid.

Name: Oleandrose
Description: This molecule is a dideoxyhexose derivative.

Name: Cis-trans-nepetalactone
Description: This molecule is a cyclopentapyran that is (4aS,7aR)-1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran substituted at position 1 by an oxo group and at positions 4 and 7 by methyl groups, respectively (the 4aS,7S,7aR-diastereomer). An iridoid monoterpenoid isolated from several Nepeta plant species. It is an aphid sex pheromone and cat attractant, and exhibits antibacterial, antifungal, and analgesic properties. It has a role as a pheromone, a plant metabolite, an insect attractant, an analgesic, an insect repellent, an antibacterial agent and an antifungal agent. It is an iridoid monoterpenoid and a cyclopentapyran.

Name: Quassimarin
Description: This molecule is a quassinoid isolated from Quassia amara and Leitneria floridana and has been shown to exhibit antitumour activity. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent and a metabolite. It is a quassinoid, a delta-lactone, an organic heteropentacyclic compound, a cyclic ether, an enone, a triol, an acetate ester and a bridged compound.

Name: All-trans-neoxanthin
Description: This molecule is a neoxanthin in which all of the double bonds have trans geometry. It has a role as a biological pigment and a plant metabolite.

Name: Brassinolide
Description: This molecule is a 2alpha-hydroxy steroid, a 3alpha-hydroxy steroid, a 22-hydroxy steroid, a 23-hydroxy steroid and a brassinosteroid. It has a role as a plant growth stimulator and a plant hormone.

Name: Methoxybrassinin
Description: This molecule is a member of indoles.

Name: L-sorbopyranose
Description: This molecule is the L-stereoisomer of sorbopyranose. It is a sorbopyranose and a L-sorbose.

Name: Soularubinone
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Aucuparin
Description: This molecule is a member of biphenyls.

Name: Ptelatoside B
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Ptelatoside A
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Tinyatoxin
Description: This molecule is a heteropentacyclic compound found in Euphorbia poissonii with molecular formula C36H38O8. It is an agonist of the transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 1 (TrpV1). It has a role as a plant metabolite, a neurotoxin and a TRPV1 agonist. It is a diterpenoid, an ortho ester, an organic heteropentacyclic compound, an enone, a member of phenols, a carboxylic ester and a tertiary alpha-hydroxy ketone.

Name: 6-Hydroxytremetone
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: Beta-Solamarine
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Alpha-Solamarine
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Neotussilagolactone
Description: This molecule is a terpene lactone.

Name: 1-decene
Description: This molecule is a colorless watery liquid with a pleasant odor. Floats on water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: 1,12-Tridecadiene
Description: This molecule is an alkadiene.

Name: Farfugin A
Description: This molecule is a naphthofuran.

Name: 2-Ethylbutanoic acid
Description: This molecule is a branched-chain fatty acid.

Name: 1-undecene
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with a mild odor. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Hence floats on water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Quercetin 4'-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside
Description: This molecule is a quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin with a beta-D-glucosyl residue attached at position 4'. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an antioxidant and an antineoplastic agent. It is a beta-D-glucoside, a monosaccharide derivative, a quercetin O-glucoside, a tetrahydroxyflavone and a member of flavonols. It is functionally related to a beta-D-glucose. It is a conjugate acid of a quercetin 4'-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside(1-).

Name: Gallotannin
Description: This molecule is a class of hydrolysable tannins obtained by condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid (and its polymeric derivatives) with the hydroxy groups of a monosaccharide (most commonly glucose). It is functionally related to a gallic acid.

Name: (S)-2-methylbutyric acid
Description: This molecule is the (S)-enantiomer of 2-methylbutanoic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a (S)-2-methylbutanoate. It is an enantiomer of a (R)-2-methylbutyric acid.

Name: Benzamide
Description: This molecule is a white powder. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Letrozole
Description: This molecule is a member of triazoles and a nitrile. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent and an EC 1.14.14.14 (aromatase) inhibitor.

Name: Gramine(1+)
Description: This molecule is an organic cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino function of gramine; major species at pH 7.3. It is an ammonium ion derivative and an organic cation. It is a conjugate acid of a gramine.

Name: Dextrin
Description: This molecule is a metabolite found in or produced by Escherichia coli (strain K12, MG1655).

Name: Ethylene glycol monobutyl ether
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid with a mild, pleasant odor. Less dense than water. Flash point 160 °F. Irritates skin and eyes and may be toxic by ingestion. Used as a solvent and to make paints and varnish.

Name: Tussilagine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrrolizines.

Name: Delta1-nonen-3-ol
Description: This molecule is an aliphatic alcohol.

Name: 1-nonene
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid with an odor of gasoline. Floats on water. Flammable, irritating vapor is produced.

Name: Sitoindoside I
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin that is sitosterol attached to a 6-O-hexadecanoyl-beta-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from Breynia fruticosa. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a fatty acid ester, a steroid saponin, a beta-D-glucoside and a monosaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to a hexadecanoic acid and a sitosterol. It derives from a hydride of a stigmastane.

Name: Gamma-elemene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene that is cyclohexane substituted at positions 1, 1, 2, and 4 by methyl, vinyl, isopropenyl and isopropylidene groups, respectively (the S,S stereoisomer). It has a role as a plant metabolite and a volatile oil component. It is a sesquiterpene, a monocyclic hydrocarbon and an olefinic compound.

Name: Conessine
Description: This molecule is a steroid alkaloid that is con-5-enine substituted by a N,N-dimethylamino group at position 3. It has been isolated from the plant species of the family Apocynaceae. It has a role as an antibacterial agent, an antimalarial, a H3-receptor antagonist and a plant metabolite. It is a steroid alkaloid and a tertiary amino compound. It is functionally related to a conanine.

Name: Condelphine
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: Dihydroconiferyl alcohol
Description: This molecule is a member of class of phenols that is 2-methoxyphenol substituted by a 3-hydroxypropyl group at position 4. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a primary alcohol and a eugenol.

Name: Kurchessine
Description: This molecule is an aza-steroid.

Name: Hydroquinidine
Description: This molecule is under investigation in clinical trial NCT00927732 (This molecule Versus Placebo in Patients With Brugada Syndrome).

Name: Hydroquinine
Description: This molecule is a cinchona alkaloid.

Name: Pseudoconhydrine
Description: This molecule is a citraconoyl group.

Name: (+)-N-methylconiine
Description: This molecule is a piperidine that is (+)-coniine bering an N-methyl substituent. It derives from a hydride of a (+)-coniine.

Name: Eseridine
Description: This molecule is a member of indoles.

Name: (2S)-5-Hydroxy-7-methoxy-8-[(E)-3-oxo-1-butenyl]flavanone
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5, a methoxy group at position 7 and a (1E)-3-oxobut-1-en-1-yl group at position 8. Isolated from Tephrosia toxicaria, it exhibits anti-cancerous activity. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a monohydroxyflavanone, a monomethoxyflavanone, a methyl ketone, an enone and an aromatic ketone. It is functionally related to a (2S)-flavanone.

Name: Obovatin
Description: This molecule is an extended flavonoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Podophyllin
Description: This molecule is a resin extracted from the roots of Podophyllum peltatum (American mandrake) and Podophyllum emodi, which contains numerous compounds, amongst which is podophyllin (as well as the drug [podophyllotoxin]). This molecule is the principal active component. This molecule arrests mitosis in metaphase.

Name: Octadiene
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Vapors heavier than air. May be mildly toxic by inhalation and ingestion. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Cicutoxin
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty alcohol.

Name: Nigakilactone K
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Isoterchebin
Description: This molecule is a tannin.

Name: Piperenol B
Description: This molecule is a benzoate ester.

Name: (+)-Zeylenol
Description: This molecule is a benzoate ester.

Name: Hemiariensin
Description: This molecule is a lignan.

Name: Piperenol A
Description: This molecule is a benzoate ester.

Name: Annocherine B
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: Momorcharaside A
Description: This molecule is a cucurbitacin and a glycoside.

Name: Jervine
Description: This molecule is a member of piperidines.

Name: Digitoxin
Description: This molecule appears as odorless white or pale buff microcrystalline powder. Used as a cardiotonic drug. (EPA, 1998)

Name: Tropine
Description: This molecule is a derivative of tropane having a hydroxy group at the 3-position. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It is a conjugate base of a tropinium.

Name: Pseudoyohimbine
Description: This molecule is a methyl 17-hydroxy-20xi-yohimban-16-carboxylate.

Name: 3,6-Ditigloyloxytropan-7-ol
Description: This molecule is a tropane alkaloid.

Name: Meteloidine
Description: This molecule is a tropane alkaloid.

Name: Divaricoside
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside.

Name: 3-heptadecylcatechol
Description: This molecule is catechol substituted at position 3 with a heptadecyl group.

Name: Labriformin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside.

Name: Labriformidin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside.

Name: Eriocarpin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside.

Name: 3',7-Dihydroxy-4',8-dimethoxyisoflavone
Description: This molecule is an isoflavonoid.

Name: Erysonine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: 5,7,3',4'-Tetrahydroxy-6,8-dimethoxyflavone
Description: This molecule is an ether and a member of flavonoids.

Name: Maoecrystal M
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Anolignan B
Description: This molecule is a lignan that consists of buta-1,3-diene substituted by 4-hydroxybenzyl groups at positions 2 and 3. It is isolated from the ground stems of Anogeissus acuminata and exhibits anti-HIV activity by inhibiting HIV-1 reverse transcriptase enzyme. It has a role as a metabolite and a HIV-1 reverse transcriptase inhibitor. It is a lignan and a member of phenols.

Name: Gemin A
Description: This molecule is a tannin.

Name: Gein
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: (2S)-8-formyl-5-hydroxy-7-methoxy-6-methylflavanone
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5, a methoxy group at position 7, a methyl group at position 6 and a formyl group at position 8. Isolated from Cleistocalyx operculatus, it has been shown to exhibit inhibitory effects on the viral neuraminidases from two influenza viral strains, H1N1 and H9N2. It has a role as an EC 3.2.1.18 (exo-alpha-sialidase) inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is a monohydroxyflavanone, a monomethoxyflavanone and an aldehyde.

Name: Diethyl sulfide
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless oily liquid with a garlic-like odor. Less dense than water. Vapors heavier than air. May irritate skin and eyes. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Totarol
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Panose
Description: This molecule is a trisaccharide composed of D-glucopyranose units. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: Jurubine
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Justicidin A
Description: This molecule is a lignan.

Name: Withanolide D
Description: This molecule is a withanolide that is 5,6:22,26-diepoxyergosta-2,24-diene-1,26-dione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 22 (the 4beta,5beta,6beta,22R stereoisomer). Isolated from Tubocapsicum anomalum and Withania somnifera, it exhibits cytotoxic activity. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent. It is a withanolide, an enone, a delta-lactone, a secondary alcohol, a tertiary alcohol, a 4-hydroxy steroid, a 20-hydroxy steroid, an ergostanoid and an epoxy steroid.

Name: Torvoside H
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin that is (5alpha,6alpha,22R,25S)-6,22,26-trihydroxyfurostan-3-one in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into the beta-D-glucopyranosyl-(1->3)-alpha-L-rhamnoside derivative, while that at position 26 has been converted to its beta-D-glucoside. This molecule is a natural product found in the fruit of Solanum torvum which shows antiviral activity against herpes simplex virus type 1. It has a role as a metabolite and an antiviral agent. It is a steroid saponin, a disaccharide derivative, a cyclic hemiketal, a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a 3-oxo-5alpha-steroid.

Name: Torvanol A
Description: This molecule is an organic potassium salt of torvanol A hydrogen sulfate. Isolated from the fruits of Solanum torvum, it exhibits antiviral activity against herpes simplex virus type 1. It has a role as an anti-HSV-1 agent and a plant metabolite. It contains a torvanol A(1-).

Name: Genipinic acid
Description: This molecule is a dicarboxylic acid.

Name: Isosilychristin
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: Simalikalactone D
Description: This molecule is a quassinoid isolated from Quassia amara and Quassia africana. It has been shown to exhibit antimalarial, cytotoxic and antiviral activities. It has a role as a metabolite, an antineoplastic agent, an antiviral agent and an antimalarial. It is a quassinoid, an organic heteropentacyclic compound, a delta-lactone, a cyclic ether, an enone, a secondary alcohol, a triol and a secondary alpha-hydroxy ketone.

Name: Silychristin
Description: This molecule is a flavonolignan isolated from Silybum marianum and has been shown to exhibit inhibitory activities against lipoxygenase and prostaglandin synthetase. It has a role as a radical scavenger, a lipoxygenase inhibitor, a prostaglandin antagonist and a metabolite. It is a flavonolignan, a member of 1-benzofurans, a polyphenol, an aromatic ether and a secondary alpha-hydroxy ketone.

Name: Stellarine B
Description: This molecule is a harmala alkaloid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: L-alpha-aminobutyric acid
Description: This molecule is an optically active form of alpha-aminobutyric acid having L-configuration. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is an alpha-aminobutyric acid and a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate acid of a L-2-aminobutyrate. It is an enantiomer of a D-alpha-aminobutyric acid. It is a tautomer of a L-alpha-aminobutyrate zwitterion.

Name: Isosilybin A
Description: This molecule is a flavonolignan. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an Aspergillus metabolite, a PPARgamma agonist and an apoptosis inducer.

Name: Silymonin
Description: This molecule is an alkylbenzene and a ring assembly.

Name: Dichotomoside D
Description: This molecule is a neolignan that is dibutyl 3,3'-biphenyl-3,3'-diyldipropanoate substituted by a beta-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 6, hydroxy group at position 6' and methoxy groups at positions 5 and 5' respectively. Isolated from the roots of Stellaria dichotoma var lanceolata, it exhibits anti-allergic activity. It has a role as an anti-allergic agent and a plant metabolite. It is a carboxylic ester, a member of biphenyls, a neolignan, a beta-D-glucoside and a member of guaiacols.

Name: Neosilyhermin B
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: Silibinin
Description: This molecule is a flavonolignan isolated from milk thistle, Silybum marianum, that has been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antineoplastic activities. It has a role as an antioxidant, an antineoplastic agent, a hepatoprotective agent and a plant metabolite. It is a flavonolignan, a polyphenol, an aromatic ether, a benzodioxine and a secondary alpha-hydroxy ketone.

Name: Glucodichotomine B
Description: This molecule is a harmala alkaloid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Silyhermin
Description: This molecule is a member of benzofurans.

Name: (-)-Isopinocamphone
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Tetraneurin A
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: Isobatatasin I
Description: This molecule is a phenanthrol.

Name: Dehydrobufotenine
Description: This molecule is a member of indoles.

Name: Phorbol 13-acetate
Description: This molecule is a phorbol ester.

Name: Clerodendrin A
Description: This molecule is a furofuran.

Name: 6,7-dimethoxy-3-(4-methoxy-6-methyl-7,8-dihydro-5H-[1,3]dioxolo[4,5-g]isoquinolin-5-yl)-3H-isobenzofuran-1-one
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: Alpha-Sinensal
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Brilliant green
Description: This molecule is an organic hydrogensulfate salt having 4-{[4-(diethylamino)phenyl](phenyl)methylidene}-N,N-diethylcyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-iminium as the counterion. It has a role as a fluorochrome, a histological dye, an antiseptic drug, an antibacterial agent, a poison and an environmental contaminant. It contains a brilliant green cation.

Name: 3,4-O-Dimethylgallic acid
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxybenzoic acid.

Name: 4-methoxy-6-methyl-7,8-dihydro-5H-[1,3]dioxolo[4,5-g]isoquinoline
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: Buddlenol B
Description: This molecule is a guaiacyl lignin that is found in Arabidopsis thaliana. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of 1-benzofurans, a dimethoxybenzene, a guaiacyl lignin, a member of phenols, a primary alcohol and a secondary alcohol. It is functionally related to a guaiacylglycerol and a coniferol.

Name: Karounidiol
Description: This molecule is an organic hydroxy compound.

Name: (+)-Karanone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: 1,2-Methylenedioxy-3,4,6-trimethoxydibenzofuran
Description: This molecule is a member of dibenzofurans. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Protohypericin
Description: This molecule is a phenanthrol.

Name: Calligonine
Description: This molecule is a harmala alkaloid.

Name: Cyanidin(1-)
Description: This molecule is an organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 3- and 5-hydroxy groups of cyanidin(1+). It is an organic anion and an anthocyanidin betaine. It is a conjugate base of a cyanidin cation.

Name: Nonadecanal
Description: This molecule is a saturated fatty aldehyde.

Name: Dehydroascorbic acid dimer
Description: This molecule is an organic heteropentacyclic compound obtained by cyclodimerisation of ascorbic acid. It is an organic heteropentacyclic compound, a tetrol and a cyclic hemiketal.

Name: 3-O-Ethylascorbic acid
Description: This molecule is a butenolide.

Name: (9Z)-tricosene
Description: This molecule is a tricosene.

Name: 3-methylbutyl octanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of isoamylol with caprylic acid. It has a role as a metabolite. It is functionally related to an isoamylol and an octanoic acid.

Name: Propyl 3-methylbutanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: Digitonin
Description: This molecule is a spirostanyl glycoside that is digitogenin in which the 3-hydroxy group is substituted by a beta-D-glucopyranosyl-(1->3)-beta-D-galactopyranosyl-(1->2)-[beta-D-xylopyranosyl-(1->3)]-beta-D-glucopyranosyl-(1->4)-beta-D-galactopyranosyl group. It is a steroidal saponin isolated from the foxglove plant, Digitalis purpurea. It is used extensively as a mild non-ionic detergent for extracting proteins from membranes for structure and function studies. It has a role as a detergent and a plant metabolite. It is a spirostanyl glycoside and a pentasaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to a digitogenin.

Name: 5beta-stigmastane
Description: This molecule is a stigmastane.

Name: 5beta-cholestane
Description: This molecule is a cholestane.

Name: Monomethyl phthalate
Description: This molecule is a methyl ester and a phthalic acid monoester.

Name: Decyl alcohol
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a sweet fat-like odor. Flash point 180 °F. Less dense than water and insoluble in water. Vapors are heavier than air.

Name: Cyclohex-2-enone
Description: This molecule is a cyclohexenone having its C=C double bond at the 2-position.

Name: Flavonol
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxyflavone that is the 3-hydroxy derivative of flavone. It is a monohydroxyflavone and a member of flavonols. It is a conjugate acid of a flavonol(1-).

Name: 3-pyridinol
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxypyridine that is pyridine in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It has been detected as a thermal degradation product from the smoke of the burning leaves of Salvia divinorum, a Mexican psychoactive plant.

Name: Ethyl hexanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ethyl ester obtained by the formal condensation of hexanoic acid with ethanol. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a fatty acid ethyl ester and a hexanoate ester.

Name: Quassin
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Lichesterol
Description: This molecule is an ergostanoid.

Name: Cirsimaritin
Description: This molecule is a dimethoxyflavone that is flavone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 6 and 7 and hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 4' respectively. It is a dimethoxyflavone and a dihydroxyflavone. It is functionally related to a flavone.

Name: Heptadecanal
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty aldehyde that is heptadecane carrying an oxo substituent at position 1. It is found in citrus. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a coral metabolite. It is a long-chain fatty aldehyde, a 2,3-saturated fatty aldehyde and a saturated fatty aldehyde.

Name: Butyl 3-methylbutanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: Cis-3-Hexenyl hexanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: (+)-cis-Linalool 3,7-oxide
Description: This molecule is a member of oxanes.

Name: Eburicol
Description: This molecule is a tetracyclic triterpenoid that is 24,25-dihydrolanosterol carrying an additional methylene substituent at position 24. A natural product found in Taiwanofungus camphoratus. It has a role as a fungal metabolite. It is a 3beta-sterol, a tetracyclic triterpenoid and a 14alpha-methyl steroid. It is functionally related to a 24,25-dihydrolanosterol.

Name: Valeryl hexanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: (2S)-flavanone
Description: This molecule is the (S)-enantiomer of flavanone. It is an enantiomer of a (2R)-flavanone.

Name: Canthaxanthin
Description: This molecule is a carotenone that consists of beta,beta-carotene bearing two oxo substituents at positions 4 and 4'. It has a role as a biological pigment, a food colouring, a fungal metabolite and an Escherichia coli metabolite. It derives from a hydride of a beta-carotene.

Name: Isobutyl caproate
Description: This molecule appears as a liquid. Insoluble in water and less dense than water. Contact may irritate skin, eyes and mucous membranes. May be toxic by ingestion, inhalation or skin absorption. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Hemin (trade name Panhematin)
Description: This molecule is an iron-containing porphyrin. More specifically, it is protoporphyrin IX containing a ferric iron ion (heme B) with a chloride ligand.

Name: 4-methylheptane
Description: This molecule is a branched C8 alkane, comprising heptane with a methyl group attached at C-4. It has been found in Amaranth seeds. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: Dimethyl sulfide
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless to straw colored liquid with a disagreeable odor. Flash point less than 0 °F. Less dense than water and slightly soluble in water. Vapors are heavier than air.

Name: All-trans-violaxanthin
Description: This molecule is the all-trans-stereoisomer of violaxanthin. It has a role as a food colouring.

Name: Isobutyl octanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: Eicosanal
Description: This molecule is a saturated fatty aldehyde.

Name: Alpha,alpha-Dimethylphenethyl formate
Description: This molecule is an alkylbenzene.

Name: Digitogenin
Description: This molecule is a 2alpha-hydroxy steroid, a 3beta-hydroxy steroid and a 15beta-hydroxy steroid. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It derives from a hydride of a (25R)-5alpha-spirostan.

Name: 3-methylbutyl hexanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexanoic acid (caproic acid) with the alcoholic hydroxy group of 3-methylbutan-1-ol (isoamylol). It has a role as a metabolite and a fragrance. It is functionally related to an isoamylol.

Name: (S,S,S)-alpha-tocopherol
Description: This molecule is the (S,S,S)-stereoisomer of alpha-tocopherol. It is an enantiomer of a (R,R,R)-alpha-tocopherol.

Name: Stigmasta-4,22-dien-3-one
Description: This molecule is a steroid. It derives from a hydride of a stigmastane.

Name: (Z)-icos-13-enoic acid
Description: This molecule is an icosenoic acid having a cis- double bond at position 13. It has a role as a mouse metabolite, a rat metabolite and a plant metabolite.

Name: Tricetin
Description: This molecule is flavone hydroxylated at positions 3', 4', 5, 5' and 7. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent and a metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a tricetin(1-).

Name: Cryptomeridiol
Description: This molecule is a eudesmane sesquiterpenoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: CEDRELONE
Description: This molecule is a limonoid.

Name: Curzerenone
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: L-erythro-isocitric acid
Description: This molecule is the (1R,2R)-stereoisomer of isocitric acid. It is a conjugate acid of a L-erythro-isocitrate(3-). It is an enantiomer of a D-erythro-isocitric acid.
This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: (8R)-3beta,8-dihydroxypolypoda-13E,17E,21-triene
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid that is decahydronaphthalene substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 1, 4a and 6, hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 6 and a (6E,10E)-2,6,10-trimethyltrideca-2,6,10-trien-13-yl group at position 5. Isolated from resinous exudate of Pistacia lentiscus and Commiphora mukul, it exhibits cytotoxicity towards prostrate cancers. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a triterpenoid, a carbobicyclic compound and a diol.

Name: Ginsenoside III
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Furanodienone
Description: This molecule is a germacrane sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Cabraleadiol monoacetate
Description: This molecule is a tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from Aglaia abbreviata. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of oxolanes, a tetracyclic triterpenoid, an acetate ester and a tertiary alcohol. It derives from a hydride of a dammarane.

Name: Ginsenoside Ra1
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Dimethyl terephthalate
Description: This molecule appears as white solid or heated colorless liquid. Has no odor. Liquid solidifies in cool water. Solid and liquid sink in water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Crinosterol
Description: This molecule is a 3beta-sterol that is campesterol in which position 22 has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond. It is a phytosterol found in marine algae, mussels, crinoids, mites and plants. It has a role as an algal metabolite, a biomarker, a plant metabolite, an animal metabolite and a marine metabolite. It is a 3beta-sterol, an ergostanoid, a member of phytosterols and a 3beta-hydroxy-Delta(5)-steroid. It is functionally related to a campesterol.

Name: Palmitoleate
Description: This molecule is a hexadec-9-enoate that is the conjugate base of palmitoleic acid; major species at pH 7.3. It has a role as a human metabolite and a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite. It is a conjugate base of a palmitoleic acid.

Name: Ginsenoside Rf
Description: This molecule is a ginsenoside found in Panax ginseng and Panax japonicus var. major that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3beta, 6alpha, 12beta and 20 pro-S positions, in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted to the corresponding beta-D-glucopyranosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucopyranoside, and in which a double bond has been introduced at the 24-25 position. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an apoptosis inducer and an antineoplastic agent. It is a 12beta-hydroxy steroid, a 3beta-hydroxy steroid, a beta-D-glucoside, a disaccharide derivative, a ginsenoside, a tetracyclic triterpenoid, a 20-hydroxy steroid and a 3beta-hydroxy-4,4-dimethylsteroid. It derives from a hydride of a dammarane.

Name: Ethyl n-amyl ketone
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a pungent odor. Insoluble in water and partially soluble in alcohol. Vapors are denser than air and may have a narcotic effect in high concentrations. Used in making perfumes and as a solvent for nitrocellulose and vinyl resins.

Name: (9R,10S)-epoxyheptadecan-4,6-diyn-3-one
Description: This molecule is a polyunsaturated fatty aldehyde.

Name: P-tert-butyltoluene
Description: This molecule is a clear colorless liquid with an aromatic gasoline-like odor. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Selina-3,7(11)-diene
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Panaxacol
Description: This molecule is an aliphatic alcohol.

Name: D-erythro-isocitric acid
Description: This molecule is the D-erythro-stereoisomer of isocitric acid. It is a conjugate acid of a D-erythro-isocitrate(3-). It is an enantiomer of a L-erythro-isocitric acid.

Name: Oxalic acid dibutyl ester
Description: This molecule is a dicarboxylic acid.

Name: Se-methyl-L-selenocysteine zwitterion
Description: This molecule is zwitterionic form of Se-methyl-L-selenocysteine. It is a tautomer of a Se-methyl-L-selenocysteine.

Name: Guggulsterone
Description: This molecule is a 3-hydroxy steroid. It has a role as an androgen.

Name: Cabraleadiol
Description: This molecule is a tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from Aglaia abbreviata. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of oxolanes, a diol and a tetracyclic triterpenoid. It derives from a hydride of a dammarane.

Name: Alpha-D-mannopyranuronate
Description: This molecule is a monocarboxylic acid anion and a carbohydrate acid anion. It is a conjugate base of an alpha-D-mannopyranuronic acid.

Name: (20R)-ginsenoside Rg3
Description: This molecule is a ginsenoside found in Panax japonicus var. major that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3beta, 12beta and 20 pro-R positions, in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding beta-D-glucopyranosyl-beta-D-glucopyranoside, and in which a double bond has been introduced at the 24-25 position. It has a role as an antioxidant and a plant metabolite. It is a ginsenoside, a glycoside and a tetracyclic triterpenoid.

Name: Protopanaxatriol
Description: This molecule is a tetracyclic triterpenoid sapogenin (isolated from ginseng and notoginseng) that is that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3beta, 6alpha, 12beta and 20 pro-S positions and in which a double bond has been introduced at the 24-25 position. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a tetracyclic triterpenoid, a sapogenin, a 3beta-hydroxy steroid, a 12beta-hydroxy steroid, a 6alpha-hydroxy steroid and a 3beta-hydroxy-4,4-dimethylsteroid. It derives from a hydride of a dammarane.

Name: Cabraleone
Description: This molecule is a tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from Aglaia foveolata and Aglaia abbreviata. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a tetracyclic triterpenoid, a cyclic terpene ketone, a tertiary alcohol and a member of oxolanes. It derives from a hydride of a dammarane.

Name: Isoallylbenzene
Description: This molecule is a member of styrenes.

Name: Humulene epoxide I
Description: This molecule is an epoxide.

Name: (R)-pantothenate
Description: This molecule is a pantothenate that is the conjugate base of (R)-pantothenic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite. It is a pantothenate and a vitamin B5. It is a conjugate base of a (R)-pantothenic acid.

Name: (-)-alismoxide
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: (20R)-Ginsenoside Rh1
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Isoeugenol
Description: This molecule is a pale yellow oily liquid with a spice-clove odor. Freezes at 14 °F. Density 1.08 g / cm3. Occurs in ylang-ylang oil and other essential oils.

Name: Chikusetsusaponin-V
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Anabsinthin
Description: This molecule is a sesterterpenoid.

Name: N(5)-ethyl-L-glutamine
Description: This molecule is a N(5)-alkylglutamine where the alkyl group is ethyl. It has been isolated from green tea. It has a role as a neuroprotective agent, a plant metabolite and a geroprotector. It is a tautomer of a This molecule zwitterion.

Name: Theasaponin
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Falaconitine
Description: This molecule is a methoxybenzoic acid.

Name: Neoisostegane
Description: This molecule is a lactone and a lignan.

Name: Parviflorin
Description: This molecule is a polyketide.

Name: Bullatacin
Description: This molecule is a polyketide. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: 10-Deoxygeniposidic acid
Description: This molecule is a terpene glycoside.

Name: Armepavine
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: Cycloheterophyllin
Description: This molecule is an extended flavonoid.

Name: Norartocarpetin
Description: This molecule is a member of flavones.

Name: Artonin A
Description: This molecule is a member of pyranoxanthones.

Name: 3'-O-beta-Glucopyranosyl-stilbericoside
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Dotriacontanoate
Description: This molecule is an ultra-long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of dotriacontanoic acid (lacceroic acid), obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. It is a straight-chain saturated fatty acid anion and an ultra-long-chain fatty acid anion. It is functionally related to a 3-oxodotriacontanoyl-CoA(4-). It is a conjugate base of a dotriacontanoic acid.

Name: Lycopsamine
Description: This molecule is a member of pyrrolizines.

Name: 5beta-cholanic acid
Description: This molecule is a cholanic acid and a member of This molecules.

Name: Aldehydo-L-glucose
Description: This molecule is the L-enantiomer of aldehydo-glucose. It is a L-glucose and an aldehydo-glucose. It is an enantiomer of an aldehydo-D-glucose.

Name: (S)-rosmarinic acid
Description: This molecule is the (S)-stereoisomer of rosmarinic acid. It is an enantiomer of a (R)-rosmarinic acid.

Name: Octadecadienoic acid, methyl ester
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester.

Name: Alisol C
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Alpha-D-fructofuranose
Description: This molecule is a D-fructofuranose. It is an enantiomer of an alpha-L-fructofuranose.

Name: Manninotriose
Description: This molecule is a trisaccharide.

Name: Docosan-1-ol
Description: This molecule is a long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is docosane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1. It is a non-prescription medicine approved by the FDA to shorten healing time of cold sores. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an antiviral drug. It is a long-chain primary fatty alcohol and a docosanol.

Name: Alisol b acetate
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Alisol B
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: 3,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxybenzoic acid in which the hydroxy groups are located at positions 3 and 5. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a dihydroxybenzoic acid and a member of resorcinols. It is functionally related to a benzoic acid.

Name: 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid
Description: This molecule is a monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 is substituted by a 2-hydroxyphenyl group. It has a role as a human xenobiotic metabolite, a bacterial xenobiotic metabolite, a fungal xenobiotic metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is a member of phenols and a monocarboxylic acid. It is functionally related to a propionic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate.

Name: Dihydrofukinolide
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone that is (3R,3a'R)-decahydrospiro[furan-3,2'-indene] carrying an oxo, methylene, acetoxy, [(2S)-2-methylbutanoyl]oxy, methyl and methyl groups at positions 2, 4, 3', 4', 7' and 7a', respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a gamma-lactone, an acetate ester, a sesquiterpene lactone and an oxaspiro compound.

Name: Sakuranin
Description: This molecule is a flavanone glycoside that is sakuranetin attached to a beta-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 5 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an EC 3.1.1.7 (acetylcholinesterase) inhibitor. It is a flavanone glycoside, a monomethoxyflavanone, a monohydroxyflavanone and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones. It is functionally related to a sakuranetin.

Name: 7H-purine
Description: This molecule is the 7H-tautomer of purine. It is a tautomer of a 1H-purine, a 3H-purine and a 9H-purine.

Name: Heliosupine
Description: This molecule is an azabicycloalkane compound having angelyloxy and echimidinyloxymethyl substituents attached to the ring system. It is an azabicycloalkane, a diester and a 2-methylbut-2-enoic acid. It is functionally related to an angelic acid and an isocrotonic acid.

Name: Resorcinol
Description: This molecule is a very white crystalline solid that becomes pink on exposure to light if not completely pure. Burns although ignition is difficult. Density approximately 1.28 g / cm3. Irritating to skin and eyes. Toxic by skin absorption. Used to make plastics and pharmaceuticals.

Name: (R)-3-phenyllactic acid
Description: This molecule is a 3-phenyllactic acid that has (R)-configuration at the 2 position. It is a 3-phenyllactic acid and a (2R)-2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a (R)-3-phenyllactate. It is an enantiomer of a (S)-3-phenyllactic acid.

Name: Pandamine
Description: This molecule is a cyclic peptide.

Name: Sesartemin
Description: This molecule is a lignan.

Name: Absinthin
Description: This molecule is a dimeric sesquiterpene lactone that is produced by the plant Artemisia absinthium (Wormwood). The bitter tasting constituent of Absinthe. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an anti-inflammatory agent. It is a sesquiterpene lactone, a triterpenoid and an organic heteroheptacyclic compound.

Name: Artabsin
Description: This molecule is a tricyclic sesquiterpene lactone found in wormwood.

Name: Methylcysteine
Description: This molecule is a cysteine derivative.

Name: Quercetin 3,4'-di-O-beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin with two beta-D-glucosyl residues attached at positions 3 and 4'. It has a role as a plant metabolite, a radical scavenger and a cardioprotective agent. It is a beta-D-glucoside, a monosaccharide derivative, a polyphenol, a quercetin O-glucoside and a trihydroxyflavone.

Name: Quercetin 7,4'-di-O-beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin with two beta-D-glucosyl residues attached at positions 7 and 4'. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a beta-D-glucoside, a member of flavonols, a monosaccharide derivative, a polyphenol, a quercetin O-glucoside and a trihydroxyflavone.

Name: Strobopinin
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7 and a methyl group at position 6 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a (2S)-flavanone.

Name: 2',4'-dihydroxy-6'-methoxy-3',5'-dimethylchalcone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 4', a methoxy group at position 6' and methyl groups at positions 3' and 5'. Isolated from the buds of Cleistocalyx operculatus, it has been shown to exhibit inhibitory effects on the viral neuraminidases from two influenza viral strains, H1N1 and H9N2. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an EC 3.2.1.18 (exo-alpha-sialidase) inhibitor. It is a member of chalcones, a monomethoxybenzene and a member of resorcinols. It is functionally related to a trans-chalcone.

Name: (2S)-8-methylpinocembrin
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyflavanone that is pinocembrin substituted by a methyl group at position 8. It has been isolated from the buds of Cleistocalyx operculatus. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a dihydroxyflavanone and a (2S)-flavan-4-one. It is functionally related to a pinocembrin.

Name: (2S)-5,7-dihydroxy-6,8-dimethylflavanone
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7 and methyl groups at positions 6 and 8. Isolated from the buds of Cleistocalyx operculatus, it has been shown to exhibit inhibitory effects on the viral neuraminidases from two influenza viral strains, H1N1 and H9N2. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an EC 3.2.1.18 (exo-alpha-sialidase) inhibitor. It is functionally related to a (2S)-flavanone.

Name: 7-Hydroxy-5-methoxy-6,8-dimethylflavanone
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: Mearnsitrin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside and a member of flavonoids.

Name: 2',4'-dihydroxy-3'-methyl-6'-methoxychalcone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by a methyl group at position 3', hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 4' and a methoxy group at position 6'. Isolated from the buds of Cleistocalyx operculatus, it has been shown to exhibit inhibitory effects on the viral neuraminidases from two influenza viral strains, H1N1 and H9N2. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an EC 3.2.1.18 (exo-alpha-sialidase) inhibitor. It is a member of chalcones, a monomethoxybenzene and a member of resorcinols. It is functionally related to a trans-chalcone.

Name: Millefin
Description: This molecule is a germacranolide.

Name: Thiobinupharidine
Description: This molecule is a member of quinolizines.

Name: At room temperature, formaldehyde
Description: This molecule is a colorless, flammable gas that has a distinct, pungent smell. It is also known as methanal, methylene oxide, oxymethyline, methylaldehyde, and oxomethane. Formaldehyde is naturally produced in small amounts in our bodies. It is used in the production of fertilizer, paper, plywood, and urea-formaldehyde resins. It is also used as a preservative in some foods and in many products used around the house, such as antiseptics, medicines, and cosmetics.

Name: Achillin
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone that is (3R,3aS,9aS,9bS)-3,3a,4,5,9a,9b-hexahydroazuleno[4,5-b]furan-2,7-dione carrying three additional methyl substituents at positions 3, 6 and 9. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a nitric oxide synthase activator. It is an azulenofuran and a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: (S)-tropic acid
Description: This molecule is a tropic acid. It is functionally related to a (R)-hydratropic acid. It is an enantiomer of a (R)-tropic acid.

Name: 4-methylcatechol
Description: This molecule is a methylcatechol having a single methyl substituent at the 4-position. It has been isolated from Picea abies. It has a role as a hapten, a carcinogenic agent, an antioxidant, a human metabolite and a plant metabolite.

Name: 12-deoxywithastramonolide
Description: This molecule is a withanolide.

Name: Trans-N-p-coumaroyl tyramine
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Daturilinol
Description: This molecule is a steroid lactone.

Name: Norhyoscyamine
Description: This molecule is a monocarboxylic acid.

Name: (-)-Pinocamphone
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Lycopaoctaene
Description: This molecule is an acyclic carotene that is lycopene in which the double bonds at positions C-7, C-11, C-15, C-7', C-11' and C-15' have been reduced to single bonds.

Name: D-gluconic acid
Description: This molecule is a gluconic acid having D-configuration. It has a role as a chelator and a Penicillium metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a D-gluconate. It is an enantiomer of a L-gluconic acid.

Name: All-cis-7,10,13-hexadecatrienoic acid
Description: This molecule is a hexadecatrienoic acid having Z double bonds at positions 7, 10 and 13. It is a hexadecatrienoic acid and an omega-3 fatty acid. It is a conjugate acid of a (7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoate.

Name: (E)-11-Hexadecenoic acid
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty acid.

Name: Kainic acid
Description: This molecule is a dicarboxylic acid, a pyrrolidinecarboxylic acid, a L-proline derivative and a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid. It has a role as an antinematodal drug and an excitatory amino acid agonist. It is a conjugate acid of a kainate(1-).

Name: Pachysamine B
Description: This molecule is an aza-steroid.

Name: 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose
Description: This molecule is the pyranose form of D-galactosamine. It has a role as a toxin. It is a D-galactosamine and a primary amino compound. It is functionally related to a D-galactopyranose. It is a conjugate base of a 2-ammonio-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose.

Name: Phosphine
Description: This molecule is a colorless, flammable, and explosive gas at ambient temperature that has the odor of garlic or decaying fish. Small amounts occur naturally from the break down of organic matter. It is slightly soluble in water. This molecule is used in semiconductor and plastics industries, in the production of a flame retardant, and as a pesticide in stored grain.

Name: Thevetin B
Description: This molecule is a trisaccharide derivative and a gentiobiosylthevetoside. It is functionally related to a digitoxigenin.

Name: 7,8-dehydrocerberin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside that is the 7,8-dehydroderivative of cerberin. Isolated from Cerbera manghas, it exhibits cytotoxic activity. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is an acetate ester, a cardenolide glycoside and a monosaccharide derivative.

Name: Tanghinin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside that is tanghinigenin attached to a 2-O-acetyl-6-deoxy-3-O-methyl-alpha-L-glucopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidc linkage. Isolated from Cerbera manghas, it exhibits cytotoxic activities against oral human epidermoid carcinoma (KB), human breast cancer cell (BC) and human small cells lung cancer. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a cardenolide glycoside, an acetate ester, a monosaccharide derivative, a tertiary alcohol and an epoxide. It is functionally related to a tanghinigenin.

Name: Deacetyltanghinin
Description: This molecule is a cardenolide glycoside that is the deacetyl derivative of tanghinin. Isolated from Cerbera manghas, it exhibits cytotoxic activities against oral human epidermoid carcinoma (KB), human breast cancer cell (BC) and human small cells lung cancer. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a cardenolide glycoside, a monosaccharide derivative, a tertiary alcohol and an epoxy steroid. It is functionally related to a tanghinigenin.

Name: Piperanine
Description: This molecule is a member of benzodioxoles.

Name: Pinidine
Description: This molecule is a piperidine alkaloid.

Name: Neoabietic acid
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: Cembrene
Description: This molecule is a cembrane diterpenoid.

Name: Isosativan
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: Phaseollidin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of pterocarpans that is (6aR,11aR)-pterocarpan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 9 and a prenyl group at position 10.

Name: Odoratin
Description: This molecule is an isoflavonoid.

Name: Erysotrine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: 5,7,4'-trihydroxy-6,8-diprenylisoflavone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is genistein substituted by prenyl groups at positions 6 and 8. It has been isolated from Derris scandens and Glycyrrhiza uralensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an antibacterial agent. It is functionally related to a genistein.

Name: Erysodine
Description: This molecule is an erythrina alkaloid with formula C18H21NO3 isolated from several erythrina plant species. It is a competitive antagonist of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors and exhibits antiparasitic and insecticidal activities. It has a role as a nicotinic antagonist, a phytogenic insecticide and an antiparasitic agent. It is an aromatic ether, an Erythrina alkaloid, an organic heterotetracyclic compound, a diether and a member of phenols.

Name: Biochanin A(1-)
Description: This molecule is conjugate base of biochanin A arising from selective deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a biochanin A.

Name: Licochalcone A
Description: This molecule is a member of chalcones.

Name: Erythrabyssin II
Description: This molecule is a member of pterocarpans.

Name: 6-Deoxyjacareubin
Description: This molecule is a member of pyranoxanthones.

Name: Cis-and-trans-Inophyllolide
Description: This molecule is a neoflavonoid.

Name: Calophyllolide
Description: This molecule is a neoflavonoid.

Name: Testosterone propionate
Description: This molecule appears as odorless white or yellowish-white crystals or a white or creamy-white crystalline powder. (NTP, 1992)

Name: 3-Pinanone
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: 2-hydroxybenzothiazole
Description: This molecule is benzothiazole substituted with a hydroxy group at the 2-position.

Name: Centellasaponin B
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: N-phenyl-2-naphthylamine
Description: This molecule is a light gray to gray powder. Solutions show blue fluorescence. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Calcium citrate
Description: This molecule is an organic calcium salt composed of calcium cations and citrate anions in a 3:2 ratio. It has a role as a nutraceutical, a food additive, a food preservative and a flavouring agent. It contains a citrate(3-).

Name: Gelsemiol-6'-trans-caffeoyl-1-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a iridoid monoterpenoid isolated from the aerial parts of Verbena litoralis and shown to possess stimulating effects on nerve growth factor. It has a role as a metabolite and a nerve growth factor stimulator. It is an iridoid monoterpenoid, a monoterpene glycoside, a cinnamate ester, a gamma-lactone and a beta-D-glucoside. It is functionally related to a trans-caffeic acid.

Name: Littorachalcone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of dihydrochalcones isolated from the aerial parts of Verbena litoralis and exhibits stimulating the effect of nerve growth factor (NGF). It has a role as a metabolite and a nerve growth factor stimulator. It is a member of dihydrochalcones, a member of resorcinols and an aromatic ether.

Name: 1-undecyne
Description: This molecule is a terminal acetylenic compound that is undecane carrying a triple bond at position 1. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a terminal acetylenic compound and an alkyne.

Name: Isosorbide dinitrate
Description: This molecule is a nitrate ester and a glucitol derivative. It has a role as a vasodilator agent and a nitric oxide donor.

Name: N-tris(hydroxymethyl)methylglycine
Description: This molecule is a Good's buffer substance, pKa = 8.15 at 20 ℃. It is functionally related to a member of tris and a glycine. It is a tautomer of a N-tris(hydroxymethyl)methylammonioacetate.

Name: Kaempferol 3,7-di-O-alpha-L-rhamnoside
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol attached to alpha-L-rhamnopyranosyl residues at positions 3 and 7 respectively via glycosidic linkages. It has been isolated from the aerial parts of Vicia faba and Lotus edulis. It has a role as a bone density conservation agent, a hypoglycemic agent, an immunomodulator, an anti-inflammatory agent, an antineoplastic agent, a plant metabolite, an apoptosis inducer and an antidepressant. It is an alpha-L-rhamnoside, a monosaccharide derivative, a dihydroxyflavone, a glycosyloxyflavone and a polyphenol. It is functionally related to a kaempferol.

Name: isoheptanol
Description: This molecule is a metabolite found in or produced by Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

Name: 1-oleoylglycerol
Description: This molecule is a 1-monoglyceride where the acyl group is oleoyl. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a 1-acylglycerol 18:1 and a monooleoylglycerol. It is functionally related to an oleic acid.

Name: Dicetyl hydrogen phosphate
Description: This molecule is the dihexadecyl ester of phosphoric acid.

Name: (R)-4-hydroxymandelonitrile beta-D-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a beta-D-glucoside consisting of (R)-prunasin carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 4 on the phenyl ring. It is a beta-D-glucoside and a nitrile. It is functionally related to a (R)-prunasin.

Name: Ethylamine
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid or a gas (boiling point 62 °F) with an odor of ammonia. Flash point less than 0 °F. Density of liquid 5.7 lb / gal. Corrosive to the skin and eyes. Vapors are heavier than air. Produces toxic oxides of nitrogen during combustion. Exposure of the closed container to intense heat may cause it to rupture violently and rocket.

Name: Grandisin
Description: This molecule is a lignan.

Name: Kadsurin A
Description: This molecule is a member of benzodioxoles.

Name: Kadsurenin L
Description: This molecule is a neolignan with formula C23H28O6, originally isolated from Piper kadsura. It has a role as a platelet-activating factor receptor antagonist and a plant metabolite. It is a bridged compound, a carbobicyclic compound, a cyclic ketone, an enone, a neolignan, a dimethoxybenzene and an acetate ester.

Name: Kadsurenin M
Description: This molecule is a neolignan that is 2,3-dihydro-1-benzofuran carrying 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl, methyl, formyl and methoxy substituents at positions 2, 3, 5 and 7 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of 1-benzofurans, a dimethoxybenzene, a neolignan, a ring assembly and an arenecarbaldehyde.

Name: (2E,4Z)-N-Isobutyl-2,4-decadienamide
Description: This molecule is a fatty amide.

Name: Kadsurenin K
Description: This molecule is a neolignan with formula C20H22O5, originally isolated from Piper kadsura. It has a role as a platelet-activating factor receptor antagonist and a plant metabolite. It is a bridged compound, a carbobicyclic compound, a cyclic ketone, an enone, a neolignan and a member of guaiacols.

Name: Denudatine
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid. It derives from a hydride of an atisane.

Name: 10,13-Dimethyl-17-(6-methylheptan-2-yl)-1,2,6,7,8,9,11,12,14,15,16,17-dodecahydrocyclopenta[a]phenanthren-3-one
Description: This molecule is a cholestanoid.

Name: Arundoin
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Ajaconine
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid, an organic heterohexacyclic compound, a tertiary amino compound, a cyclic ether, a primary alcohol, a secondary alcohol and an olefinic compound. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It derives from a hydride of an atidane.

Name: Malonylglycitin
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyisoflavone that is glycitin substituted by a malonyl group at position 6''. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a glycosyloxyisoflavone, a hydroxyisoflavone, a malonate ester, a monosaccharide derivative and a methoxyisoflavone. It is functionally related to a glycitin.

Name: Daidzein 7-(6-O-acetyl-beta-D-glucoside)
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyisoflavone that is daidzein in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 7 has been replaced by a 6-O-acetyl-beta-D-glucosyl residue. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a human xenobiotic metabolite. It is a beta-D-glucoside, an O-acyl carbohydrate, an acetate ester, a glycosyloxyisoflavone, a hydroxyisoflavone, a monosaccharide derivative and a member of phenols. It is functionally related to a daidzein.

Name: Isoflavone
Description: This molecule is a simplest member of the class of isoflavones that is 4H-chromen-4-one in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a phenyl group.

Name: Biochanin A
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone which is substituted by an additional hydroxy group at position 5 and a methoxy group at position 4'. A phytoestrogen, it has putative benefits in dietary cancer prophylaxis. It has a role as a phytoestrogen, a plant metabolite, an EC 3.5.1.99 (fatty acid amide hydrolase) inhibitor, a tyrosine kinase inhibitor and an antineoplastic agent. It is a member of 7-hydroxyisoflavones and a member of 4'-methoxyisoflavones. It is a conjugate acid of a biochanin A(1-).

Name: Lidocaine
Description: This molecule is the monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of N,N-diethylglycine with 2,6-dimethylaniline. It has a role as a local anaesthetic, an anti-arrhythmia drug, an environmental contaminant, a xenobiotic and a drug allergen. It is a monocarboxylic acid amide, a tertiary amino compound and a member of benzenes. It is functionally related to a glycinamide.

Name: Glycitein 7-(6-O-acetyl-beta-D-glucoside)
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyisoflavone that is glycitin carrying an acetyl substituent at position 6 on the glucose moiety. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an acetate ester, a glycosyloxyisoflavone, a hydroxyisoflavone, a methoxyisoflavone, a monosaccharide derivative, a beta-D-glucoside and an O-acyl carbohydrate. It is functionally related to a glycitin.

Name: Malonyldaidzin
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyisoflavone that is daidzein substituted by a 6-O-(carboxyacetyl)-beta-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a hydroxyisoflavone, a glycosyloxyisoflavone, a malonate ester and a monosaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to a daidzein 7-O-beta-D-glucoside.

Name: Deoxynivalenol
Description: This molecule is a trichothecene mycotoxin produced by Fusarium to which wheat, barley, maize (corn) and their products are susceptible to contamination. It has a role as a mycotoxin. It is a trichothecene, a cyclic ketone, a secondary alpha-hydroxy ketone, a primary alcohol, an enone and a triol.

Name: Helicid
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Stepharanine
Description: This molecule is a berberine alkaloid with formula C19H18NO4 that is isolated from several species of Stephania. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an EC 3.1.1.7 (acetylcholinesterase) inhibitor. It is a berberine alkaloid, an organic heterotetracyclic compound and an organic cation.

Name: Sinomendine
Description: This molecule is an aporphine alkaloid that is 7-methyldibenzo[de,g]quinolin-7-ol carrying three additional methoxy substituents at positions 2, 8 and 9. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an aporphine alkaloid, a polyether, an aromatic ether and a tertiary alcohol.

Name: Michelenolide
Description: This molecule is a gamma-lactone.

Name: Calanolide E2 (diastereoisomer of calanolide E1)
Description: This molecule is a member of coumarins. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: (-)-epicubenol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid that is (8aS)-1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-octahydronaphthalene substituted by an isopropyl group at position 1, methyl groups at positions 4 and 7, and by a hydroxy group at position 4a (the 1S,4R,4aS,8aR-diastereoisomer). It has a role as a plant metabolite and a volatile oil component. It is a member of octahydronaphthalenes, a sesquiterpenoid and a tertiary alcohol.

Name: Myrcenol
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid that is oct-7-en-2-ol substituted by a methyl group at position 2 and a methylidene group at position 6 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a fragrance. It is a monoterpenoid and a tertiary alcohol.

Name: Hexamethylcyclotrisiloxane
Description: This molecule is an organosilicon compound.

Name: Lysergamide
Description: This molecule is an ergoline alkaloid comprising ergoline lacking hydrogens at positions 9 and 10 and also having a methyl group attached to the piperidine nitrogen. It derives from a hydride of an ergoline.

Name: Quercetagetin 3-methyl ether
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: 2-(2,6-dihydroxyphenyl)-3,5,7-trihydroxy-4H-chromen-4-one
Description: This molecule is a hydroxyflavan.

Name: 5,7,2'-trihydroxy-6-methoxyflavone
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 2' and a methoxy group at position 6. It has been isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a trihydroxyflavone and a monomethoxyflavone. It is functionally related to a flavone.

Name: Gentianose
Description: This molecule is a trisaccharide composed of beta-D-glucopyranose, alpha-D-glucopyranose and beta-D-fructofuranose units. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

Name: Amarogentin
Description: This molecule is a secoiridoid glycoside that consists of (4aS,5R,6R)-5-ethenyl-6-hydroxy-4,4a,5,6-tetrahydro-1H,3H-pyrano[3,4-c]pyran-1-one having a 2-O-[(3,3',5-trihydroxybiphenyl-2-yl)carbonyl]-beta-D-glucopyranosyl group attached at position 6 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as an EC 5.99.1.2 (DNA topoisomerase) inhibitor and a metabolite. It is a secoiridoid glycoside and a monosaccharide derivative.

Name: Trilaurin
Description: This molecule is a triglyceride obtained by formal acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol by lauric (dodecanoic) acid. It is a triglyceride and a dodecanoate ester.

Name: The Expert Panel for Cosmetic Ingredient Safety concluded that the following 24 silicate ingredients
Description: These molecules are safe in cosmetics in the present practices of use and concentration described in this safety assessment when formulated to be non-irritating, with the exception that the available data are insufficient to make a determination of safety for the use of naturally-sourced (i.e., mined) silicate ingredients in products that may be incidentally inhaled: Magnesium Silicate.

Name: Calcium sulfate dihydrate
Description: This molecule is a calcium salt and a hydrate. It contains a calcium sulfate.

Name: Aluminum oxide
Description: This molecule is a white odorless crystalline powder. Water insoluble. Properties (both physical and chemical) vary according to the method of preparation; different methods give different crystalline modifications. The variety formed at very high temperature is quite inert chemically.  alpha-Alumina is the main component of technical grade alumina. Corundum is natural aluminum oxide. Emery is an impure crystalline variety of aluminum oxide. (NIOSH, 2024)

Name: Farrerol
Description: This molecule is an organic molecular entity. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Hydroquinone
Description: This molecule appears as light colored crystals or solutions. May irritate the skin, eyes and mucous membranes. Mildly toxic by ingestion or skin absorption.

Name: Grifolin
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Poriol
Description: This molecule is a member of flavanones.

Name: 2-methylpyridine
Description: This molecule is a colorless liquid with a strong, unpleasant odor. Floats on water. Poisonous vapor is produced. (USCG, 1999)

Name: Hexyl 3-methylbutanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: Fastigilin B
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: (Z)-7-Hexadecen-1,16-olide
Description: This molecule is a macrolide.

Name: Eriodictin
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glycoside.

Name: Humulene epoxide II
Description: This molecule is an epoxide.

Name: Butachlor
Description: This molecule is an aromatic amide that is 2-choro-N-(2,6-diethylphenyl)acetamide in which the amide nitrogen has been replaced by a butoxymethyl group. It has a role as a herbicide, an environmental contaminant and a xenobiotic. It is an aromatic amide, an organochlorine compound and a tertiary carboxamide. It is functionally related to a N-phenylacetamide.

Name: (-)-2-carene
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Gamma-eudesmol
Description: This molecule is a eudesmane sesquiterpenoid in which the eudesmane skeleton carries a hydroxy substituent at C-11 and has a double bond between C-4 and C-5. It has a role as a volatile oil component.

Name: Germanicol
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid that is oleanane substituted by a hydroxy group at the 3beta-position and with a double bond between positioins 18 and 19. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a secondary alcohol. It derives from a hydride of an oleanane.

Name: 2-Ethyl-5-methylpyridine
Description: This molecule is a member of methylpyridines.

Name: Laccaic acid C
Description: This molecule is a tetrahydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 3,5,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by two carboxy groups at positions 1 and 2 as well as a 5-(2-amino-2-carboxyethyl)-2-hydroxyphenyl group at position 7. A minor component of LAC dye together with laccaic acids A, B and D It has a role as a dye and an animal metabolite. It is a polyphenol, a tetrahydroxyanthraquinone, a tricarboxylic acid and an alpha-amino acid.

Name: Laccaic acid A
Description: This molecule is a tetrahydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 3,5,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by two carboxy groups at positions 1 and 2 as well as a 5-(2-acetamidoethyl)-2-hydroxyphenyl group at position 7. The major component of LAC dye together with laccaic acids B, C and D It has a role as a dye, an animal metabolite and an EC 2.1.1.37 [DNA (cytosine-5-)-methyltransferase] inhibitor. It is a tetrahydroxyanthraquinone, an acetamide, a polyphenol and an oxo dicarboxylic acid.

Name: Laccaic acid B
Description: This molecule is a tetrahydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 3,5,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by two carboxy groups at positions 1 and 2 as well as a 5-(2-hydroxyethyl)-2-hydroxyphenyl group at position 7. A minor component of LAC dye together with laccaic acids A, C and D It has a role as an animal metabolite and a dye. It is an oxo dicarboxylic acid, a polyphenol, a tetrahydroxyanthraquinone and a primary alcohol.

Name: L-iditol
Description: This molecule is the L-enantiomer of iditol. It has a role as a fungal metabolite and a human metabolite. It is an enantiomer of a D-iditol.

Name: Arctinal
Description: This molecule is a ring assembly and a member of thiophenes.

Name: Diosbulbin B
Description: This molecule is a naphthofuran.

Name: Turkesterone
Description: This molecule is a steroid.

Name: Ecgonine
Description: This molecule is a tropane alkaloid that consists of tropane bearing carboxy and hydroxy substituents at positions 2 and 3 respectively and having (1R,2R,3S,5S)-configuration. It is both a metabolite of and a precursor to cocaine. It has a role as a metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a tropane alkaloid and a 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid.

Name: P-menthan-3-one
Description: This molecule is a p-menthane monoterpenoid that is p-menthane substituted by an oxo group at position 3. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a volatile oil component.

Name: Proteacin
Description: This molecule is a cyanogenic glycoside.

Name: Cherylline
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: Hamayne
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Crinine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid.

Name: Shanzhiside
Description: This molecule is a terpene glycoside.

Name: (-)-Isoshyobunone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Triptriolide
Description: This molecule is an abietane diterpenoid with formula C20H26O7, originally isolated from Tripterygium wilfordii. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an anti-inflammatory agent. It is a gamma-lactone, a triol, an epoxide and an abietane diterpenoid.

Name: LSM-6185
Description: This molecule is an oxacycle.

Name: Salazinic acid
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ether.

Name: Anisole
Description: This molecule appears as a clear straw-colored liquid with an aromatic odor. Insoluble in water and the same density as water. Vapors heavier than air. Moderately toxic by ingestion. A skin irritant. Used to make perfumes, flavorings and as a solvent.

Name: Wilforidine
Description: This molecule is a dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid and pyridine alkaloid with formula C36H45NO18 originally isolated from Tripterygium wilfordii. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a human xenobiotic metabolite. It is an acetate ester, a dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid, a macrocyclic lactone, an organic heteropentacyclic compound and a pyridine alkaloid.

Name: Cannabichromene
Description: This molecule is a 1-benzopyran.

Name: Triptobenzene H
Description: This molecule is an abietane diterpenoid with formula C21H28O4, originally isolated from Tripterygium wilfordii. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an alpha,beta-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid, an abietane diterpenoid, a carbotricyclic compound, a tricyclic diterpenoid, a member of phenols and a monomethoxybenzene.

Name: Trans-cis-nepetalactone
Description: This molecule is a cyclopentapyran that is (4aS,7aS)-1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran substituted at position 1 by an oxo group and at positions 4 and 7 by methyl groups, respectively (the 4aS,7S,7aS-diastereomer). An iridoid monoterpenoid isolated from several Nepeta plant species. It exhibits potent repellant activity against house dust mites and mosquitoes. It has a role as an insect repellent, a plant metabolite, an antibacterial agent and an antifungal agent. It is an iridoid monoterpenoid and a cyclopentapyran.

Name: Atrochrysone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of anthracenones that is 3,4-dihydroanthracen-1(2H)-one which carries a methyl group at position 3 and hydroxy groups at positions 3, 6, 8, and 9, respectively.
