Name: Quercetin 5,7,3',4'-tetramethyl ether
Description: This molecule is a tetramethoxyflavone that is the 5,7,3',4'-tetramethy-derivative of quercetin. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a tetramethoxyflavone and a member of flavonols. It is functionally related to a quercetin.

Name: Deoxypeganine
Description: This molecule is a member of quinazolines.

Name: Neoandrographolide
Description: This molecule is a diterpene glycoside.

Name: Cis-2-coumarate
Description: This molecule is a 2-coumarate that is the conjugate base of cis-2-coumaric acid. It is a conjugate base of a cis-2-coumaric acid.

Name: Neoarctin B
Description: This molecule is a lignan.

Name: Ugaxanthone
Description: This molecule is a member of xanthones.

Name: Oroxylin A
Description: This molecule is a dihydroxy- and monomethoxy-flavone in which the hydroxy groups are positioned at C-5 and C-7 and the methoxy group is at C-6. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent and an EC 1.14.13.39 (nitric oxide synthase) inhibitor. It is a monomethoxyflavone and a dihydroxyflavone. It is a conjugate acid of an oroxylin A(1-).

Name: Alpha-Neup5Ac-(2->8)-alpha-Neup5Ac-(2->3)-beta-D-Galp-(1->4)-beta-D-Glcp
Description: This molecule is a linear amino tetrasaccharide consisting of two sialyl, one galactose and one glucose residue (at the reducing end) connected by sequential alpha-(2->8)-, alpha-(2->3)- and beta-(1->4)-linkages. The oligosaccharide of ganglioside GD3. It is an amino tetrasaccharide, a member of acetamides and a dicarboxylic acid.

Name: Junosmarin
Description: This molecule is a member of coumarins.

Name: 9,10-dihydroxy-8,8-dimethyl-2H,8H,9H,10H-pyrano[2,3-h]chromen-2-one
Description: This molecule is a member of coumarins.

Name: Plantaginin
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyflavone that is scutellarein attached to a beta-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a glycosyloxyflavone, a trihydroxyflavone and a monosaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to a scutellarein.

Name: Decarine
Description: This molecule is a benzophenanthridine alkaloid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Norchelerythrine
Description: This molecule is a benzophenanthridine alkaloid.

Name: Platydesmine
Description: This molecule is an organonitrogen heterocyclic compound, an oxacycle and an organic heterotricyclic compound.

Name: (R)-amphetamine
Description: This molecule is a 1-phenylpropan-2-amine that has R configuration. It is an enantiomer of a (S)-amphetamine.

Name: Methyl propionate
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid. Flash point 28 °F. Density about the same as water. Vapors heavier than air. May irritate skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Used for flavoring and as a solvent.

Name: 1,1-dimethoxyethane
Description: This molecule appears as a liquid with a sharp odor. Less dense than water. Mildly toxic by ingestion and inhalation. Severely irritates the skin and eyes. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: 1-hydroxybutan-2-one
Description: This molecule is a primary alpha-hydroxy ketone that is butane-1,2-diol in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been formally oxidised to give the corresponding ketone. It is functionally related to a butan-2-one and a butane-1,2-diol.

Name: (S)-amphetamine
Description: This molecule is a 1-phenylpropan-2-amine that has S configuration. It has a role as a neurotoxin, an adrenergic uptake inhibitor, a dopaminergic agent, a sympathomimetic agent, a dopamine uptake inhibitor and an adrenergic agent. It is an enantiomer of a (R)-amphetamine.

Name: Dihydroxyacetone
Description: This molecule is a ketotriose consisting of acetone bearing hydroxy substituents at positions 1 and 3. The simplest member of the class of ketoses and the parent of the class of glycerones. It has a role as a metabolite, an antifungal agent, a human metabolite, a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite, an Escherichia coli metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a ketotriose and a primary alpha-hydroxy ketone.

Name: Di-n-butylamine
Description: This molecule appears as a yellow-colored liquid with a amine-like odor. Denser than water. Very corrosive, may burn skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Flash point 125 °F. Combustible. Produce toxic oxides of nitrogen when burned. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Chikusetsusaponin III
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Diacetyl
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a strong chlorine-like odor. Flash point 80 °F. Less dense than water. Vapors heavier than air.

Name: Betulafolienetriol
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Chikusetsusaponin Ia
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Chikusetsusaponin-IVa
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: Ajugamarin H1
Description: This molecule is a diterpene lactone isolated from the whole plants of Ajuga ciliata. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a butenolide, a diterpene lactone, an acetate ester and a spiro-epoxide.

Name: Ajugamarin A1
Description: This molecule is a diterpene lactone isolated from the whole plants of Ajuga ciliata. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an acetate ester, a butenolide, a diterpene lactone and a spiro-epoxide.

Name: Tubuloside A
Description: This molecule is an oligosaccharide.

Name: Taccalonolide A
Description: This molecule is a withanolide.

Name: Rocaglamide
Description: This molecule is an organic heterotricyclic compound that is 2,3,3a,8b-tetrahydro-1H-benzo[b]cyclopenta[d]furan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 8b, methoxy groups at positions 6 and 8, a 4-methoxyphenyl group at position 3a, a phenyl group at position 3 and a N,N-dimethylcarbamoyl group at position 1. Isolated from Aglaia odorata and Aglaia duperreana, it exhibits antineoplastic activity. It has a role as a metabolite, an antineoplastic agent and an antileishmanial agent. It is an organic heterotricyclic compound, a monomethoxybenzene and a monocarboxylic acid amide.

Name: Aglafolin
Description: This molecule is a heterotricyclic compound based on a 2,3,3a,8b-tetrahydro-1H-benzo[b]cyclopenta[d]furan framework substituted by hydroxy groups at positions C-1 and C-8b, a methoxycarbonyl group at C-2, a phenyl group at C-3, a 4-methoxyphenyl group at C-3a and methoxy groups at C-6 and C-8. A platelet aggregation inhibitor found in Aglaia elliptifolia and Aglaia odorata. It has a role as a metabolite and a platelet aggregation inhibitor. It is an organic heterotricyclic compound and a methyl ester.

Name: Corossoline
Description: This molecule is a polyketide.

Name: Nigakihemiacetal A
Description: This molecule is a quassinoid that is picras-2-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 11, 13 and 16, methoxy groups at positions 2 and 12 and an oxo group at position 1 (the 11alpha,12beta stereoisomer). It has a role as an antifeedant. It is a quassinoid, a lactol and an organic heterotetracyclic compound. It derives from a hydride of a picrasane.

Name: Licoflavone B
Description: This molecule is a member of flavones.

Name: Dioscorine
Description: This molecule is an azaspiro compound.

Name: Onosmin A
Description: This molecule is an aminobenzoic acid that is anthranilic acid in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by a 4-methylbenzyl group. Isolated from Onosma hispida, it exhibits inhibitory activity against lipoxygenase. It has a role as a lipoxygenase inhibitor and a plant metabolite. It is an aminobenzoic acid and a secondary amino compound. It is functionally related to an anthranilic acid.

Name: Onosmin B
Description: This molecule is a benzoate ester obtained by the fromal condensation of the carboxy group of onosmin A with methanol. Isolated from Onosma hispida, it exhibits inhibitory activity against lipoxygenase. It has a role as a metabolite and a lipoxygenase inhibitor. It is a secondary amino compound and a benzoate ester. It is functionally related to an onosmin A.

Name: Neocarlinoside
Description: This molecule is a flavone C-glycoside that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 3' and 4' and a beta-D-glucopyranosyl and a beta-L-arabinopyranosyl residue via C-glycosidic linkages at positions 6 and 8 respectively It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a flavone C-glycoside and a tetrahydroxyflavone. It is functionally related to a flavone.

Name: Carlinoside
Description: This molecule is a C-glycosyl compound that is luteolin substituted at positions 8 and 6 by alpha-L-arabinopyranosyl and beta-D-glucosyl residues respectively. It has a role as a metabolite, an antioxidant and an anti-inflammatory agent. It is a tetrahydroxyflavone and a C-glycosyl compound. It is functionally related to a luteolin.

Name: Neoschaftoside
Description: This molecule is a flavone C-glycoside that is apigenin attached to a beta-D-glucopyranosyl and a beta-L-arabinopyranosyl residues at positions 6 and 8 respectively via C-glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a flavone C-glycoside and a dihydroxyflavone. It is functionally related to an apigenin.

Name: (+)-7-isojasmonic acid
Description: This molecule is an oxylipin that is [(1S)-3-oxocyclopentyl]acetic acid substituted by a (2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl group at position 2 on the cyclopentanone ring. It has a role as a member of jasmonates and a plant metabolite. It is an oxo carboxylic acid and an oxylipin. It is a conjugate acid of a (+)-7-isojasmonate.

Name: Bikhaconitine
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: Rubiarbonol G
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid of the class of arborinane-type terpenoids isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, an antimicrobial agent and a plant metabolite. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid, an acetate ester and a triol.

Name: Rubianthraquinone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of hydroxyanthraquinones that is anthracene-9,10-dione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6, a methoxy group at position 1 and a methyl group at position 2. It has been isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an aromatic ether and a dihydroxyanthraquinone.

Name: Rubiarbonone C
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid of the class of arborinane-type terpenoids isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a cyclic terpene ketone, a diol, a pentacyclic triterpenoid and an acetate ester.

Name: Rubiarbonone B
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid of the class of arborinane-type terpenoids isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a triol, a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a cyclic terpene ketone.

Name: Rubiarbonol F
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid of the class of arborinane-type terpenoids isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as a metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a pentol.

Name: Rubiarbonone A
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid of the class of arborinane-type terpenoids isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as a metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is a cyclic terpene ketone, an acetate ester, a diol and a pentacyclic triterpenoid.

Name: Rubiarbonol A
Description: This molecule is a pentacyclic triterpenoid of the class of arborinane-type terpenoids isolated from the roots of Rubia yunnanensis. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a tetrol.

Name: Urocortisone
Description: This molecule is a 21-hydroxy steroid.

Name: 3-methoxy-4-hydroxy-5-all-trans-polyprenylbenzoic acid
Description: This molecule is a monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 4-hydroxybenzoic acid substituted with a methoxy group at C-3 and a polyprenyl chain of unspecified length at C-5. It is an olefinic compound, a monohydroxybenzoic acid and a methoxybenzoic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 3-methoxy-4-hydroxy-5-all-trans-polyprenylbenzoate.

Name: Tetrahydroswertianolin
Description: This molecule is a xanthone glycoside that is the 1,2,3,4-tetrahydro derivaive of swertianolin (the S,4R-stereoisomer). It is isolated from Swertia japonica and shows hepatoprotective properties. It has a role as a hepatoprotective agent and a plant metabolite. It is a beta-D-glucoside, a monosaccharide derivative, an aromatic ether and a xanthone glycoside. It is functionally related to a swertianolin.

Name: Swertipunicoside
Description: This molecule is a C-glycosyl compound that is the 2'-C-beta-D-glucopyranosyl derivative of 1,5,8-trihydroxy-3-methoxy-7-(1',3',6',7'-tetrahydroxy-9'-oxo-4'-xanthyl)xanthone; isolated from Swertia punicea. It has a role as a metabolite and a HIV-1 reverse transcriptase inhibitor. It is a member of xanthones, a biaryl, a polyphenol, a C-glycosyl compound and an aromatic ether.

Name: Cratoxyarborenone D
Description: This molecule is an organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 2,3-dihydro-5H-furo[3,2-b]xanthen-5-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 7, 8 and 9, an isoprenyl group at position 6 and a prop-1-en-2-yl group at position 2. It is isolated from Cratoxylum Sumatranum and exhibits cytotoxicity towards the KB (human oral epidermoid) cancer cell line. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is an organic heterotetracyclic compound, a cyclic ketone, a polyphenol and a cyclic ether.

Name: Phenethyl sophoroside
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Murrangatin
Description: This molecule is a member of coumarins.

Name: (-)-Deltoin
Description: This molecule is a furanocoumarin.

Name: Phytantriol
Description: This molecule is a triol that consists of 3,7,11,15-tetramethylhexadecane bearing three hydroxy substituents at positions 1, 2 and 3.

Name: L-2-aminoadipic acid
Description: This molecule is the L-enantiomer of 2-aminoadipic acid. It has a role as an Escherichia coli metabolite and a human metabolite. It is functionally related to an adipic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a L-2-aminoadipate(1-) and a L-2-aminoadipate(2-). It is an enantiomer of a D-2-aminoadipic acid.

Name: 2-aminoadipic acid
Description: This molecule is an alpha-amino acid that is adipic acid bearing a single amino substituent at position 2. An intermediate in the formation of lysine. It has a role as a mammalian metabolite and a Caenorhabditis elegans metabolite. It is an amino dicarboxylic acid, a non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid and a dicarboxylic fatty acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 2-aminoadipate(2-).

Name: Malonylshisonin
Description: This molecule is an anthocyanidin glycoside.

Name: Egomaketone
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ketone.

Name: Luteolin-3',7-di-O-glucoside
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glycoside.

Name: Isomyristicin
Description: This molecule is a member of benzodioxoles.

Name: Perilloside A
Description: This molecule is a terpene glycoside.

Name: Cyanidin 3-O-(6-O-para-coumaroyl)glucoside-5-O-glucoside
Description: This molecule is an anthocyanidin glycoside.

Name: 5-Heptenal, 2,6-dimethyl-
Description: This molecule is a monounsaturated fatty aldehyde.

Name: 2,7,7-Trimethyl-bicyclo[2.2.1]hept-2-ene
Description: This molecule is a hydrocarbon.

Name: 2,5-di-tert-butylphenol
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of phenols that is phenol substituted by tert-butyl groups at position 2 and 5. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a mammalian metabolite. It is a member of phenols and an alkylbenzene.

Name: Trans-3(10)-Caren-2-ol
Description: This molecule is an organic hydroxy compound.

Name: 2-Ethyl-4-methyl-1-pentanol
Description: This molecule is a primary alcohol.

Name: Humulen-(v1)
Description: This molecule is a hydrocarbon.

Name: Hinesol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Perilloside C
Description: This molecule is a terpene glycoside.

Name: Isoterpinolene
Description: This molecule is a p-menthadiene with double bonds at positions 2 and 4(8). It has a role as a human metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is a cycloalkene and a p-menthadiene.

Name: (3R)-hydroxy-beta-ionone
Description: This molecule is a beta-ionone compound having an (R)-hydroxy group at the 3-position. It is functionally related to a beta-ionone.

Name: 4-sec-Butylphenol
Description: This molecule is an alkylbenzene.

Name: 8Z,14Z-Eicosadienoic acid
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty acid.

Name: Tuberonic acid
Description: This molecule is an oxo monocarboxylic acid that is (+)-7-isojasmonic acid in which one of the hydrogens of the side-chain methyl group is replaced by a hydroxy group. It has a role as a member of jasmonates and a plant metabolite. It is a member of cyclopentanones, a primary alcohol, an oxo monocarboxylic acid and a homoallylic alcohol. It is functionally related to a (+)-7-isojasmonic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a tuberonate.

Name: Luteolin-7-O-[beta-D-glucuronosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucuronide]
Description: This molecule is the glycosyloxyflavone resulting from the condensation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of luteolin with the 1 position of 2-O-beta-D-glucopyranuronosyl-beta-D-glucopyranosiduronic acid. It is a trihydroxyflavone, a glycosyloxyflavone, a dicarboxylic acid, a disaccharide derivative and a luteolin O-glucuronoside. It is a conjugate acid of a luteolin 7-O-[(beta-D-glucosiduronate)-(1->2)-(beta-D-glucosiduronate)].

Name: Limonoate A-ring-lactone
Description: This molecule is a limonoid.

Name: (6S)-dehydrovomifoliol
Description: This molecule is a dehydrovomifoliol that has S-configuration at the chiral centre. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an enantiomer of a (6R)-dehydrovomifoliol.

Name: Isoegomaketone
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ketone.

Name: 2-[4-(3,4-Methylenedioxyphenyl)butyl]-4(1H)-quinolinone
Description: This molecule is a member of quinolines.

Name: 2,2,2-trichloroethanol
Description: This molecule is a chloroethanol. It has a role as a mouse metabolite.

Name: Methyl geranate
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Perillyl aldehyde
Description: This molecule is an aldehyde that is cyclohex-1-ene-1-carbaldehyde substituted by a prop-1-en-2-yl group at position 4. It has a role as a mouse metabolite, a human metabolite and a volatile oil component. It is an olefinic compound and an aldehyde.

Name: Dimethyl suberate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester.

Name: Cyclohexylamine
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless to yellow liquid with an odor of ammonia. Flash point 90 °F. Irritates the eyes and respiratory system. Skin contact may cause burns. Less dense than water. Vapors heavier than air. Toxic oxides of nitrogen produced during combustion.

Name: 2-nonadecenoic acid
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty acid.

Name: 1,1,2,2-Tetrachloroethane
Description: This molecule is a manufactured, colorless, dense liquid that does not burn easily. It is volatile and has a sweet odor. In the past, it was used in large amounts to produce other chemicals, as an industrial solvent to clean and degrease metals, and as an ingredient in paints and pesticides. Commercial production of 1,1,2,2-tetrachloroethane for these uses has stopped in the United States. It presently is used only as a chemical intermediate in the production of other chemicals.

Name: Arnebinol
Description: This molecule is a member of phenols.

Name: C.I. Natural Red 20
Description: This molecule is a naphthoquinone.

Name: Intermedine
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester compound formed from condensation between retronecine and (2S,3R)-2,3-dihydroxy-2-isopropylbutanoic acid. It is a member of pyrrolizines, an azabicycloalkane and a carboxylic ester.

Name: 3-hydroxyisovaleric acid
Description: This molecule is a 3-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is isovaleric acid substituted at position 3 by a hydroxy group. Used as indicator of biotin deficiency. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is functionally related to a butyric acid and an isovaleric acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 3-hydroxyisovalerate.

Name: Deoxyshikonin
Description: This molecule is a hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone.

Name: Ethyl docosenyl
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: Alkannin beta,beta-dimethylacrylate
Description: This molecule is a hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone.

Name: Methyl cis-15-tetracosenoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester.

Name: Shikonin
Description: This molecule is a hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone.

Name: Echinone
Description: This molecule is an acetate ester and a hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone.

Name: Arnebinone
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: (R)-lipoic acid
Description: This molecule is the (R)-enantiomer of lipoic acid. A vitamin-like, C8 thia fatty acid with anti-oxidant properties. It has a role as a prosthetic group, a nutraceutical and a cofactor. It is a lipoic acid, a member of dithiolanes, a heterocyclic fatty acid and a thia fatty acid. It is functionally related to an octanoic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a (R)-lipoate. It is an enantiomer of a (S)-lipoic acid.

Name: (S)-lipoic acid
Description: This molecule is the (S)-enantiomer of lipoic acid. Not found in nature, it may exert detrimental effects on biosystems. It is a lipoic acid, a heterocyclic fatty acid, a thia fatty acid and a member of dithiolanes. It is functionally related to an octanoic acid. It is an enantiomer of a (R)-lipoic acid.

Name: Decoside
Description: This molecule is a steroid saponin.

Name: Lagerstroemine
Description: This molecule is a macrolide.

Name: Dequalinium chloride
Description: This molecule is an organic chloride salt that is the dichloride salt of dequalinium. It has a role as an antiseptic drug, a mitochondrial NADH:ubiquinone reductase inhibitor, an antifungal agent and an antineoplastic agent. It contains a dequalinium.

Name: Petunidin 3-arabinoside
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glycoside.

Name: 4-[(e)-2-{[2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)ethyl]amino}vinyl]-2,3-dihydro-2,6-pyridinedicarboxylic acid
Description: This molecule is an organooxygen compound and an organonitrogen compound. It is functionally related to an alpha-amino acid.

Name: Miraxanthin-II
Description: This molecule is an organooxygen compound. It is functionally related to a tetracarboxylic acid.

Name: Acetylene
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless gas with a faint garlic-like odor. Easily ignited and burns with a sooty flame. Gas is lighter than air. Flame may flash back to the source of a leak very easily. Under prolonged exposure to fire or heat the containers may rupture violently and rocket.

Name: Diethylene glycol monoethyl ether
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless, slightly viscous liquid with a mild pleasant odor. Flash point near 190 °F. Used to make soaps, dyes, and other chemicals.

Name: Heliettin
Description: This molecule is a furanocoumarin.

Name: P-Mentha-1,8-dien-4-ol
Description: This molecule is a p-menthane monoterpenoid.

Name: Norbixin
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: 6-Geranylgeranyl 8'-methyl 6,8'-diapocarotene-6,8'-dioate
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: Bixin
Description: This molecule is a carotenoic acid that is the 6'-monomethyl ester of 9'-cis-6,6'-diapocarotene-6,6'-dioic acid. It has a role as an antioxidant, an insulin-sensitizing drug, a biological pigment, an anti-inflammatory agent, a food colouring and an apoptosis inducer. It is a carotenoic acid, a dicarboxylic acid monoester and a methyl ester.

Name: Sclareapinone
Description: This molecule is a naphthoquinone.

Name: Zerumboneoxide
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid that is the 2, 3-epoxy derivative of zerumbone. Isolated from Zingiber zerumbet, it exhibits inhibitory activity against nitric oxide synthase. It has a role as a metabolite and an EC 1.14.13.39 (nitric oxide synthase) inhibitor. It is a sesquiterpenoid, a cyclic ketone, an enone and an epoxide. It is functionally related to a zerumbone. It derives from a hydride of an alpha-humulene.

Name: 5-hydroxyzerumbone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid that is zerumbone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5. Isolated from the rhizomes Zingiber zerumbet, it has been found to inhibit lipopolysaccharide-induced nitric oxide production. It has a role as a metabolite and an EC 1.14.13.39 (nitric oxide synthase) inhibitor. It is a cyclic ketone, a sesquiterpenoid and a secondary alcohol. It is functionally related to a zerumbone. It derives from a hydride of a humulane.

Name: Zerumbone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid and cyclic ketone that is (1E,4E,8E)-alpha-humulene which is substituted by an oxo group at the carbon atom attached to two double bonds. It is obtained by steam distillation from a type of edible ginger, Zingiber zerumbet Smith, grown particularly in southeast Asia. It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent, a plant metabolite and a glioma-associated oncogene inhibitor. It is a sesquiterpenoid and a cyclic ketone. It derives from a hydride of an alpha-humulene.

Name: 4',5-dihydroxy-3'-methoxyflavon-7-olate(1-)
Description: This molecule is a flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 4',5,7-trihydroxy-3'-methoxyflavone arising from selective deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a 4',5,7-trihydroxy-3'-methoxyflavone.

Name: 3,5-di-O-caffeoyl quinic acid
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester that is the diester obtained by the condensation of the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5 of (-)-quinic acid with the carboxy group of trans-caffeic acid. Isolated from Brazilian propolis and Suaeda glauca, it exhibits hepatoprotective and cytotoxic activities. It has a role as a metabolite, a hepatoprotective agent and an antineoplastic agent. It is a cyclitol carboxylic acid and a carboxylic ester. It is functionally related to a (-)-quinic acid and a trans-caffeic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 3,5-di-O-caffeoyl quinate.

Name: Jasmone
Description: This molecule is a cyclic ketone.

Name: Isochlorogenic acid
Description: This molecule is a quinic acid.

Name: Hexadecyl ferulate
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Carthamin
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Ethyl orthoformate
Description: This molecule appears as a clear, colorless liquid with a pungent odor. Less dense than water. Vapors heavier than air. May irritate skin and eyes. Used to make other chemicals.

Name: Neocarthamin
Description: This molecule is a flavanone glycoside that is carthamidin attached to a beta-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 5 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a flavanone glycoside, a trihydroxyflavanone and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones. It is functionally related to a carthamidin.

Name: Gamma-tocotrienol
Description: This molecule is a tocotrienol that is chroman-6-ol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 7 and 8 and a farnesyl chain at position 2. Name: Selenium
Description: This molecule is a naturally occurring mineral element that is distributed widely in nature in most rocks and soils. In its pure form, it exists as metallic gray to black hexagonal crystals, but in nature it is usually combined with sulfide or with silver, copper, lead, and nickel minerals. Most processed selenium is used in the electronics industry, but it is also used: as a nutritional supplement; in the glass industry; as a component of pigments in plastics, paints, enamels, inks, and rubber; in the preparation of pharmaceuticals; as a nutritional feed additive for poultry and livestock; in pesticide formulations; in rubber production; as an ingredient in antidandruff shampoos; and as a constituent of fungicides. Radioactive selenium is used in diagnostic medicine.

It has a role as an anti-inflammatory agent, a neuroprotective agent, a biomarker and a metabolite. It is a diterpenoid, a benzochromene, a hydroxy monocarboxylic acid, a polyketide and a phytocannabinoid. It is a conjugate acid of a Delta(9)-tetrahydrocannabinolate.

Description: This molecule is an omega-hydroxy amino acid that is 2-decenoic acid in which one of the hydrogens attached to the terminal carbon is replaced by a hydroxy group and in which the C=C double bond has E configuration. Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyflavanone that is (S)-naringenin substituted by a geranyl group at position 8. Isolated from Macaranga bicolor, it exhibits antibacterial and antineoplastic activities. It has a role as a metabolite, an antineoplastic agent and an antibacterial agent. It is a trihydroxyflavanone, a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones and a (2S)-flavan-4-one. It is functionally related to a (S)-naringenin.

Name: Flavanone
Description: This molecule is the simplest member of the class of flavanones that consists of flavan bearing an oxo substituent at position 4. It derives from a hydride of a flavan.

Name: 5-heptadecylresorcinol
Description: This molecule is a 5-alkylresorcinol that is resorcinol which is substituted by a heptadecyl group at position 5. It is found in wheat bran. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent and a plant metabolite.

Name: Chalcone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of chalcones that is acetophenone in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a benzylidene group. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a member of styrenes and a member of chalcones.

Name: Biotin
Description: This molecule is an organic heterobicyclic compound that consists of 2-oxohexahydro-1H-thieno[3,4-d]imidazole having a valeric acid substituent attached to the tetrahydrothiophene ring. It is a member of biotins and a vitamin B7. It is a conjugate acid of a biotinate.

Name: Genistein(1-)
Description: This molecule is an organic anion that is the conjugate base of genistein, obtained by selective deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group. It is a conjugate base of a genistein.

Name: Beta-alanine
Description: This molecule is a naturally-occurring beta-amino acid comprising propionic acid with the amino group in the 3-position. It has a role as an inhibitor, an agonist, a human metabolite, a fundamental metabolite and a neurotransmitter. It is a conjugate acid of a beta-alaninate. It is a tautomer of a beta-alanine zwitterion.

Name: Tyrosine
Description: This molecule is an alpha-amino acid that is phenylalanine bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 4 on the phenyl ring. It has a role as a Daphnia magna metabolite. It is an alpha-amino acid, a polar amino acid and an aromatic amino acid. It contains a 4-hydroxybenzyl group. It is functionally related to a propionic acid. It is a conjugate base of a tyrosinium. It is a conjugate acid of a tyrosinate(1-).

Description: This molecule is a member of the class of monohydroxy-1,4-benzoquinones that is embelin in which the hydroxy group at position 5 is replaced by a ethoxy group. Isolated from Lysimachia punctata and Embelia ribes, it exhibits antineoplastic activity. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is an enol ether, a member of 1,4-benzoquinones and a member of monohydroxy-1,4-benzoquinones. It is functionally related to an embelin.

Name: Actinodaphnine
Description: This molecule is an organic heteropentacyclic compound 6,7,7a,8-tetrahydro-5H-benzo[g][1,3]dioxolo[4',5':4,5]benzo[1,2,3-de]quinoline bering additional hydroxy and methoxy substituents at positions 10 and 11 respectively. It is an organic heteropentacyclic compound, an aromatic ether, a secondary amino compound, a member of phenols and an aporphine alkaloid.

Name: 1,7-dihydroxy-4-methoxyxanthone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 7, a methoxy group at position 4 and an oxo group at position 9. It has been isolated from the stems of Cratoxylum cochinchinense. It has a role as a metabolite and a plant metabolite. It is an aromatic ether, a member of phenols and a member of xanthones.

Name: thallium
Description: This molecule is a bluish-white metal that is found in trace amounts in the earth's crust. In the past, This molecule was obtained as a by-product from smelting other metals; however, it has not been produced in the United States since 1984. Currently, all the This molecule is obtained from imports and from This molecule reserves.. In its pure form, This molecule is odorless and tasteless. It can also be found combined with other substances such as bromine, chlorine, fluorine, and iodine. When it's combined, it appears colorless-to-white or yellow.. Thallium is used mostly in manufacturing electronic devices, switches, and closures, primarily for the semiconductor industry. It also has limited use in the manufacture of special glass and for certain medical procedures.

Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines.

Name: 4'-hydroxyechinenone

Name: 11-cis-retinal
Description: This molecule is a retinal having 2E,4Z,6E,8E-double bond geometry. It has a role as a chromophore, a human metabolite and a mouse metabolite.

Name: Bufogenin
Description: This molecule is a steroid lactone of Chan su (toad venom), a Chinese medicine obtained from the skin venom gland of toads. A specific Na/K-ATPase protein inhibitor, it is used as a cardiotonic and central nervous system (CNS) respiratory agent, an analgesic and anesthetic, and as a remedy for ulcers. It has a role as an EC 3.6.3.9 (Na(+)/K(+)-transporting ATPase) inhibitor. It is a steroid lactone and an epoxy steroid. It is functionally related to a bufanolide.

Name: N,N,N-Trimethylserotonin

Name: Bufalin
Description: This molecule is a 14beta-hydroxy steroid that is bufan-20,22-dienolide having hydroxy substituents at the 5beta- and 14beta-positions. It has been isolated from the skin of the toad Bufo bufo. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, a cardiotonic drug, an anti-inflammatory agent and an animal metabolite. It is a 3beta-hydroxy steroid and a 14beta-hydroxy steroid. It is functionally related to a bufanolide.

Name: Bufotenin
Description: This molecule is a tertiary amine that consists of N,N-dimethyltryptamine bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at position 5. It has a role as a hallucinogen and a coral metabolite. It is a tryptamine alkaloid and a tertiary amine. It is functionally related to a N,N-dimethyltryptamine.

Name: Bufadienolide
Description: This molecule is the simplest member of the class of bufadienolides that is bufanolide with unsaturation at positions 20 and 22.

Name: Bufotenidine
Description: This molecule is a member of tryptamines.

Name: Desacetyleupaserrin
Description: This molecule is a germacranolide.

Name: Marinobufagenin
Description: This molecule is a cardiotonic steroid secreted by the toad Bufo rubescens and other related species such as Bufo marinus. An endogenous Na/K-ATPase inhibitor, it is a vasoconstrictor with effects similar to digitalis. It has a role as an EC 3.6.3.9 (Na(+)/K(+)-transporting ATPase) inhibitor and an epitope. It is a steroid hormone and an epoxy steroid. It is functionally related to a (5beta)-bufadienolide.

Name: Tenuifolin
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Arenobufagin
Description: This molecule is a steroid lactone. It is functionally related to a bufanolide.

Name: 6alpha-hydroxycinobufagin

Name: Resiniferonol
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: Telocinobufagin
Description: This molecule is a steroid lactone. It is functionally related to a bufanolide.

Name: 5beta-hydroxybufotalin
Description: This molecule is a steroid lactone. It is functionally related to a bufanolide.

Name: Hellebrigenin
Description: This molecule is a 3beta-hydroxy steroid, a 5beta-hydroxy steroid, a 14beta-hydroxy steroid, a 19-oxo steroid, a steroid aldehyde and a steroid lactone. It has a role as an apoptosis inducer, an autophagy inducer, an antineoplastic agent, an animal metabolite, an antileishmanial agent and a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a 5beta-bufanolide.

Name: Arsenic
Description: This molecule is a naturally occurring element widely distributed in the earth's crust. In the environment, arsenic is combined with oxygen, chlorine, and sulfur to form inorganic arsenic compounds. This molecule in animals and plants combines with carbon and hydrogen to form organic arsenic compounds. Inorganic arsenic compounds are mainly used to preserve wood. Copper chromated arsenic (CCA) is used to make "pressure-treated" lumber. CCA is no longer used in the U.S. for residential uses; it is still used in industrial applications. Organic arsenic compounds are used as pesticides, primarily on cotton plants.

Name: Lead
Description: This molecule is a naturally occurring bluish-gray metal found in small amounts in the earth's crust. This molecule can be found in all parts of our environment. Much of it comes from human activities including burning fossil fuels, mining, and manufacturing. This molecule has many different uses. It is used in the production of batteries, ammunition, metal products (solder and pipes), and devices to shield X-rays. Because of health concerns, lead from gasoline, paints and ceramic products, caulking, and pipe solder has been dramatically reduced in recent years.CDC uses a blood lead reference value (BLRV) of 3.5 micrograms per deciliter (μg/dL) to identify children with higher levels of lead in their blood compared to most children. This level is based on the 97.5th percentile of the blood lead values among U.S. children ages 1""5 years from the 2015""2016 and 2017""2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey cycles. Children with blood lead levels at or above the BLRV represent those at the top 2.5% with the highest blood lead levels. To learn more about CDC's updated recommendations on children's blood lead levels, please visit:http://www.cdc.gov/nceh/lead/ACCLPP/blood_lead_levels.htm.

Name: Tanariflavanone A
Description: This molecule is a hydroxyflavanone with a pyranochromane skeleton that is 3,4,7,8-tetrahydro-2H,6H-pyrano[3,2-g]chromen-6-one substituted by geminal methyl groups at position 2, hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5 and a phenyl group at position 8 which in turn is substituted by a geranyl group at position 2 and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4. Isolated from Macaranga tanarius, it exhibits alleopathic effect. It has a role as an allelochemical and a plant metabolite. It is a hydroxyflavanone, a pyranochromane and an extended flavonoid.

Name: Nymphaeol C
Description: This molecule is a tetrahydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy group at positions 5, 7, 3' and 4', a geranyl group at position 2' and a prenyl group at position 6. Isolated from Macaranga tanarius and propolis collected in Okinawa, it exhibits radical scavenging activity. It has a role as a metabolite and a radical scavenger. It is a tetrahydroxyflavanone and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones.

Name: Tanariflavanone B
Description: This molecule is a trihydroxyflavanone that consists of (2S)-2,3-dihydro-2'H,4H-2,5'-bichromen-4-one skeleton substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 8', a methyl group at position 2', a prenyl group at position 6 and a 4-methylpent-3-enyl group at position 2'. Isolated from Macaranga tanarius, it exhibits alleopathic effect. It has a role as an allelochemical and a plant metabolite. It is a trihydroxyflavanone and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones.

Name: 7-Hydroxy-5-methoxy-6-methylflavan
Description: This molecule is an ether and a member of flavonoids.

Name: Nordracorubin
Description: This molecule is a flavonoid oligomer.

Name: Bavachalcone
Description: This molecule is a member of chalcones.

Name: Isoneobavachalcone
Description: This molecule is a member of phenols.

Name: Bakuchiol
Description: This molecule is under investigation in clinical trial NCT03112863 (Comparison of the Cosmetic Effects of This molecule and Retinol).

Name: Delphinidin
Description: This molecule is an anthocyanidin cation consisting of benzopyrylium with hydroxy substituents at the 3-, 5- and 7-positions and a 3,4,5-trihydroxyphenyl group at the 2-position. It is a plant pigment responsible for the colours of the plants of the genera Viola and Delphinium. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, a biological pigment and a plant metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a delphinidin(1-).

Name: Corylinal
Description: This molecule is a member of isoflavones.

Name: Ophthalmic acid
Description: This molecule is a L-glutamine derivative that is L-glutamine substituted by a 1-[(carboxymethyl)amino]-1-oxobutan-2-yl at the terminal amino nitrogen atom. It has a role as a biomarker and a human metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of an Ophthalmate.

Name: Psilostachyin B
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: Forsythiaside
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Acteoside
Description: This molecule is a glycoside that is the alpha-L-rhamnosyl-(1->3)-beta-D-glucoside of hydroxytyrosol in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the glucopyranosyl moiety has undergone esterification by formal condensation with trans-caffeic acid. It has a role as a neuroprotective agent, an antileishmanial agent, an anti-inflammatory agent, a plant metabolite and an antibacterial agent. It is a cinnamate ester, a disaccharide derivative, a member of catechols, a polyphenol and a glycoside. It is functionally related to a hydroxytyrosol and a trans-caffeic acid.

Name: Lucialdehyde B
Description: This molecule is a tetracyclic triterpenoid that is lanosta-8,24-dien-26-al substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 7. Isolated from Ganoderma lucidum and Ganoderma pfeifferi, it exhibits antiviral and cytotoxic activities. It has a role as a metabolite, an antineoplastic agent and an anti-HSV agent. It is a tetracyclic triterpenoid, a cyclic terpene ketone, a 3-oxo-5alpha-steroid, a 7-oxo steroid and a steroid aldehyde. It derives from a hydride of a lanostane.

Name: Sibiricose A1
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Sibiricose A6

Name: (9Z)-pentadecenoic acid
Description: This molecule is a 9-pentadecenoic acid in which the double bond adopts cis-configuration. It is a conjugate acid of a (9Z)-pentadecenoate.

Name: Kaempferol 7,4'-dimethyl ether 3-neohesperidoside
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and a glycoside.

Name: 3',4'-Di-O-methylquercetin
Description: This molecule is a hydroxyflavan. It is a conjugate acid of a quercetin 3',4'-dimethyl ether(2-).

Name: Zierin
Description: This molecule is a cyanogenic glycoside.

Name: 6-O-Acetylarbutin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside.

Name: Cycloprotobuxine C
Description: This molecule is a steroid alkaloid.

Name: 2H-pyran-2-one
Description: This molecule is the simplest member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran with an oxo substituent at position 2.

Name: 2-stearoylglycerol
Description: This molecule is a 2-monoglyceride where the acyl group is octadecanoyl (stearoyl). It is functionally related to an octadecanoic acid.

Name: 3-(1-Pyrazolyl)-alanine
Description: This molecule is an alpha-amino acid.

Name: 2-butylfuran
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a butyl group. It is a constituent found in several plant species and some cooked foods. It has a role as a human metabolite, a plant metabolite and a flavouring agent.

Name: Decyl methacrylate
Description: This molecule is a clear light tan liquid. Insoluble in water. (NTP, 1992)

Name: Beta-D-gentiobiosyl beta-D-glucosyl crocetin
Description: This molecule is a diester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of beta-D-gentiobiosyl crocetin with the anomeric hydroxy group of beta-D-glucopyranose. It is a beta-D-glucoside and a diester.

Name: Isorhamnetin 3-O-robinobioside
Description: This molecule is a glycosyloxyflavone that is isorhamnetin substituted at position 3 by a robinobiosyl residue. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an antioxidant and an apoptosis inducer. It is a glycosyloxyflavone, a monomethoxyflavone, a trihydroxyflavone and a disaccharide derivative. It is functionally related to an isorhamnetin.

Name: Picrocrocin
Description: This molecule is a beta-D-glucoside of beta-cyclocitral; the precursor of safranal. It is the compound most responsible for the bitter taste of saffron. It is functionally related to a beta-cyclocitral.

Name: 4-Oxo-b-ionone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Beta-D-glucosyl crocetin
Description: This molecule is a dicarboxylic acid monoester resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxylic acid groups of crocetin with the anomeric hydroxy group of beta-D-glucopyranose. It is a dicarboxylic acid monoester and a beta-D-glucoside. It is functionally related to a crocetin and a beta-D-glucose. It is a conjugate acid of a beta-D-glucosyl crocetin(1-).

Name: Crocin-1
Description: This molecule is a diester that is crocetin in which both of the carboxy groups have been converted to their gentiobiosyl esters. It is one of the water-soluble yellow-red pigments of saffron and is used as a spice for flavouring and colouring food. Note that in India, the term 'Crocin' is also used by GlaxoSmithKline as a brand-name for paracetamol. It has a role as an antioxidant, a food colouring, a plant metabolite and a histological dye. It is a diester, a disaccharide derivative and a diterpenoid. It is functionally related to a beta-D-gentiobiosyl crocetin and a gentiobiose.

Name: Phorone
Description: This molecule appears as a yellowish liquid with a solvent-like odor. Combustible but difficult to ignite. Used as a solvent for lacquers and coatings.

Name: 2-Propenyl heptanoate
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester.

Name: Crosatoside B
Description: This molecule is a glycosylglucose derivative that is alpha-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by a 2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)ethyl group. It has a role as a mouse metabolite and a rat metabolite. It is a glycoside, a member of phenols and a glycosylglucose derivative. It is functionally related to a 2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)ethanol.

Name: 3,5-dimethylbenzaldehyde
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of benzaldehydes that is benzaldehyde substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite and a human metabolite. It is a member of benzaldehydes and a methylbenzene.

Name: Xi-2,2,6-Trimethyl-1,4-cyclohexanedione

Name: 3-dehydroshikimic acid
Description: This molecule is a 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is shikimic acid in which the allylic hydroxy group has been oxidised to the corresponding keto group. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid, a 4-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid, a 5-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid, an alpha,beta-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid and a secondary alpha-hydroxy ketone. It is functionally related to a shikimic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 3-dehydroshikimate.

Name: 2,6-dimethylheptadecane
Description: This molecule is a branched alkane consisting of heptadecane bearing two methyl substituents at positions 2 and 6. It has a role as a fungal metabolite.

Name: Coriose

Name: Homoplantaginin
Description: This molecule is a glycoside and a member of flavonoids.

Name: 9-(Methylthio)nonanenitrile
Description: This molecule is a nitrile.

Name: 5,6-Dehydrokawain
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ether and a member of 2-pyranones.

Name: 7-hydroxy-5-methoxy-2-phenyl-3,4-dihydro-2H-1-benzopyran-4-one
Description: This molecule is a member of flavonoids and an ether.

Name: Alnustone
Description: This molecule is a diarylheptanoid.

Name: (2S,2'R,3R,4E,8E)-N-2'-hydroxytetradecanoyl-2-amino-9-methyl-4,8-octadecadiene-1,3-diol
Description: This molecule is a ceramide.

Description: This molecule is a member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 are replaced by ethyl and methyl groups, respectively. It has a role as a flavouring agent, a human urinary metabolite, a plant metabolite, a fungal metabolite and a mouse metabolite.

Name: Hopan-22-ol
Description: This molecule is a hopanoid that is hopane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 22. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a hopanoid, a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a tertiary alcohol.

Name: Filicinic acid
Description: This molecule is an enone that is cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5 and geminal methyl groups at position 4. It has a role as a metabolite. It is an enol and an enone. It is functionally related to a phloroglucinol.

Name: Aspidin
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester. It is functionally related to a phloroglucinol.

Name: Dubinidine
Description: This molecule is an organic heterotricyclic compound, an oxacycle and an organonitrogen heterocyclic compound.

Name: Deserpidine
Description: This molecule is an alkaloid ester, a methyl ester, a benzoate ester, an organic heteropentacyclic compound and a yohimban alkaloid. It derives from a hydride of a yohimban.

Name: Filixic acid BBB
Description: This molecule is a carboxylic ester. It is functionally related to a phloroglucinol.

Name: Fernene
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid.

Name: Furohyperforin
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Sodium dichloro-s-triazinetrione
Description: This molecule is a white solid with an odor of bleach-like odor. Mixes with water. (USCG, 1999)

Name: 4',4''',5,5'',7,7''-Hexahydroxy-3,8''-biflavone
Description: This molecule is a flavonoid oligomer.

Name: 8-Hydroxyhyperforin 8,1-hemiacetal
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Xanthone
Description: This molecule is the parent compound of the xanthone class consisting of xanthene bearing a single oxo substituent at position 9. It has a role as an insecticide.

Name: Candletoxin A
Description: This molecule is a phorbol ester.

Name: Finaconitine
Description: This molecule is a diterpenoid.

Name: Azukisaponin III
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: (-)-epigallocatechin
Description: This molecule is a flavan-3,3',4',5,5',7-hexol having (2R,3R)-configuration. It has a role as an antioxidant, a plant metabolite and a food component. It is a flavan-3,3',4',5,5',7-hexol and a catechin. It is an enantiomer of a (+)-epigallocatechin.

Name: Oxypaeoniflorin
Description: This molecule is a monoterpene glycoside with formula C23H28O12, isolated from several species of Paeoniae. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a cyclic acetal, a lactol, a bridged compound, a beta-D-glucoside, a 4-hydroxybenzoate ester and a monoterpene glycoside.

Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin.

Name: Dihydrotricetin
Description: This molecule is a pentahydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 3', 4' and 5'. It is a pentahydroxyflavanone, a 3',5'-dihydroxyflavanone and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones.

Name: Hellicoside
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Hypolaetin
Description: This molecule is a pentahydroxyflavone that consists of luteolin substituted by an additional hydroxy group at position 8. It has a role as an antioxidant and a plant metabolite. It is functionally related to a luteolin.

Name: Plantamajoside
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid.

Name: Plantagoside
Description: This molecule is a flavanone glycoside that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 4' and 5' and a beta-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 3' respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a flavanone glycoside, a tetrahydroxyflavanone, a monosaccharide derivative, a beta-D-glucoside and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones. It is functionally related to a (2S)-flavanone.

Name: Sodium ferulate
Description: This molecule is an organic sodium salt resulting from the replacement of the proton from the 3-hydroxy group of ferulic acid by a sodium ion. It has a role as a plant metabolite, an antioxidant, a MALDI matrix material, an anti-inflammatory agent, an apoptosis inhibitor and a cardioprotective agent. It contains a trans-ferulate.

Name: Domoic acid
Description: This molecule is an L-proline derivative that is L-proline substituted by a carboxymethyl group at position 3 and a 6-carboxyhepta-2,4-dien-2-yl group at position 4. It is produced by the diatomic algal Pseudo-nitzschia. It is an analogue of kainic acid and a neurotoxin which causes amnesic shellfish poisoning (ASP). It has a role as a neurotoxin, a marine metabolite, a hapten, a neuromuscular agent and an algal metabolite. It is a pyrrolidinecarboxylic acid, a tricarboxylic acid, a L-proline derivative and a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate acid of a domoate(2-).

Name: Dimercury dichloride
Description: This molecule is a mercury coordination entity.

Name: Fargesone A
Description: This molecule is a member of benzodioxoles.

Name: (2-trans,6-cis)-farnesol
Description: This molecule is the (2E,6Z)-stereoisomer of farnesol.

Name: Demethoxyaschantin
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of furofurans that is tetrahydro-1H,3H-furo[3,4-c]furan-1-yl]-1,3-benzodioxole carrying an additional 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl substituent at position 4. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a furofuran, a lignan, a dimethoxybenzene and a member of benzodioxoles.

Name: Rose oxide
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of oxanes that is tetrahydro-2H-pyran which is substituted at positions 2 and 4 by an isoprop-1-enyl group and a methyl group, respectively. Organic compound of the pyran class and the monoterpene class and a fragrance found in roses and rose oil. All four possible stereoisomers are known; the 2S,4R and 2S,4S diastereoisomers [also known as the (-)-cis- and (-)-trans-isomers, respectively] are the main constituents in several essential oils and are used as a food flavouring and in perfumes and cosmetics. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a monoterpenoid, a member of oxanes and an olefinic compound.

Name: Piperdial
Description: This molecule is a secondary alcohol.

Name: Piperalol
Description: This molecule is a secondary alcohol.

Name: Micromelin
Description: This molecule is a member of coumarins.

Description: This molecule is a member of xanthones.

Name: 6-Hydroxy-1,2,3,7-tetramethoxy-9H-xanthen-9-one
Description: This molecule is a member of xanthones.

Name: Senegin III
Description: This molecule is a triterpenoid saponin isolated from Polygala senega var latifolia and has been shown to exhibit hypoglycemic activity. It has a role as a hypoglycemic agent and a plant metabolite. It is a cinnamate ester, a hydroxy monocarboxylic acid, a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a triterpenoid saponin. It is functionally related to a 4-methoxycinnamic acid. It derives from a hydride of an oleanane.

Name: 1,2,3,6,7-Pentamethoxyxanthone
Description: This molecule is a member of xanthones.

Name: 1,7-Dimethoxyxanthone
Description: This molecule is a member of xanthones.

Name: Tenuifoliose A

Name: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine
Description: This molecule is an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine that has alpha-configuration at the anomeric centre.

Name: Tenuifoliside A

Description: This molecule is a member of xanthones.

Name: Obaberine
Description: This molecule is a member of isoquinolines and a bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloid.

Name: D-cymarose
Description: This molecule is a dideoxyhexose derivative.

Name: DTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-alpha-D-gulose
Description: This molecule is a dTDP-sugar having 4-dehydro-6-deoxy-alpha-D-gulose as the sugar component. It is a conjugate acid of a dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-alpha-D-gulose(2-).

Name: Conduritol
Description: This molecule is a tetrol that is cyclohexene in which a hydrogen attached to each of the carbons at positions 3, 4, 5, and 6 is replaced by a hydroxy group. The group consists of six possible diastereoisomers, known as conduritols A to F, some of which can exist as two distinct enantiomers. It is a tetrol, a secondary alcohol and a cyclitol. It derives from a hydride of a cyclohexene.

Name: Arteglasin A
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpene lactone.

Name: 2',4',6'-trihydroxyacetophenone
Description: This molecule is a benzenetriol that is acetophenone in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 4, and 6 on the phenyl group are replaced by hydroxy groups. It is used as a matrix in matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization (MALDI) mass spectrometry for the analysis of acidic glycans and glycopeptides. It has a role as a MALDI matrix material and a plant metabolite. It is a methyl ketone, a benzenetriol and an aromatic ketone.

Name: Pyrocurzerenone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: 1-(4-Methylphenyl)ethanol
Description: This molecule is a member of toluenes.

Name: Cyclocurcumin
Description: This molecule is a diarylheptanoid.

Name: Curcolone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Curmadione
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Curcolonol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Zederone

Name: 3-octadecylenic acid
Description: This molecule is a long-chain fatty acid.

Name: Zedoarol
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Tetrahydrodemethoxycurcumin
Description: This molecule is a beta-diketone that is tetrahydrocurcumin in which one the methoxy groups has been replaced by a hydrogen atom. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a diarylheptanoid, a polyphenol, a beta-diketone and a monomethoxybenzene.

Name: Curine
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ether.

Name: Gibberellin A13
Description: This molecule is a C20-gibberellin that is gibberellin A12 in which the 4a-methyl group is oxidised to the corresponding carboxylic acid and a hydroxy substituent is present at the 2beta-position. It is a C20-gibberellin and a tricarboxylic acid. It is functionally related to a gibberellin A12.

Name: Tuliposide B
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid derivative and an O-acyl carbohydrate.

Name: N-amyl butyrate
Description: This molecule appears as a colorless liquid. Less dense than water. May emit acrid fumes and irritating smoke when burned. Used to make plastics.

Name: Citrusinine ii
Description: This molecule is an organic molecular entity.

Name: 8-geranylumbelliferone
Description: This molecule is a member of the class of hydroxycoumarins that is umbelliferone in which the ring hydrogen at position 8 has been replaced by a geranyl group. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a hydroxycoumarin and a monoterpenoid. It is functionally related to an umbelliferone.

Name: Citrusinine I
Description: This molecule is a member of acridines. It is functionally related to an acridone.

Name: 9S-hydroxy-2E-decenoic acid
Description: This molecule is a carbonyl compound.

Name: Taxine A
Description: This molecule is an amine.

Name: Linoelaidic acid
Description: This molecule is an octadecadienoic acid containing two E (trans) double bonds at positions 9 and 12. It has a role as a metabolite. It is an octadecadienoic acid and an omega-6 fatty acid.

Name: Cis-tetradec-7-enoic acid
Description: This molecule is a tetradecenoic acid having a cis-double bond at the 7-position.

Name: Physalin C
Description: This molecule is a physalin.

Name: Physalin D
Description: This molecule is a physalin with antimalarial and antimycobacterial activities isolated from Physalis angulata. It has a role as an antimalarial, an antimycobacterial drug and an antineoplastic agent. It is a physalin, a lactone, an enone, a 5alpha-hydroxy steroid, a 6beta-hydroxy steroid, an organic heteroheptacyclic compound and a cyclic ether.

Name: Danielone
Description: This molecule is an aromatic ketone that is 2-hydroxy-1-phenylethanone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4 and methoxy groups at positions 3 and 5. It is a phytoalexin isolated from the papaya fruit and exhibits antifungal activity. It has a role as a phytoalexin, an antifungal agent and a plant metabolite. It is a dimethoxybenzene, a member of phenols, an aromatic ketone, a primary alcohol and a primary alpha-hydroxy ketone.

Name: Ethyl lactate
Description: This molecule appears as a clear colorless liquid with a mild odor. Flash point 115 °F. Denser than water and soluble in water. Vapors heavier than air.

Name: 2-acetyl-5-methylfuran
Description: This molecule is a furan carrying acetyl and methyl substituents at the 2- and 5-positions respectively. It is a member of furans, a methyl ketone and an aromatic ketone.

Name: Ethyltrimethylpyrazine

Name: Dexamethasone acetate
Description: This molecule is a corticosteroid hormone.

Name: Yiamoloside B

Name: Simulansine
Description: This molecule is an oxacycle, an organic heterotricyclic compound and an organonitrogen heterocyclic compound.

Name: Simulansamide
Description: This molecule is a benzophenanthridine alkaloid.

Name: Simulanoquinoline
Description: This molecule is a benzophenanthridine alkaloid.

Name: 1-behenoylglycerol
Description: This molecule is a fatty acid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group at position-1 of glycerol with the carboxy group of docosanoic acid. It has a role as a plant metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a 1-monoglyceride and a fatty acid ester. It is functionally related to a glycerol and a docosanoic acid.

Name: Chrysanthenone
Description: This molecule is a monoterpenoid.

Name: Handelin
Description: This molecule is a sesterterpenoid.

Name: Chrysarobin
Description: This molecule is an extract of Goa powder; a complex mixture of reduction products of chrysophanic acid, emodin, and emodin monomethyl ether; used locally in ringworm, psoriasis, and eczema.

Name: Indicumenone
Description: This molecule is a sesquiterpenoid.

Name: Docosyl trans-ferulate
Description: This molecule is a hydroxycinnamic acid. It has a role as a metabolite.

Name: 6-Methyl indole
Description: This molecule is a member of indoles.

Name: Isoplumericin
